chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 473: The Choice of Destiny (3)
paragraphs: After dealing with the formidable foe with great difficulty, before enjoying even a day of good life, he must leave this world.
King of the Cloud Sea felt a mix of emotions.
It must be known that, even those legendary knights of past generations, opened the Gate of Heaven decades or even a hundred years after the war ended.
Someone like him, breaking through immediately and about to leave, was the first one.
However, it is said that beyond the Gate of Heaven lies an even more beautiful world,
Thinking of this, King of the Cloud Sea didn’t feel so uncomfortable.
Thus, he replied, "I will now let people prepare the ritual, then pass on my knight’s breathing method to my son, and I can open the Gate of Heaven."
Han Xing and the others nodded and then began to wait.
At this moment, King of the Cloud Sea came to the outside of the great hall, summoning several of his officials.
The officials hadn’t had the chance to congratulate King of the Cloud Sea on his legendary breakthrough.
Instead, they heard him say that a ritual would be held immediately to proceed to the Gate of Heaven.
Strong shock appeared in the eyes of these officials.
"His Majesty the King! You cannot!"
"Your Majesty, the great situation has not yet stabilized, there are still many Sky Knights within the Cliff Kingdom, without your leadership, the Cliff Kingdom might make a comeback!"
They urged him one after another.
Nonetheless, King of the Cloud Sea had already made up his mind.
He waved them away, saying, "Don’t persuade me anymore, this matter is beyond your control, and also beyond mine."
"Quickly go and prepare."
The officials exchanged glances upon hearing this.
They seemed to know King of the Cloud Sea had already decided.
A moment later, they sighed and then departed.
Only half a day passed.
All the knights on the continent heard the news.
King of the Cloud Sea would hold a sacred ritual today to open the Gate of Heaven.
He was going to leave this world!
The knights who learned of this news were no less shocked than those officials.
While knights from the Cliff Kingdom seemed to see an opportunity, their eyes once again filled with longing.
At this moment, King of the Cloud Sea summoned his son, who just turned 14 this year.
Then he said meaningfully, "Kerry, you know, your father is leaving."
"Though you just turned 14 this year, you already possess the strength of an Earth Knight, your talent is stronger than your father’s."
Young Little Kerry said, tears in his eyes, "Father, why do you have to leave so soon?"
"Your child has not grown up yet, not ready to manage such a big country as the Cloud Sea Kingdom."
King of the Cloud Sea shook his head and said, "Kerry, you can."
"Now the greatest enemy has been eliminated by me, even though there are still a few Sky Knights within the Cliff Kingdom, we have means to counter them."
"With your talent, you will soon become the new Apocalypse Knight."
"I hope you can become the new Legendary Knight in 200 years."
"Father will wait for you inside the Gate of Heaven..."
King of the Cloud Sea explained many things.
Young Little Kerry shed tears while remembering every word King of the Cloud Sea said.
Then, King of the Cloud Sea slowly stood up and said, "Alright, the time is almost here."
"Now, take over the Thunderstorm Sword from my hand, and you will be the new leader of the Cloud Sea Kingdom."
Little Kerry kneeled on one knee, respectfully accepting the Longsword from King of the Cloud Sea’s hand.
Several hours later.
Gathered by those kingdom ministers.
Millions of knights assembled on the same plain.
They were all there to witness King of the Cloud Sea’s heavenly ritual.
At this moment.
King of the Cloud Sea began his speech under the gaze of several million pairs of eyes.
It was nothing but recounting the hardships of the Cloud Sea over the past two hundred years and the history of the knights’ wars.
The knights below were deeply touched.
Tears of emotion ran down their eyes.
Then, King of the Cloud Sea suddenly said, "Thus, the speech ends here."
"May the Divine Light always protect you, and also always protect the Cloud Sea Kingdom."
"Now, I will open the Gate of Heaven and leave this world."
Upon these words, millions of pairs of eyes instantly fixed on King of the Cloud Sea.
He raised the Longsword high, a surging Divine Power burst towards the sky.
"Buzz!"
This Divine Power shot up to the deepest part of the sky.
At the same time, the clouds in the sky were stirred, seemingly forming a terrifying whirlwind.
"Whoosh—whoosh—whoosh—"
The clouds rotated, gradually converging.
This continent also whipped up gusts of wind.
Fallen leaves danced.
The knights stood upright in the wind.
Meanwhile.
The rotation speed of the whirlwind in the sky became increasingly intense, more clouds attracted to form a thick dark cloud vortex.
Because the cloud layer was too thick. Even the sun was obscured.
This vast world fell into temporary darkness.
The spirits involuntarily raised their heads, puzzled by the spectacle in the sky.
When the terrifying cloud layer accumulated to a certain thickness.
Like after the rain clears, suddenly, from within the cloud layer, a strong beam of dawn shot through.
The beam of light was so intense, it seemed as if only the figure of this light remained between heaven and earth.
The crowd watched with their own eyes.
The dawn light enveloped King of the Cloud Sea, making him appear as sacred as the Pope.
In the next moment, the blue Divine Power on King of the Cloud Sea’s body charged towards the sky.
"Boom!"
After a terrifying burst of Divine Power, the dark clouds were completely dispersed.
Dazzling light illuminated every corner of the world.
This light brought endless Life Force.
At the same time, plants on the Sky Island began to proliferate.
Sweet Fruit trees within mere seconds were laden with plump red fruits, falling to the ground before they could be picked.
Blue Crystal Flowers blossomed instantly, the whole hillside covered in colorful blooms.
It seemed as though the entire world was cheering to celebrate the birth of a new Legendary Knight.

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 474: Entering the Gate of Heaven
paragraphs: At this moment.
All the knights simultaneously raised their heads, for they saw a portal suddenly appear in the sky.
The pillars of the portal were entirely built with white stone, and the white gate was carved with various patterns.
In the ears of everyone, it seemed as though they could hear the singing of nuns.
The knights exclaimed one after another: "Look, that’s the Gate of Heaven!"
"No wonder they say the Gate of Heaven is the most sacred creation in the world; just looking at it makes me want to kneel!"
Apart from this group of knights, all creatures in this world felt an extremely holy aura.
At the same time.
A staircase slowly extended from the portal, gradually descending from the sky.
"Here it comes, the heavenly staircase! Only the chosen legendary knights may tread upon it!"
The knights exclaimed again, their eyes wide open, as if fearing to miss a single second of this sacred ritual.
The King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom gazed at the staircase extending to his feet and took a deep breath.
He knew that once he stepped onto the staircase, there would be no turning back.
He turned his head and waved to the knights, saying, "Then, farewell, my most beloved subjects!"
The knights all shouted in unison: "Farewell, Your Majesty the King!"
The King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom turned back around without hesitation.
And took a step onto the heavenly staircase.
At the same time, he suddenly noticed that everything around him vanished.
Whether those Sky Islands or the continent below, and all the knights, everything disappeared from his sight.
Everything around became engulfed in whiteness, leaving only this sacred staircase in front of him.
The King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom no longer hesitated, but held the sword at his waist, and stepped upward one step at a time.
The king could not see.
But the knights below could still see the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom ascending the staircase.
Their eyes filled with worship and envy.
Moreover, as the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom climbed higher, the Gate of Heaven began to open slowly.
A vast and unfathomable aura gradually seeped from within.
Under this aura, even the legendary King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom seemed so insignificant.
At this moment, Han Xing and others watching mid-air exchanged glances.
They saw a hint of delight in each other’s eyes.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "I seem to have sensed the aura of a demigod inside..."
"Good heavens, so the demigods of this world are all hidden behind the Gate of Heaven."
At this point, the Gate of Heaven had already opened halfway.
The aura emanating from within made the hundreds of thousands of knights below irresistibly kneel.
They were witnessing this moment that was enough to be recorded in the annals of history.
Minutes later, the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom arrived before the Gate of Heaven.
However, he couldn’t see the scenery behind the gate, everything in front was a white expanse.
After pondering for a moment.
The King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom stepped directly into the Gate of Heaven.
At the same time, the staircase disappeared, and the Gate of Heaven gradually closed.
The knights below shouted once more: "Farewell, Your Majesty the King!"
"May your glory always protect us!"
The knights clenched their right fists and placed them over their chests.
Then they watched the Gate of Heaven as it closed slowly.
And just at this moment.
Six streams of light flashed and disappeared, rushing in at the moment the gate was about to close.
The knights below displayed expressions of bewilderment.
"Did you see it, something seemed to follow His Majesty the King into the Gate of Heaven?"
"It seems so, what was that?"
The knights exchanged glances.
However, because those six streams of light were incredibly fast, almost in the blink of an eye.
Only a small number of knights witnessed that scene.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and others who had entered the Gate of Heaven suddenly received a system prompt,
[You have entered the special area: God of Light’s Paradise]
Upon seeing this prompt, they couldn’t help but twitch their mouths.
Cheng Jianyong complained: "Wow, so the so-called paradise is just the God of Light’s Paradise, huh?"
The others were similarly speechless.
Han Xing then said: "Radiance, first hide our aura."
The God of Radiance did so without hesitation, hiding them entirely.
Then, they began to observe their surroundings.
Here, it felt like a giant city floating above the cloud tops.
Various pavilions hidden within the cloud layer appeared and disappeared.
But the whole city was enveloped by a divine power shield, so when Han Xing and others were outside, they didn’t sense the aura of this special area.
And in front of them appeared a magnificent white corridor, with white roses blooming on either side.
The entire [Paradise] exuded a holy aura.
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom walked on this magnificent corridor, confusion still radiating from his eyes.
And Han Xing and his group, hiding their aura, followed distantly behind the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom.
Moments later, a knight with equally legendary level strength approached.
"Is there a new legendary knight here again?"
"But this time, it seems it’s a bit early."
Moments later, appearing in front of the King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom was a middle-aged man in white armor, a sword at his waist.
The King of the Cloud Sea Kingdom seemed to recognize the person, and said excitedly: "You are... you’re Enivar, the seventeenth knight of the Cloud Sea Kingdom to break through to legendary status!"
"You’re still alive!"
However, the legendary knight on the opposite side said calmly: "Do not shout, follow me."
"Every knight here has come up from below."

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 474: Entering the Gate of Heaven (2)
paragraphs: The King of the Cloud Sea nodded in sudden realization.
He had been too excited and almost forgot about this.
Then, the knight led the King of the Cloud Sea deeper into the corridor.
Han Xing and the others hid their presence and followed behind.
To avoid detection, this time, the God of Radiance personally stepped in and worked hard to conceal their aura.
Even demigod-level experts wouldn’t notice their existence unless face-to-face.
Soon the King of the Cloud Sea was led by the legendary knight into a sacred hall.
Inside, there were hundreds of legendary auras, dozens of demigods, and even the presence of some ordinary Tier Three and Tier Four people.
Upon entering the hall, the King of the Cloud Sea showed a look of astonishment.
Because he saw that the hundreds of knights around him were those who had broken through to legend and had been guided to the Gate of Heaven throughout the generations.
However, at this moment, they were all kneeling on one knee, respectfully looking at the hundred or so exceptionally graceful females on the hall’s platform.
Among them, more than a dozen possessed demigod-level power.
The legendary knight beside the King of the Cloud Sea gestured, "Hurry and pay respects to the goddesses!"
The King of the Cloud Sea was taken aback, "Goddesses?"
"Which goddess?"
Despite his confusion, the King of the Cloud Sea complied, "Greetings, Goddesses!"
Above, the hundreds of goddesses nodded simultaneously.
Han Xing and the others observing from outside exchanged curious glances at the scene.
At this moment, a female with a black plum blossom mark on her forehead and initial-tier demigod level spoke softly, "This time, the Gate of Heaven has opened two years earlier."
"Do you know what happened?"
Hearing this question, the King of the Cloud Sea was instantly startled.
Because he had no idea how to respond.
Was he supposed to tell these goddesses that a group of mysterious entities seized the Sun Crystal ahead of schedule, allowing him to break through to a legendary knight?
Even Han Xing and the others outside became somewhat tense.
Cheng Jianyong whispered, "Damn, the King of the Cloud Sea won’t betray us, right?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Whether he betrays us or not."
"If there are any unusual occurrences."
"We act immediately and control all the experts here."
The team members nodded.
The King of the Cloud Sea, after considering it in his mind, decided to feign ignorance. He shook his head and said, "Respected Goddesses, I don’t know what happened."
"All I know is that the Sun Crystal suddenly burst forth, and I seized it, breaking through to become a legendary knight."
The goddess with dark lips seemed to ponder as she slightly opened her lips.
After a moment, she shook her head and said, "Forget it, the Divine Master has been gone for tens of thousands of years; a small problem with the Sun Crystal he left behind is normal."
The other goddesses also nodded gently as they sat on their thrones.
The King of the Cloud Sea couldn’t help but ask, "Respected Goddesses, what is the world behind the Gate of Heaven, and what are we supposed to do?"
The goddess with almond-shaped eyes glanced at him indifferently.
"We are the wives left in this world by the Divine Master, and the original beings of this world were born of us."
"Then these beings were released into the world below, beginning to proliferate gradually."
"After tens of thousands of years, the human race below was formed."
Upon hearing this, the King of the Cloud Sea’s eyes showed slight shock.
"You mean that the humans of this world were created by you?"
The goddesses on the thrones nodded slowly.
The King of the Cloud Sea felt even more astonished and continued to ask, "Then why gather us legendary knights at the Gate of Heaven?"
Upon hearing this query, not only did the hundred or so goddesses reveal a strange smile, but the other legendary knights did as well.
At this moment, the goddess with dark purple lips spoke softly, "The Divine Master has not returned in thousands of years, gathering you to allow life to continue.
"Life to continue?"
The King of the Cloud Sea felt increasingly perplexed.
Who is the Divine Master?
What does life continuation mean?
As if understanding his thoughts.
The goddess spoke quietly, "Then, to welcome new knight companions, let us begin the life extension ceremony."
The King of the Cloud Sea looked slightly puzzled.
Yet in the next moment, his puzzled gaze turned into shock.
He watched.
As the goddess’s words fell.
The a hundred plus legendary knights across the hall began removing their armor and then their undergarments, until completely bare.
While on the throne, those lofty goddesses also slowly descended the stairs.
They unwound the light gauze on their bodies as they walked.
Rustling...
Pieces of clothing fell to the ground, revealing their graceful forms.
Then these elevated goddesses went directly to the knights, engaging in forbidden acts.
This spectacle completely stunned Han Xing and the others observing outside.
The two girls blushed deeply and turned away not to watch as soon as they sensed something was amiss.
Han Xing also cast a divine power barrier for them, isolating all displays.
Inside, low gasps continued to echo.
It’s likely that none of the beings in this world ever imagined what paradise actually looks like this.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed repeatedly, "Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"

As the goddess’s words fell.
The a hundred plus legendary knights across the hall began removing their armor and then their undergarments, until completely bare.
While on the throne, those lofty goddesses also slowly descended the stairs.
They unwound the light gauze on their bodies as they walked.
Rustling...
Pieces of clothing fell to the ground, revealing their graceful forms.
Then these elevated goddesses went directly to the knights, engaging in forbidden acts.
This spectacle completely stunned Han Xing and the others observing outside.
The two girls blushed deeply and turned away not to watch as soon as they sensed something was amiss.
Han Xing also cast a divine power barrier for them, isolating all displays.
Inside, low gasps continued to echo.
It’s likely that none of the beings in this world ever imagined what paradise actually looks like this.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed repeatedly, "Whoa!
Whoa!
Whoa!"

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 474: Entering the Gate of Heaven (Part 3)
paragraphs: "I was completely dumbfounded!"
Shen Yun couldn’t help but twitch his mouth, "Today I really feel like a knife cutting my rear end, enlightened."
Even the God of Radiance beside them had a peculiar expression on his face.
It’s unbelievably defying.
In everyone’s mind, an idea inevitably emerged.
Did these goddesses gather these knights only to keep them as male slaves?
However, after observing for a few seconds, Han Xing suddenly said, "Don’t you guys feel something’s off about these goddesses?"
"Off?" Everyone asked in confusion.
Han Xing nodded, "Apart from those few demigods, the other goddesses have an aura of decay about them."
Upon hearing this, everyone continued to look over.
At this moment, the King of the Cloud Sea stood dumbfoundedly in place, seemingly completely oblivious to what was happening.
Then, the goddess with phoenix eyes and seductive eyes gently beckoned with her finger.
The King of the Cloud Sea walked toward her as if he had lost his senses.
Yet, at that moment, he seemed to notice something.
The King of the Cloud Sea rubbed his eyes.
In the next moment, he suddenly saw the goddess before him vanish.
Walking towards him instead was a woman with a face full of wrinkles and sagging skin.
The King of the Cloud Sea snapped awake, pointing at her in fear, "You you! What’s going on here?"
The woman with a wrinkled face opened her dry lips and spoke, "You actually managed to break free from that control state."
"Interesting."
Her voice turned hoarse like an old lady.
The King of the Cloud Sea looked around.
At this moment, he was horrified to find.
The previously glamorous goddesses had all turned into extremely old ladies.
Their skin was wrinkled and piled together, covered with black spots.
Their eyes were cloudy, and even their teeth were almost gone.
What was even more terrifying was that the King of the Cloud Sea saw several non-human creatures among them.
Centaur, spider, octopus, and even flapping moths were present.
At this moment, the demigod level goddess suddenly had several skeletal arms appear behind her.
"Sigh... That man left us here, hasn’t appeared in tens of thousands of years."
"No longer providing us with new divine power, we’ve become like this..."
"Having no choice but to search in the world below for those with vigorous life force, to help us restore our appearance..."
After saying this, she pointed lightly, and the King of the Cloud Sea was frozen in place.
However, Han Xing and the others watching from afar had already understood what was happening here.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but comment, "Wow, this God of Light has quite the playbook."
"Gathered so many beauties from different races here, planning to establish a harem and directly populate an entire world."
"But for some reason, the God of Light hasn’t returned for thousands of years, leaving this group of women here."
"And the time flow here is one to ten, meaning these women have been here for tens of thousands of years."
"With their power, they’re nearing the end of their lifespan."
"So they came up with this method to preserve their youth..."
After Cheng Jianyong finished speaking, everyone nodded.
They also understood why these goddesses had fallen into such decadence.
To keep their youth eternal, they needed to absorb more young life force.
Then they launched the Gate of Heaven scheme and maintained it for tens of thousands of years.
Han Xing glanced at the God of Radiance and asked, "Radiance, have you finished sensing?"
"Did you sense the presence of any divine spirits here?"
The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "Master, I’ve already sensed there isn’t any other divine spirit presence."
"In this special area, all the strong are here."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded and then said directly, "Then let’s take action, control all these guys, and find out the whereabouts of the Light God’s Treasure Vault."
The God of Radiance nodded without hesitation.
In the next moment, a terrifying divine power erupted from him.
This divine power completely enveloped the entire Paradise.
If the God of Radiance hadn’t consciously controlled it, he could even have completely enveloped this small world.
At this moment, everyone in the hall was frozen in place, enveloped by the God of Radiance’s divine power.
All their powers were sealed.
Whether it was divine power, so-called knight’s power, vision, or sensory abilities, all were sealed.
Just like when Han Xing and the others faced the will of the God of Light at Tier Four.
This time, these legends and decaying demigods felt their five senses completely stripped away.
The knights were utterly confused, each grasping at the air before them aimlessly.
But having gone through the initial confusion, those goddesses noticed the familiarity of this divine power.
They carefully sensed this divine power that was sealing them.
One of the goddesses murmured, "This aura is so similar to the Lord God’s aura..."
"Lord God, have you returned?"
All of a sudden, all the goddesses began to shout.
"Lord God, I miss you so much!"
"Lord God, we’ve waited for you for tens of thousands of years, have you finally remembered us?"
"Lord God... Why don’t you see us?"
Everyone’s expressions turned peculiar.
Cheng Jianyong joked at this moment, "Radiance, they’re calling you."
The God of Radiance looked at the group of bare old women before him.
Even though he was experienced and knowledgeable, he felt somewhat uneasy at the moment.
He was about to speak when Han Xing interrupted him, "Radiance, they seem to be mistaking you for the God of Light, try asking the treasure vault’s whereabouts."
The God of Radiance’s expression stiffened, meaning he had to deal with these old ladies?
But since it was Han Xing’s command, the God of Radiance couldn’t refuse.
So, he imitated the God of Light’s tone and slowly spoke, "It’s me."

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 475: The Truth of Heaven, Opening the Divine Treasure Vault
paragraphs: In the next moment, these divine maidens fell into a frenzy.
"Oh god! It’s really Lord God!"
"I’ve waited for you for so long!"
"Lord God! I’ve missed you so much!"
Seeing them rushing towards him collectively, the God of Radiance nearly got goosebumps.
He twitched his mouth slightly and continued, "I encountered some issues outside, which delayed me."
This sounded like a very flimsy excuse.
However, the divine maidens in the scene believed it without any hesitation.
"So that’s it, we misunderstood Lord God, sob sob! I am to blame."
"We thought Lord God would never come back..."
At this moment, one of the elderly divine maidens sighed and said, "Although I cannot see Lord God, I can sense that the aura of Lord God is still so youthful and vibrant."
"Sadly, my appearance is gone..."
For a moment, the divine maidens realized something simultaneously.
Their wrinkled faces all displayed a look of embarrassment.
The God of Radiance did not speak because he knew the more he said, the more he’d be exposed.
However, seeing his silence, the elderly maidens became anxious.
"Lord God, have you abandoned us? Or are you disappointed with the filthy scene in the hall?"
"Lord God, please forgive us. I am willing to endure all punishment, just to be by your side again!"
The elder with purple lips slowly spoke, using an aged voice, "Lord God, blame only me if you must."
"As a Divine Maiden of the White Bone Race, I know a method to extend life. This method only needs to consume a lot of Life Force to live eternally."
"But you told me before you left, not to harm the beings of the Lower Realm. I’ve remembered your words over these years.
"However, you have been gone for too long, and many sisters could no longer endure, their appearances growing increasingly old."
"Their final wish was to see you once more before dying."
"With no other choice, I used this compromise of a method."
"I taught them to absorb Life Force by communing with Knights of the Lower Realm."
"If punishment is due, let it befall me alone!"
Having said that, the elder with closed eyes knelt down immediately.
The other divine maidens also knelt to plead for her.
At this moment, those observing from the outer hall, looked somewhat bemused.
Cheng Jianyong remarked, "This God of Light seems impressive, having enchanted all these women to the core."
"A mere sentence remembered for tens of thousands of years."
"If I knew I was dying soon, regardless of orders, I’d save my life first."
Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "You’re not one of God of Light’s women; how would you know their thoughts."
"However, seeing this, the Goddess Hall isn’t as dirty as we imagined."
Everyone nodded.
Several divine maidens held Demigod Level power.
If they descended from the Gate of Heaven, nothing in the Lower Realm would equate their presence.
Just like the beasts of old, devouring any Sky Island they wish.
In this world, they were invincible.
Yet they restrained their desires and refrained from killing for the sake of their beauty’s endurance.
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed at a loss in handling the situation before him.
He looked pleadingly towards Han Xing.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing said, "If all they want is to see the God of Light one last time, grant them that."
"But first, find out the location of the treasure vault."
The God of Radiance nodded, understanding Han Xing’s intention.
He took a deep breath and said slowly, "It’s alright, I don’t blame you."
"In my eyes, you’re still as... beautiful as ten thousand years ago."
Upon hearing this, the divine maidens were overwhelmed with tears of joy.
"Wonderful, I knew Lord God would understand us."
"Lord God, you’re as merciful as always."
What they did not know was that the God of Light before them was merely an illusion by the God of Radiance.
One elder with a dried petal on her head asked, "Lord God, can I see you again?"
The other elders looked on eagerly.
The God of Radiance slowly said, "Soon, I will lift your divine power prohibition, but I have to deal with some matters first."
"I’ve been gone too long, and my memory is blurry. Who remembers where my treasure vault is?"
Hearing this, the divine maidens were utterly convinced that he indeed was the God of Light.
The divine maiden with many white bone arms said softly, "Lord God, your vault is deep in Paradise."
"Beneath the Altai Ice and Snow Celestial Pool."
The God of Radiance glanced at Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded to him.
This inquiry went smoother than expected.
Who knew it would be so easy to ascertain the location of the Light God’s Treasure Vault.
Having discovered the vault’s location, there was no further need for their concern here.
The God of Radiance again waved both hands, causing all knights and divine maidens to re-enter a state deprived of senses.
He turned to Han Xing and asked, "Master, how should these people be handled?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, then shook his head, "You inherited the God of Light’s power. Use your discretion with them."

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 475: Truth of Heaven, Opening the Divine Treasure Vault (2)
paragraphs: After speaking, he led the team members out of the hall.
The God of Radiance stood dumbfounded in place.
A moment later, he sighed and created a divine power avatar on the spot.
This divine power avatar had no strength but retained some of the God of Light’s memories.
He stayed here merely to comfort this group of aged goddesses.
What a pitiful group...
He shook his head.
The God of Radiance left the palace.
As for the control state of the people in the hall, it can only be lifted after they leave.
Soon, the God of Radiance caught up with Han Xing.
Han Xing also sensed the presence of those auras in the hall.
It seems the God of Radiance did not go all out.
The group didn’t pay it much mind.
A dozen seconds later.
They reached the deepest part of this Cloud Palace.
Here, they indeed saw a pool of pure water.
But strangely, snowflakes were floating above this pool of water.
Waves of coldness attacked everyone.
This is the Altai Ice and Snow Celestial Pool.
The pool water below seems to have the function of shielding divine power fluctuations.
Standing above it, they surprisingly did not find any trace of a treasure vault.
Han Xing glanced at it, and a system prompt appeared before him.
[Altai Ice and Snow Celestial Pool: The pool water is formed by extreme ice snow, consuming it can restore 19999 life value.]
"Wow, it can also restore life value?" Shen Yun said in surprise.
Cheng Jianyong also saw the system prompt and asked, "Brother Xing, should we take this pool water?"
Han Xing gave him a look, "What do you take me for?"
"It’s obviously the bathwater of that group of goddesses, I don’t want it."
The team members shared a knowing smile.
Then, Han Xing took the lead and jumped into the pool.
"Splash!"
The icy pool water was repelled by his divine power, not touching Han Xing at all.
Then, the other team members also jumped down one after another.
After diving together for a good four to five minutes, they reached a depth of several thousand meters and still hadn’t reached the bottom.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "Wow, this pool is really deep!"
"No wonder the God of Light would hide the treasure vault in this location."
The group nodded in agreement.
A few minutes later, upon diving to approximately ten thousand meters deep, they finally reached the bottom of the pool.
And below, they saw a gate also sealed with divine power.
Han Xing glanced at the God of Radiance, then took the Giant Beast Tail Spike out of his backpack.
The God of Radiance, understanding, took the tail spike and began frantically stabbing the divine power seal on the gate.
"Puff! Puff puff!"
A few seconds later, the divine power gate was directly breached.
A look of joy appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Han Xing didn’t go in immediately, but prayed at the gate: "I hope the God of Light’s treasure vault has more Terrastone and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots."
"In this way, I can directly construct the Celestial Rail Strike Device!"
The group, upon hearing this, also grew a bit expectant.
Then, the treasure vault gate slowly opened.
A strong wave of treasure aura emerged to greet them.
The aura of this treasure was even stronger than the vaults they had opened before.
"Oh my! It feels like there’ll be a lot of treasures inside!"
A look of delight appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Then, they directly entered the treasure vault inside.
In front of them appeared another magnificent palace.
On the stone pillars, patterns of various auspicious beasts were engraved in gold,
the floor was piled high with various treasures.
Even the gold coins were stacked into small hills.
Among those piles of gold coins, the group also saw some longswords and shields emanating divine power waves.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow! So many gold coins!"
"Each coin must weigh dozens of grams, right?"
"If you casually grab a handful, you could live a worry-free life on Blue Star!
Shen Yun gave him a look and said, "You brat, even as a demigod, is this all your ambition?"
Cheng Jianyong replied candidly, "What’s wrong with that, who minds if they have too much money?"
"Back in school, our monthly allowance was less than a thousand bucks, three people sharing a bowl of instant noodles."
"I always dreamed of finding a Giant Dragon’s treasure and striking it rich one day."
"Then I’d take my brothers to travel the world!"
"Now that so many gold coins are laid in front of me, it fulfills my old dream of getting rich."
After Cheng Jianyong finished speaking, everyone laughed.
Han Xing laughed and said, "Xiaoyongzi, then all these gold coins are yours."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Hahaha, thank you, Brother Xing!"
"When I return to the Witch Race Territory, I’ll give Xiaoyuanyuan a few big boxes of gold coins, that little one has always been a money-grubber."
"She will definitely be very happy."
Xiaoyuanyuan is Cheng Jianyong’s daughter, and Han Xing and Shen Yun are her godfathers.
Everyone also laughed.
However, they were soon captivated by the treasures in the vault.
Compared to the other things in this vault, the gold coins were actually the least valuable.
They saw stacks of Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones.
In the corners, there were large boxes filled with Ancient Elf Secret Ingots.
At this moment, Han Xing directly announced, "Start hoarding, brothers!"
The team members cheered in unison.
"Yeah!"
With that said, they all rushed forward.
Piles of materials were collected by them.
System prompts continuously sounded in Han Xing’s ears.
[Acquired Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*18243]
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone*24831.]
[Acquired Waveless Metal*37231.]
[Acquired...]
Compared to the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault, the Light God’s treasure vault clearly had more material reserves.

A look of joy appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Han Xing didn’t go in immediately, but prayed at the gate: "I hope the God of Light’s treasure vault has more Terrastone and Ancient Elf Secret Ingots."
"In this way, I can directly construct the Celestial Rail Strike Device!"
The group, upon hearing this, also grew a bit expectant.
Then, the treasure vault gate slowly opened.
A strong wave of treasure aura emerged to greet them.
The aura of this treasure was even stronger than the vaults they had opened before.
"Oh my!
It feels like there’ll be a lot of treasures inside!"
A look of delight appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Then, they directly entered the treasure vault inside.
In front of them appeared another magnificent palace.
On the stone pillars, patterns of various auspicious beasts were engraved in gold,
the floor was piled high with various treasures.
Even the gold coins were stacked into small hills.
Among those piles of gold coins, the group also saw some longswords and shields emanating divine power waves.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow!
So many gold coins!"
"Each coin must weigh dozens of grams, right?"
"If you casually grab a handful, you could live a worry-free life on Blue Star!
Shen Yun gave him a look and said, "You brat, even as a demigod, is this all your ambition?"
Cheng Jianyong replied candidly, "What’s wrong with that, who minds if they have too much money?"
"Back in school, our monthly allowance was less than a thousand bucks, three people sharing a bowl of instant noodles."
"I always dreamed of finding a Giant Dragon’s treasure and striking it rich one day."
"Then I’d take my brothers to travel the world!"
"Now that so many gold coins are laid in front of me, it fulfills my old dream of getting rich."
After Cheng Jianyong finished speaking, everyone laughed.
Han Xing laughed and said, "Xiaoyongzi, then all these gold coins are yours."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Hahaha, thank you, Brother Xing!"
"When I return to the Witch Race Territory, I’ll give Xiaoyuanyuan a few big boxes of gold coins, that little one has always been a money-grubber."
"She will definitely be very happy."
Xiaoyuanyuan is Cheng Jianyong’s daughter, and Han Xing and Shen Yun are her godfathers.
Everyone also laughed.
However, they were soon captivated by the treasures in the vault.
Compared to the other things in this vault, the gold coins were actually the least valuable.
They saw stacks of Philosopher’s Stones and Shimmering Terra Stones.
In the corners, there were large boxes filled with Ancient Elf Secret Ingots.
At this moment, Han Xing directly announced, "Start hoarding, brothers!"
The team members cheered in unison.
"Yeah!"
With that said, they all rushed forward.
Piles of materials were collected by them.
System prompts continuously sounded in Han Xing’s ears.
[Acquired Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*18243]
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone*24831.]
[Acquired Waveless Metal*37231.]
[Acquired...]
Compared to the Fertility God’s Treasure Vault, the Light God’s treasure vault clearly had more material reserves.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 475: The Truth of Heaven and the Opening of the Divine Treasure Vault_3
paragraphs: Aside from these materials, they also received a huge pile of gems, along with all kinds of equipment at Epic Level and above.
Although, this equipment wasn’t of much use to Han Xing and his team.
But they could still take it back to Xingyu City to increase the strength of the Survivors.
Everyone started looting like crazy.
Piles of materials like small hills were stuffed into their backpacks.
[Obtained Philosopher’s Stone *17341]
[Obtained Shimmering Terra Stone *7231]
[Obtained Red Flame Divine Gold *6231]
[Obtained...]
System notifications kept popping up.
Half an hour later, they finally finished collecting all the materials in this palace.
Han Xing tallied up the gains of the five.
By now, they had already looted:
[Philosopher’s Stone] *27.43 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone] *11.24 million
[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot] *5.72 million
[Thunder Divine Stone] *2.74 million
[Waveless Metal] *2.37 million
[Extreme Ice Divine Stone] *1.94 million
[Calamity Divine Gold] *60,000
[Chaos Divine Stone] *50,000
Although it still wasn’t enough to forge the Celestial Rail Strike Device, Han Xing didn’t feel discouraged at all.
Because right now, they had only just finished looting the first area of the Light God’s Treasure Vault.
Besides this grand hall.
They also saw a series of rooms nearby, each emanating a strong aura of treasure from within.
Han Xing said, "Keep looting!"
Hearing that, the teammates instantly became wildly excited and rushed into the rooms one by one.
Huge amounts of treasure were swept up by them.
The loot in each room was taken away.
It didn’t take long.
Han Xing harvested another over ten million Philosopher’s Stones, over ten million Shimmering Terra Stones, plus more than four million Ancient Elf Secret Ingots!
Han Xing glanced at his material reserves.
[Philosopher’s Stone] *150.37 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone] *51.06 million
[Ancient Elf Secret Ingot] *21.17 million
[Calamity Divine Gold] *710,000
[Chaos Divine Stone] *720,000
[World Will] *1
At this moment, a surge of intense joy rose in Han Xing’s heart.
He sighed with emotion, "Finally! The materials to forge the Celestial Rail Strike Device are fully sufficient!"
"As long as we get out of this vault and return to the Divine Demon Battleship, I can forge the first Celestial Rail Strike Device in history!"
The excitement in Han Xing’s heart was practically overflowing!
Just then, Shen Yun opened the last room.
He called out to Han Xing, "Brother Xing, come look at this!"
Hearing Shen Yun’s shout, Han Xing rushed over immediately.
Then they saw that in this splendid room, all kinds of gems were piled up in the corners.
Besides that, in this room there was also an altar right in front of them.
On top of it, there were a full 5 Divine Formats!
In that moment, even Han Xing felt a bit surprised.
"Damn! 5 Divine Formats!"
"Where did that God of Radiance bastard get these from?"
Everyone was stunned.
Han Xing, meanwhile, just walked up and collected the Divine Formats.
The system notification appeared.
[Collection successful, obtained [Divine Format: Echo], [Divine Form: Tiger], [Divine Grade·Bamboo], [Divine Grade·Judgement], [Divine Format: Light]...]
Five Divine Formats in total!
Han Xing checked the Divine Attributes of these formats.
[Divine Format: Echo]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: A strong being Above Legendary can greatly increase their Divine Power Value by absorbing the Divine Power contained within this Divine Format, with an increase of 2000~2500.
[Effect 2]: Any Profession that reaches Level 60 can use this Divine Format to break through to Demigod and grasp a portion of the ’Echo’ Law.
[Divine Form: Tiger]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: After absorption, increases Divine Power by 3000~3500.
[Effect 2]: Skipped.
[Divine Grade·Bamboo]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: After absorption, increases Divine Power by 2000~2500.
[Effect 2]: Skipped.
[Divine Grade·Judgement]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: A being Above Legendary, after absorption, increases Divine Power Value by 7000~8000.
[Effect 2]: Any Profession that reaches Level 60 can use this Divine Format to break through to Demigod, grasp a portion of the ’Judgement’ Law, and unlock a higher Level Limit.
[Divine Format: Light]: Special item.
[Effect 1]: After absorption, increases Divine Power Value by 3000~3500.
[Effect 2]: Skipped.
After reading through the Divine Attributes of the five formats, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
What he lacked most right now was a large number of Divine Formats.
By a rough calculation, if he absorbed all five, they would boost his Divine Power Value by at least 18,000!
If he relied on the World Tree, Han Xing would need to collect over 180,000 pieces of Ancient Spirit Wood to get that much.
"The haul this time is really not bad!" Han Xing praised sincerely.
At this moment, the God of Radiance also sensed the aura of those five Divine Formats.
He said, a bit surprised, "Didn’t expect that God of Light guy to even leave a Divine Format for himself."
Han Xing suddenly thought of something, then asked, "Radiance, I remember you said before that you could break through to True God within five years."
"If you also absorb this Light Divine Format, can you shorten that timeframe?"
The God of Radiance was a bit surprised when he heard that.
A moment later, he nodded. "In theory, it should be possible."
"The Light Rule contained in this Divine Format—if I absorb it—should speed up my progress toward breaking through to True God by about two years."
"However, since my combat power has already reached the upper limit of a Divine Spirit, even if I absorb this Divine Format, my combat strength won’t really increase."
Two years...
Han Xing nodded thoughtfully.
To others, the fact that this Divine Format couldn’t increase the God of Radiance’s combat power might make it seem a bit wasteful.
But to Han Xing, a single Divine Format that could let the God of Radiance reach True God two years earlier was a very good deal.
So he directly tossed the rhombic crystal in his hand, shining with Light, to the God of Radiance.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 476: Forging the First Celestial Rail Strike Device in History
paragraphs: Han Xing handed the ’Light’ Divine Format to the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance took it without being overly formal.
He nodded directly and said, "Thank you, Master."
Han Xing waved his hand. At this moment, a noticeably larger and more intense rhombic crystal appeared in his hand.
This one was the Divine Format of the God of Judgment.
To Han Xing’s surprise, just this Divine Format could increase the Divine Power Value by over 7000, more than the combined increase of two other Divine Formats.
Thus, Han Xing asked, "Radiance, is the God of Judgment a True God?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment and then nodded, "Yes, the God of Judgment has been a True God level existence for many years."
Han Xing continued to ask, "If you break through to True God, do you think you could be a match for the God of Judgment?"
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance said awkwardly, "The God of Judgment is an old True God. He specializes in offensive and destructive powers, and his combat strength is very strong."
"If it really comes to a fight, I could hold out against him for a while..."
Han Xing was a bit speechless, "Just say you can’t beat him then."
The God of Radiance smiled awkwardly.
"I am indeed not his match, but if both are True Gods, the God of Judgment wouldn’t be able to kill me either."
Han Xing nodded, "Previously the Old Tree warned me against absorbing those True Gods’ Divine Formats."
"If I absorb this Divine Format of the God of Judgment now, would he come after me?"
The God of Radiance contemplated once more, "Theoretically, yes."
"Even if the God of Judgment doesn’t want to take action, due to the mark of the rule, he’d be forced to strike at you."
"And because this Divine Format is True God level, the mark’s effect would last at least a year’s time."
"This means that within the next year, you’d be sensed by those Divine Spirits."
"However, if the God of Judgment is somewhere special at the moment, he might not be able to trouble you in the short term."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded in realization once again.
He learned some small facts about divine beings.
That is, absorbing another’s Divine Format would mark one’s location and persist for a long time.
"It seems that aside from the Divine Format of Judgment, the other Divine Formats can all be absorbed to enhance my strength."
"But there’s no rush to absorb them now.
"Once I have enough Divine Formats, I’ll absorb them in one go, and break through to Demigod."
"When those divine beings come looking for me, I’ll just defeat them all!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
So far, the vault of the God of Light had been completely plundered by them.
From entering this world to now, it hasn’t been a day yet.
Outside this realm, perhaps not even half an hour has passed.
Yet, they’ve altered the world’s structure.
Now, Han Xing was eagerly anticipating constructing the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
So, he looked at his teammates and said, "Let’s go, we can leave here now."
The teammates all nodded in agreement.
Then, they directly released the [Oracle Throne].
With Han Xing leading the God of Radiance, the other four teammates shared a teleportation.
Then, the figures of the six vanished from this world...
At the same time.
In the palace where the group of goddess resided.
After the God of Radiance left, their five senses deprivation state was lifted.
At this moment, all the goddesses saw the figure standing at the palace gate, exuding a dazzling radiance.
"Divine Master... it’s truly Lord God!"
"Oh my! Am I dreaming?"
They hurriedly dressed and dashed frantically toward the figure...
Upon returning to the Divine Demon Battleship, the God of Radiance also retracted his divine aura.
The huge small world once again hid into the Void.
As for Han Xing, he also arrived at the deck of the Divine Demon Battleship.
He directly opened the crafting interface, and then the system prompt appeared.

[Consume materials: Philosopher’s Stone*50,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*50,000, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*20,000, Calamity Divine Gold*5000, Chaos Divine Stone*2000, World Will*1, to craft the Celestial Rail Strike Device?]
[Note! Due to the massive size of the Celestial Rail Strike Device, at least 2100 square kilometers of space must be reserved.]
Han Xing glanced at the blueprint’s general outline, where only a strange creation could be vaguely seen.
"2100 square kilometers?"
"That means approximately seventy thousand meters long, thirty thousand meters wide?"
Han Xing inspected the size of the [Divine Demon Battleship].
Moments later, he found a suitable place.
That is, at the bow of the [Divine Demon Battleship].
The space here could almost fit two [Celestial Rail Strike Devices].
Han Xing directly clicked to construct.
The system prompt appeared: "Construction in progress, time remaining 10 days, 23 hours, 17 minutes..."
Han Xing was startled, "Wow, does it require so much time?"
Undoubtedly, this was the longest building he had ever constructed.
This also indirectly hinted at the power of the Celestial Rail Strike Device!
Han Xing’s heart was filled with anticipation.
Then, he returned to the cabin.
Directly activated teleportation mode.
"Divine Demon Battleship, launch!"
Buzz!
The Demon God’s Heart began to fully absorb the energy from the Void.
Then, teleportation mode was activated.
Seconds later, the massive figure of the Divine Demon Battleship vanished from its location.
Now that the God of Light had died, perhaps aside from Han Xing and his team, no one would ever find this small world again.
And all about this world will slumber here forever.
Five days later...
The Divine Demon Battleship appeared in another region of the Void.

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 476: Forging the First Celestial Rail Strike Device (Part 2)
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong sat in the cabin, studying his Holy Artifact Battleaxe.
He asked, "Brother Xing, for our next stop, are we going straight to the Land of Divine War?"
Han Xing nodded. "Mm, we’re more or less ready."
"Next, we head to the Land of Divine War, find some complete Rules and more Divine Formats, and let me condense my own Divine Format to break through."
The team members all looked excited after hearing this.
Because they all knew how significant what Han Xing was about to do truly was!
Once he succeeded, not only could he break through to Demigod, he might even touch the realm Hunt and the Demon Emperor once stood in.
As for what kind of Power that realm actually possessed, none of them knew.
None of them had ever broken through, and in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, there was no record of this.
According to the Old Tree, its memories in this regard had been affected by some Rule and were becoming increasingly blurry.
The Divine Demon Battleship continued forward, occasionally performing Teleportation maneuvers.
At this moment, Han Xing took out four Divine Formats.
They were: Compassion, Bamboo, Tiger, Echo.
The Light Divine Format, he had given to the God of Radiance.
The Reproduction Divine Format, he had given to the Great White Bear.
He still had a "Judgement" Divine Format in his hand.
But that belonged to a big-shot True God, not someone he could offend lightly.
So, he could only absorb these four Divine Formats first.
Han Xing looked at the four colored Divine Formats floating before him, joy rising in his eyes.
"Radiance, I’m going to absorb these Divine Formats—do I just swallow them directly?"
The God of Radiance froze for a second, then smiled and shook his head. "No need to swallow them."
"Master, you just need to shatter the Divine Formats, then control your Divine Power to absorb the overflowing Rules."
Han Xing nodded in sudden understanding.
Because they were already getting close to the Land of Divine War.
Even if that bunch of Divine Spirits wanted to come cause trouble, Han Xing felt no fear.
Not only that, he would be absorbing many more Divine Formats next.
Thus, Han Xing directly crushed the four Divine Formats before him.
In the next instant, a series of "crack, crack" sounds rang out.
The four Divine Formats shattered simultaneously.
Pure Power of Rules turned into specks of white light, seemingly about to disperse into the Void.
At this moment, Han Xing directly released his Divine Power.
Then, in an instant, all those overflowing Rule Fragments were absorbed by Han Xing.
He felt his Divine Power Value soaring at high speed.
The system prompts appeared.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: Echo, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Form: Tiger, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Grade·Bamboo, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Compassion, Divine Power Value +3500]
A total of four system prompts.
Han Xing’s Divine Power Value instantly skyrocketed by 11,000!
He happily glanced at his panel.
[Divine Power Value: 47614]
"Nice, I’m about to break through the fifty-thousand mark!"
"Still short 150,000 Divine Power!"
At the same time.
In the Void, four powerful beings opened their eyes at the same moment.
They gazed into the distance, pondering. "My Divine Format has been absorbed? By who?"
"The location is in the Void—could it be other Divine Spirits?"
Meanwhile, a woman with a snail shell on her back mused, "Should I go take a look?"
"Absorbing my Power of Rules is basically forming a grudge."
"And knowing full well there would be such consequences, yet still daring to do it, that has to be someone extremely confident in their own strength."
Thinking of this, the middle-aged woman carrying the snail shell shook her head.
"Better not wade into this muddy water."
Not just her—the other three Divine Spirits also made their decision: to let it go.
They were just ordinary Divine Spirits.
And the existence that had absorbed their Divine Formats was either some reckless hothead, or a terrifying monster.
If it was the latter, the other side might very well be doing it to lure them in.
If they rushed over foolishly, they might walk right into that trap.
With this in mind, these Divine Spirits all chose silence.
For the next five days, Han Xing remained in a vigilant State.
After confirming that no Divine Spirit had come to make trouble, he quietly let out a sigh of relief.
At the same time.
Everyone came out to the deck outside the cabin.
Because they were all waiting.
In two more hours, the first Celestial Rail Strike Device would be successfully constructed.
Just thinking about it filled everyone with anticipation.
At this moment, the entire battleship’s prow region was shrouded in a layer of holy white light.
Everyone silently waited.
They noticed that this time, the construction was different from all the previous ones.
Before, construction was just construction—there weren’t any special phenomena.
But now, they saw that the area covered by the white light was continuously absorbing more Void Energy.
You had to know, that single World Will Han Xing had invested had already sucked dry that whole stretch of Void, tens of millions of kilometers worth of Void Energy.
And after all these days.
The Celestial Rail Strike Device under construction had roughly absorbed just as much Energy.
If they hadn’t maintained constant movement, the same bizarre situation as when the World Will was synthesized might have occurred.
An entire stretch of Void erased directly.
At the side, the God of Radiance sighed. "Master, this mysterious item you’ve forged is brimming with vast might."
"The Energy it has absorbed by now is almost comparable to a small world."
Han Xing nodded.
He also felt it was getting a little ridiculous.
Still, the more outrageous the construction process, the stronger this thing probably was.

sentences.text: Cheng Jianyong sat in the cabin, studying his Holy Artifact Battleaxe.
He asked, "Brother Xing, for our next stop, are we going straight to the Land of Divine War?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Mm, we’re more or less ready."
"Next, we head to the Land of Divine War, find some complete Rules and more Divine Formats, and let me condense my own Divine Format to break through."
The team members all looked excited after hearing this.
Because they all knew how significant what Han Xing was about to do truly was!
Once he succeeded, not only could he break through to Demigod, he might even touch the realm Hunt and the Demon Emperor once stood in.
As for what kind of Power that realm actually possessed, none of them knew.
None of them had ever broken through, and in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, there was no record of this.
According to the Old Tree, its memories in this regard had been affected by some Rule and were becoming increasingly blurry.
The Divine Demon Battleship continued forward, occasionally performing Teleportation maneuvers.
At this moment, Han Xing took out four Divine Formats.
They were: Compassion, Bamboo, Tiger, Echo.
The Light Divine Format, he had given to the God of Radiance.
The Reproduction Divine Format, he had given to the Great White Bear.
He still had a "Judgement" Divine Format in his hand.
But that belonged to a big-shot True God, not someone he could offend lightly.
So, he could only absorb these four Divine Formats first.
Han Xing looked at the four colored Divine Formats floating before him, joy rising in his eyes.
"Radiance, I’m going to absorb these Divine Formats—do I just swallow them directly?"
The God of Radiance froze for a second, then smiled and shook his head.
"No need to swallow them."
"Master, you just need to shatter the Divine Formats, then control your Divine Power to absorb the overflowing Rules."
Han Xing nodded in sudden understanding.
Because they were already getting close to the Land of Divine War.
Even if that bunch of Divine Spirits wanted to come cause trouble, Han Xing felt no fear.
Not only that, he would be absorbing many more Divine Formats next.
Thus, Han Xing directly crushed the four Divine Formats before him.
In the next instant, a series of "crack, crack" sounds rang out.
The four Divine Formats shattered simultaneously.
Pure Power of Rules turned into specks of white light, seemingly about to disperse into the Void.
At this moment, Han Xing directly released his Divine Power.
Then, in an instant, all those overflowing Rule Fragments were absorbed by Han Xing.
He felt his Divine Power Value soaring at high speed.
The system prompts appeared.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: Echo, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Form: Tiger, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Grade·Bamboo, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Compassion, Divine Power Value +3500]
A total of four system prompts.
Han Xing’s Divine Power Value instantly skyrocketed by 11,000!
He happily glanced at his panel.
[Divine Power Value: 47614]
"Nice, I’m about to break through the fifty-thousand mark!"
"Still short 150,000 Divine Power!"
At the same time.
In the Void, four powerful beings opened their eyes at the same moment.
They gazed into the distance, pondering.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 476: Forging the First Celestial Rail Strike Device (Part 3)
paragraphs: One hour later.
The Void Energy within hundreds of thousands of kilometers around was once again mobilized fiercely.
At this moment, it was like a vortex in the ocean.
Endless energy gathered together, gradually forming a line of energy.
Along this line, the under-construction [Celestial Rail Strike Device] was continuously absorbing energy.
Then, the commotion grew increasingly terrifying!
Even Han Xing did not dare to use the warship’s teleportation function, for fear of interrupting the absorption of the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
Shen Yun sighed beside him, "Fortunately, this time, we’re building in the Void!"
"Otherwise, if it were in the Holy Spirit Realm, I’m afraid all the world’s strong would sense that commotion."
Han Xing also nodded.
This was the first [Celestial Rail Strike Device] in history, and no one knew such a thing would happen during construction.
At this moment, that mass of Void Energy Storm was still expanding.
For some reason, Han Xing felt a faint sense of worry.
"Radiance, keep an eye on the surroundings. If you see anything, let me know immediately."
The God of Radiance nodded.
As someone about to break through to a True God, he too sensed a faint sense of crisis in the dark.
However, he didn’t know where this sense of crisis was coming from.
The God of Radiance frowned deeply.
Not knowing the source of the crisis is what makes it most terrifying.
Previously, when helping those small worlds through catastrophes and receiving backlash, he knew it was a mysterious will retaliating against him.
But now, he couldn’t tell where the sense of crisis was coming from.
Another half hour passed.
The sense of crisis grew stronger.
And the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] was about to be successfully constructed.
At this moment, the God of Radiance could no longer bear it.
He suddenly rushed into the air.
Then his limbs suddenly spread out like a bird spreading its wings!
A billion rays of light burst forth from him.
This light directly illuminated the void within millions of miles completely!
His pupils burned like two suns.
His gaze was scorching, beginning to scan everything in this void.
Seeing the solemn look on the God of Radiance’s face,
everyone knew he might have sensed something.
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong and others simultaneously entered a combat-ready state.
However, even though the God of Radiance had unleashed all his Divine Power,
he still found no signs of anything unusual.
Han Xing, too, had already donned the [Mask of the Golden Goddess] and activated the [Eye of the Divine] effect.
Two pairs of divine eyes scanned through the void.
Like two celestial gods patrolling the human world.
Yet, despite the two of them working together, they still didn’t detect any anomaly in the Void.
At that moment.
Han Xing felt the Coal Ball in the Pet Space stirring restlessly.
"Hmm? Coal Ball wants to come out?"
Thinking of this, he directly released Coal Ball.
A massive black wolf, nearly ten meters in length, appeared suddenly.
"Roar!"
As soon as Coal Ball appeared, it let out a roar.
Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed with joy, "Ah! Little Coal Ball has come out."
However, at that moment, Coal Ball did not look at Zhang Lianmeng.
Instead, it tightened its limbs, emitting a low, threatening growl from its mouth.
"Roar!!!"
It let out a terrifying roar, the soundwave materializing and reverberating through the void.
Coal Ball seemed to have encountered some threat, continually looking around vigilantly.
At this moment, Han Xing seemed to understand something.
He directly spoke, "Radiance, be careful, there might be a Void Beast nearby!"
Hearing this, the God of Radiance also understood something.
"I see, I was wondering what that sense of crisis was, turns out it’s these creatures!"
Everyone nodded in realization.
From Coal Ball’s strength, it was clear that the Void Race was a kind of creature extremely skilled in hiding.
Plus, this was their turf.
Those Void Beasts could hide so well that even the Divine Spirits couldn’t detect them.
No wonder everyone sensed nearby danger but couldn’t see the source of it.
However, being a member of the Void Race, Coal Ball sensed the aura of its kin and was the first to issue a warning to Han Xing.
Cheng Jianyong, on guard around him, wondered aloud, "Speaking of which, we’ve been moving in the void for so long without encountering any Void Beasts."
"Why are they suddenly causing us trouble this time?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, "I fear it’s because the Celestial Rail Strike Device absorbed too much energy, triggering some sort of retaliatory will from the Void."
"And these Void Beasts were sent by that will to deal with us."
"Of course, it’s also possible there’s a nest of Void Beasts around here."
"Our absorption of void energy here alerted them all."
Everyone nodded.
One has to admit, both of Han Xing’s statements are plausible.
But regardless, at least now they knew who the enemy was.
At this moment, everyone was alert, ready for battle at any time.
Although they knew the enemy was nearby,
the hiding skills of the Void Race are simply too perverse.
If they don’t voluntarily reveal themselves, they simply can’t be forced out of the void.
Han Xing asked, "Radiance, is there a way to force out these Void Beasts?"
Suspended overhead like a sun, the God of Radiance pondered for a moment.
Then he nodded, "I’ll give it a try."
At that moment, the God of Radiance suddenly extinguished the light emanating from his body.
Then the bright scene in the void quickly vanished, plunging once again into darkness.
Only the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] continued ragingly absorbing the surrounding energy.
The next moment.
The God of Radiance took a deep breath.
He suddenly stretched out his arms.
Everyone saw a sudden burst of billions of Chains of Light from the God of Radiance.
"Brrzz!"
These Chains of Light burst forth, completely filling the area within hundreds of thousands of miles!

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 477: The Void Royal Family Reveals Itself
paragraphs: Not only that, these Chains of Light also carry the ability to blockade space.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and the others heard the system notification.
[You have been affected by the God of Radiance’s [Light Prison], your mobility has been sealed, and the space in this area has been locked...]
Han Xing and his five companions were instantly immobilized, even Coal Ball was frozen in place.
In that moment.
From the pupils of the God of Radiance, two beams of white light suddenly shot out.
He looked like a Celestial God inspecting the world, scanning inch by inch.
Soon, he discovered a section of the area where a vague shadow seemed to be lurking.
The next moment, a smile appeared at the corner of the God of Radiance’s lips, "Found it!"
His gaze swept over that shadow, then applied a layer of Divine Power Mark on it.
The Divine Power Mark radiated brilliance.
Even Han Xing and the others could clearly see the silhouette of the Void Beasts.
However, the God of Radiance’s scanning motion hadn’t stopped.
He seemed aware that the number of Void Beasts was definitely not just one.
So, he continued to scan.
Under his examination, the Void Beasts became unable to hide.
The God of Light’s mark clearly revealed their forms and locations.
Han Xing directed his gaze toward them, seeing the attributes of each Void Beast.
[Void Creature·Kadir]
[Level: 65 (Middle-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 242143, Agility 213523, Spirit 226371, Constitution 203415]
[Skills: Escape into the Void, Void Spike, Body of Nothingness, Void Eternal Night, Void Shattering]
[Divine Power Value: 10235]
[Void Creature·Stig]
[Level: 70 (High-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 442351, Agility 452301, Spirit 431623, Constitution 403153]
[Skills: Same as above]
[Divine Power Value: 24136]
Clearly, these Void Creatures possessed skills quite similar to Coal Ball.
However, what caught Han Xing’s attention even more were two Void Creatures that were significantly larger in stature, with purple horns on their heads.
Their aura felt incredibly profound and vast, even Coal Ball was much inferior in comparison to these two Void Creatures.
[Void Royal Family·Giozino]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
[Void Royal Family·Orasio]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
At this point, the dozens of Void Beasts around had all been marked by the God of Radiance.
The teammates also saw the attributes of the two Void Royals.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise, "Oh my... these Void Royals, could they really be Divine-level Void Beasts?"
Han Xing nodded.
From Coal Ball’s wary demeanor, it was clear that these Void Beasts had put enormous pressure on it.
Shen Yun also exclaimed, "Two Divine-level Void Beasts, plus dozens of Demigod-level Void Beasts, this lineup is truly a bit terrifying.".
Everyone felt the same way.
At this moment, the group of Void Beasts seemed to realize they had been exposed.
Yet due to the Divine Chains of the God of Light, these Void Beasts couldn’t break free at all.
"Roar! Roar!"
A series of low roars echoed.
The Void Beasts started to struggle fiercely.
However, as a top-tier Divine Spirit, the God of Radiance’s Divine Chains were not easily broken.
Crunch! Crunch!
The Divine Chains snapped one by one, but immediately new Divine Chains emerged and twisted the Void Beasts tightly.
At this moment, the two Void Royals unleashed boundless Power of the Void together, breaking free from the God of Radiance’s restraint.
Then, they charged toward the God of Radiance.
In the Void, ripples appeared, rapidly approaching the God of Radiance.
"Hmph!"
The God of Radiance snorted coldly, a look of disdain appearing on his face.
The most troublesome part of the Void Beasts lies in their extremely strong stealth abilities.
The God of Radiance’s mark happened to counteract their stealth abilities.
The next moment.
The God of Radiance casually slapped.
A large hand of light directly pressed down.
"Slap!"
A region was directly pressed down by a massive hand stretching ten thousand meters.
The Void Royals lurking in the Void were instantly forced out.
"Poof! Poof! Poof!"
The bodies of the Void Beasts cracked under pressure, looking on the verge of exploding.
At this moment, the two Void Royals began their counterattack.
Terrifying Void Energy surged from their bodies.
This Void Energy formed hundreds of thousands of Void Spikes, all aimed at the God of Radiance.
"Whiz! Whiz-whiz-whiz!"
The sound of the air shattering continually echoed.
From these spikes, Han Xing and the others sensed an immensely strong penetrative force.
Even a single spike could cause them severe damage.
Yet the God of Radiance neither dodged nor evaded.
He directly cast a layer of Divine Power Shield.
The next moment, these Void Spikes struck the Shield of Radiance, stirring up a flurry of ripples.
But they failed to breach the defense.
As a top-tier Divine Spirit, the God of Radiance’s reputation was well deserved.
Moreover, the God of Radiance immediately retaliated, throwing out two balls of light with a swift motion.
"Buzz!"
The light balls exploded upon contacting the bodies of the Void Beasts.
In an instant, terrifying light erupted like a supernova explosion.
"Boom!"
The two King-level Void Beasts were blasted away.
Then the God of Radiance instantly rushed forward, delivering punch after punch with Light Fist.
Bang! Bang-bang!
The Void constantly quaked, and Radiant Divine Power spread for a million miles.
The two Void Royals were battered backward.
He wielded enormous power, dominating the two Void Royals single-handedly.
Meanwhile, the surrounding Void Beasts were still trapped by the God of Radiance’s Divine Chains.
In other words.
The God of Radiance was not only fighting two Divine-level Beasts alone, but also had the spare capacity to control dozens of Demigods.

Moreover, the God of Radiance immediately retaliated, throwing out two balls of light with a swift motion.
"Buzz!"
The light balls exploded upon contacting the bodies of the Void Beasts.
In an instant, terrifying light erupted like a supernova explosion.
"Boom!"
The two King-level Void Beasts were blasted away.
Then the God of Radiance instantly rushed forward, delivering punch after punch with Light Fist.
Bang!
Bang-bang!
The Void constantly quaked, and Radiant Divine Power spread for a million miles.
The two Void Royals were battered backward.
He wielded enormous power, dominating the two Void Royals single-handedly.
Meanwhile, the surrounding Void Beasts were still trapped by the God of Radiance’s Divine Chains.
In other words.
The God of Radiance was not only fighting two Divine-level Beasts alone, but also had the spare capacity to control dozens of Demigods.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 477: Void Royal Family Appears_2
paragraphs: For the formidable combat strength of the God of Radiance, everyone once again had a clear and serious realization in their hearts.
Han Xing said with satisfaction, "Good, good, good, indeed worthy of being a top-tier Divine Spirit."
"When he breaks through to a True God, his combat strength will be able to undergo a qualitative transformation!"
At this moment, a fluctuation suddenly appeared once again in the void.
An invisible figure instantly drilled into the God of Radiance’s [Light Cage].
"Crack! Crack!"
Chains of Divine Power were shattered.
Even the demigod-level Void Beasts were rescued.
"Roar!!!"
One Void Beast after another charged towards the God of Radiance,
At this time, the God of Radiance frowned.
He also sensed an additional powerful aura on the battlefield.
But because the other party concealed their form, the specific appearance couldn’t be seen.
"Interesting, is there a third member of the Void Royal Family?"
As the words fell, the God of Radiance directly shot a radiant Divine Power and marked that Void Beast.
At this moment, the figure of that Void Beast gradually revealed itself.
It was a creature with the form of a tiger, with a single horn on its head.
Seeing these distinctive physical features, Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Oh my, another member of the Void Royal Family!"
At this moment, that Void Royal Family member suddenly charged towards the God of Radiance.
The current situation turned into a one versus three.
The other Void Beasts also seemed to know that the God of Radiance was the most troublesome enemy here.
Thus, they all swarmed towards the God of Radiance.
The current God of Radiance could be said to be in a state of being besieged.
Though he was a top-tier Divine Spirit, facing three divine-level creatures at once, these troublesome Void Beasts, was still a bit challenging.
Very soon, the Divine Power Shield of the God of Radiance was cracked.
Watching, those Void Beasts were about to rush to the God of Radiance’s body and launch an attack on his form.
Cheng Jianyong said below, "Old Guang, do you need us to help?"
The God of Radiance shot a Divine Power Spear and directly waved his hand, "No need..."
However, before finishing the sentence, a mass of darkness suddenly enveloped him.
One of the Void Royal Family members directly used [Void Eternal Night], pulling the God of Radiance into the depths of the void.
His radiance seemed to be extinguished like a flame.
The entire void immediately became incredibly dark.
Then, the attacks from those Void Beasts poured down like a storm.
"Damn!" The God of Radiance couldn’t help but curse.
In a moment, even he, was a bit unable to withstand it.
This was the God of Radiance’s first action, initially wanting to perform well in front of Han Xing.
However, it seemed he fell into some troublesome situation.
Of course, he would certainly be able to break free from this [Void Eternal Night] of the Royal Family, it just needed a little time.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing said, "Anybody want to go up and give it a try?"
Cheng Jianyong immediately said, "I’ll do it!"
Han Xing nodded, "Alright, go ahead."
Cheng Jianyong picked up the Holy Artifact Battleaxe in his hand, eager to try, "Is it finally my turn to take the stage?"
"This is my first action since breaking through to demigod; watch how I perform for you all!"
Despite the fact that the enemies before him were at least middle-tier demigod-level Void Beasts.
He wasn’t afraid at all; instead, his war intent was high.
The next moment.
Cheng Jianyong’s figure instantly disappeared from the original spot.
Then, directly appeared behind one of the middle-tier demigod-level Void Beasts.
At this moment, that Void Beast had entered the void.
Everyone knew, in this state, their dodge probabilities were extremely abnormal.
However, Cheng Jianyong waved the battleaxe in his hand, just so mundanely swung down an axe.
"Slash!"
Poof!
A torrent of Void Energy suddenly exploded.
This middle-tier demigod-level Void Beast was just so easily slain by Cheng Jianyong with one axe!
With such a huge attribute gap, these Void Beasts’ Body of Nothingness couldn’t even function.
This scene caused the other Void Beasts to be extremely fearful.
Because they clearly saw, this demigod Void Beast’s Body of Nothingness had already been triggered.
Yet it was still slain by Cheng Jianyong with one axe.
This was truly beyond their understanding.
Shen Yun praised, "Oh my, Xiaoyongzi can do it, having the strength to instantly kill a demigod."
Those Void Beasts also seemed to realize the threat of this human before them.
Thus, at least a dozen Void Beasts pounced towards Cheng Jianyong.
"Crash!"
Void Beasts surged from all directions, launching various ranged attacks.
Void Spear, Void Spike, Spear of Nothingness...
These attacks contained tremendous lethality.
However, no matter how bizarre their attack trajectories were, they were easily dodged by Cheng Jianyong.
This man wielding the giant axe effortlessly avoided the attacks of more than a dozen demigod-level Void Beasts with a fleeting body technique.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong comfortably arrived in front of those Void Beasts.
[Immortal Giant] swung lightly, yet each axe carried terrifying lethality.
"Poof! Poof poof poof!"
One Void Beast after another was slaughtered on the spot.
Their Body of Nothingness had no effect under Cheng Jianyong’s Holy Artifact Battleaxe.

[Successfully slew Void Beast Cecil: Middle-tier Demigod Level creature, gained Experience Value 172.43 billion, automatically absorbed the Divine Power Value from the opposer, Divine Power Value +300]

[Successfully slew Void Beast Mikhail: Initial-tier Demigod Level creature, gained Experience Value 67.244 billion, automatically absorbed the Divine Power Value from the opposer, Divine Power Value +100]
The Void Beasts besieging Cheng Jianyong fell one by one.
Having become the Supreme Hidden Profession [Barbaric War God], Cheng Jianyong had already reached an unbeaten level against those of the same tier.
