chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 477: The Void Royal Family Reveals Itself_3
paragraphs: Basic or Middle-tier demigods are not even a match for him.
Until two High-tier Demigod-level Void Beasts simultaneously blocked his path.
This finally caused Cheng Jianyong’s horrific killing speed to stall.
And at this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng’s attack followed closely.
She casually raised her magic staff.
In the void, hundreds of fireballs suddenly appeared.
They weren’t ordinary fireballs; these fireballs possessed the power of a forbidden curse level.
What’s even more terrifying is that these fireballs reached a diameter of tens of thousands of meters!
Everyone just felt waves of heat assaulting them.
The next moment, Zhang Lianmeng pointed her magic staff, and all these large fireballs were launched forward.
"Boom!!!"
Hundreds of mushroom clouds exploded, turning the entire void into a fiery red!
Tremendous heatwaves continued to sweep through, making the surrounding tens of thousands of miles of void seem half set aflame, radiating endless flames.
Cheng Jianyong, engaged in battle with the Void Beasts, looked surprisingly at the commotion over there.
"Damn... This power surge, could it just be Sister Lian Meng’s large fireball?"
"This is even more terrifying than a forbidden curse!"
Zhang Lianmeng, who became a supreme hidden profession, launched forbidden curse-level attacks with a mere gesture.
The group of Void Beasts was directly blown apart by her, with some even perishing on the spot.
However, before they could react.
A cloud of thunder with a scope reaching millions of meters suddenly appeared.
Then, tens of thousands of ice cones, each reaching tens of thousands of meters, and a green storm of the same diameter of millions of meters appeared.
These are several ordinary skills of the mage.
[Large Fireball], [Leiyun], [Ice Cone Technique], [Hurricane Technique]
But now, when used by Zhang Lianmeng, they became even more terrifying than four forbidden curses.
The region was directly bombarded by various elements in turn.
System prompts appeared continuously.
[Successfully killed Void Beast·Mikhail: Middle-tier Demigod-level creature, gained 124.724 billion experience value, divine power value automatically absorbed, divine power value +200]
[Successfully killed Void Beast·Amanniaz: High-tier Demigod-level creature, gained 233.426 billion experience value, divine power value automatically absorbed, divine power value +500]
[Successfully killed...]
More than a dozen Void Beasts were smashed to death by Zhang Lianmeng.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong and Zhang Lianmeng.
Displayed the formidable power of the supreme hidden profession without reservation!
Both of them are currently only Basic-tier demigods, yet they have the power to easily kill Initial-tier and Middle-tier Void Beasts.
Even Su Xiaoyang and Shen Yun at the back revealed looks of envy in their eyes.
Supreme hidden profession, truly strong!
In the void, black crystals could be seen everywhere, all of which were dropped by those demigod-level Void Beasts upon their death.
Han Xing casually picked up one.
[Void Crystal: A special energy crystal, consuming it randomly enhances 5000 points of four-dimensional attributes.]
(If consumed by Void Race creatures, directly increases 200,000 points of potential value.)
"Oh? It can directly increase so many potential values?"
Han Xing checked the attributes of Coal Ball.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Tier Five Legendary Level)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV60]
[Attributes: Power 50023, agility 59082, Spirit 52315, Constitution 54176]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 90 (Good)]
[Growth: SSS (Can enhance pet growth through potential value, next level: SSS+, required potential value: 10 million)]
[Current potential value: 7.726621 million]
[Skills]: Body of Nothingness, Counterattack Spike, Power of the Void, Void Flashes, Void Absorption, Void Frenzy, Dark Eternal Night (Domain Skill), Dark End, Escape into the Void!
Han Xing nodded, "Just over a million potential values short of enabling Coal Ball to achieve demigod advancement directly."
The advancement system of the Void Race differs from the strong beings of the Holy Spirit Realm and even other world creatures.
It requires not only reaching the potential value threshold.
But also the current level to reach full level.
Coal Ball had already reached level 60; now it only needs the potential value to reach 10 million to break through to become a demigod.
Thus, Han Xing collected all these [Void Crystals].
[Obtained Void Crystal (Demigod-level) *31...]
And as those demigod-level Void Beasts continued to perish.
The pressure from the God of Radiance’s side alleviated significantly.
Soon they surged again, fighting those three divine-level Void Beasts into a retreat.
"Buzz!"
Light Spear, Light Capturing Net, Rain of Light...
Various means were used by the God of Radiance.
If these three royal Void Beasts had not given up attacking, focusing instead on defense.
They might have been killed immediately by the God of Radiance.
And just then.
These three royal Void Beasts seemed to realize they were no match for this glowing guy in front of them.
They directly chose to escape into the void.
Upon seeing the three royal Void Beasts vanish again.
Han Xing also realized these Void Beasts might attempt to flee.
So Han Xing shouted directly: "Leave them!"
With those words, he drew the bowstring, and a crescent moon appeared.
And the gaze of the God of Radiance sharpened, with three radiant chains of tens of thousands of meters thick bursting from him again.
"Clang..."
The sound of dragging chains rang out.
Even though the Void Beasts hidden in the void masked themselves well, even erasing the marks of the God of Radiance.
Their whereabouts were still unveiled.
The radiant chains fiercely struck a particular spot,
"Bang! Bang bang!"
Those regions received special attention from the God of Radiance.
Moments later, the three royal Void Beasts were simultaneously forced out.
"Roar!"
Upon appearing, they discovered their bodies penetrated by enormous radiant chains, not only sealing their divine power values but preventing them from re-entering the void.
Then, the God of Radiance pointed a single finger to the sky.
Instantly, within a range of millions of miles, millions of light spears appeared.
The gaze of the God of Radiance sharpened, "Divine Light Feather, annihilate!"

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 478: Powerful Celestial Rail Strike Device
paragraphs: "Divine Light Feather, annihilate!"
As the words fell, all the light spears descended, indiscriminately striking all the void beasts below.
"Pfft! Pfft-pfft-pfft-pfft!!"
The sound of bodies being pierced incessantly emerged.
The void beasts below let out continuous wails.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed that one of the void royal species had already developed dense cracks on its body.
Han Xing was just about to step in and finish it off.
"Pfft!"
With a burst, the void royal species exploded into pieces on the spot, slain by the God of Light.
"Damn, missed the kill."
Han Xing said, somewhat resentfully.
His gaze focused on the remaining two void royal species.
One of them, resembling a qilin, had suddenly developed dense cracks on its body.
Han Xing decisively drew the bowstring back,
A terrifying surge of power of flame gathered.
Ultimate Skill—Sun-Destroying Arrow!
"Boom!"
The massive sun instantly exploded and directly devoured the void beast.
At this moment, Han Xing heard a system notification.
[Successfully killed void royal species·Orasio, gained 29.231 billion experience points, automatically absorbed opponent’s divine power value, divine power value +1000]
[Due to your outstanding performance, received additional rewards, legendary points +500]
Han Xing’s face lit up with joy, "Haha, I snagged this one!"
Not only that, aside from the rewards of divine power value and legendary points.
At the place where the void beast died, Han Xing also saw a massively colossal [Void Crystal].
However, the last remaining void royal species had somehow forcibly broken free from the divine power chain of the God of Radiance.
It directly escaped into the void, fleeing frantically.
Upon sensing the death of the two void royal species, it was immediately scared out of its wits and charged away without looking back.
Thus, the void beasts in this area were effectively cleared out by them.
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed to want to pursue further.
Yet Han Xing called him back, "Don’t chase, Radiance, let it run."
The figure of the God of Radiance halted, then used instant movement to return to the deck of the divine demon battleship.
Han Xing looked at him, nodded in satisfaction and said, "Radiance, you did well this time."
"True to being a top-tier divine spirit."
The God of Radiance chuckled, "As long as I didn’t shame my master."
Cheng Jianyong also walked over, looking at the God of Radiance, he said, "Old Guang, do you think that when I break through to divine spirit level, I’ll be a match for you?"
He seemed somewhat eager to try.
However, the God of Radiance smiled and said, "Young friend Cheng Jianyong, having awakened the heart of the fighting god, inherited that one’s power, and wielding the holy artifact battleaxe."
"You won’t need to wait to break through to divine spirit; reaching top demigod level will be sufficient to deal with me."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned upon hearing, "Am I that amazing?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, young friend Cheng Jianyong, the conditions you possess could be described as intrinsically advantageous."
"All three of these things, each one is uniquely rare among other formidable strong."
"If you manage to break through to divine spirit in the future, you could become among the top-tier existence among divine spirits."
"Even I won’t be a match for you."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong bashfully scratched his head and said, "Is that so, then that’s great, hahaha!"
Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "Look how smug you are, your mouth is about to reach your ears."
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "What’s wrong, are you jealous?"
"Jealous that I can slay divine spirits across tiers? Or jealous of my talent?"
Shen Yun said speechlessly, "I’m jealous of your thick skin."
Listening to their conversation, the team members have gotten used to it.
Then, Han Xing took out the two black crystals the size of heads.
These were dropped from the two slain void royal species.
[Void Royal Crystal: Consuming it can increase divine power value by 10,000 points.]
(If consumed by a void royal species, it can increase potential value by one million points, with a chance to additionally increase four-dimensional attributes by 50,000 points.)
Seeing the attributes of this crystal, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Oh? The crystal from the void royal species can enhance divine power?"
This was another unexpected delight!
The crystals from those demigod-level void beasts only increased four-dimensional attributes.
Although the divine power obtained from killing other divine spirits is still less,
This undoubtedly provides Han Xing with another means of boosting divine power value.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball was circling around Han Xing, constantly rubbing against him, its gaze intermittently lingering on the void royal crystal in Han Xing’s hand, appearing very eager.
Han Xing knew.
Coal Ball was just a step away from becoming a demigod, and if it consumed these [Void Crystals], it could transform towards demigod level.
Moreover, Coal Ball also possessed the bloodline of a void royal species, consuming these [Void Crystals] would grant additional attribute enhancement effects.
Thus, even though this void royal crystal greatly benefits Han Xing.
Han Xing still felt that he should first allow Coal Ball to break through to demigod level.
He laughed and said, "Little Coal Ball, wait a moment."
"The celestial rail strike device is almost completed, just a few more minutes,"
"After a few minutes, I’ll feed you these."
Coal Ball excitedly spun in circles, gasping in excitement, nodding repeatedly.
"Ha~ Ha~"
Han Xing patted its head, then turned his gaze to the progress bar in front of him.
[Celestial Rail Strike Device Remaining Construction Time: 2 minutes 32 seconds...]
At this moment, everyone turned their gaze over.
With the void beasts already repelled,
It seemed that there were no more creatures or situations here to interfere with Han Xing and the others.

sentences.text: "Divine Light Feather, annihilate!"
As the words fell, all the light spears descended, indiscriminately striking all the void beasts below.
"Pfft!
Pfft-pfft-pfft-pfft!!"
The sound of bodies being pierced incessantly emerged.
The void beasts below let out continuous wails.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed that one of the void royal species had already developed dense cracks on its body.
Han Xing was just about to step in and finish it off.
"Pfft!"
With a burst, the void royal species exploded into pieces on the spot, slain by the God of Light.
"Damn, missed the kill."
Han Xing said, somewhat resentfully.
His gaze focused on the remaining two void royal species.
One of them, resembling a qilin, had suddenly developed dense cracks on its body.
Han Xing decisively drew the bowstring back,
A terrifying surge of power of flame gathered.
Ultimate Skill—Sun-Destroying Arrow!
"Boom!"
The massive sun instantly exploded and directly devoured the void beast.
At this moment, Han Xing heard a system notification.
[Successfully killed void royal species·Orasio, gained 29.231 billion experience points, automatically absorbed opponent’s divine power value, divine power value +1000]
[Due to your outstanding performance, received additional rewards, legendary points +500]
Han Xing’s face lit up with joy, "Haha, I snagged this one!"
Not only that, aside from the rewards of divine power value and legendary points.
At the place where the void beast died, Han Xing also saw a massively colossal [Void Crystal].
However, the last remaining void royal species had somehow forcibly broken free from the divine power chain of the God of Radiance.
It directly escaped into the void, fleeing frantically.
Upon sensing the death of the two void royal species, it was immediately scared out of its wits and charged away without looking back.
Thus, the void beasts in this area were effectively cleared out by them.
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed to want to pursue further.
Yet Han Xing called him back, "Don’t chase, Radiance, let it run."
The figure of the God of Radiance halted, then used instant movement to return to the deck of the divine demon battleship.
Han Xing looked at him, nodded in satisfaction and said, "Radiance, you did well this time."
"True to being a top-tier divine spirit."
The God of Radiance chuckled, "As long as I didn’t shame my master."
Cheng Jianyong also walked over, looking at the God of Radiance, he said, "Old Guang, do you think that when I break through to divine spirit level, I’ll be a match for you?"
He seemed somewhat eager to try.
However, the God of Radiance smiled and said, "Young friend Cheng Jianyong, having awakened the heart of the fighting god, inherited that one’s power, and wielding the holy artifact battleaxe."
"You won’t need to wait to break through to divine spirit; reaching top demigod level will be sufficient to deal with me."
Cheng Jianyong was stunned upon hearing, "Am I that amazing?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, young friend Cheng Jianyong, the conditions you possess could be described as intrinsically advantageous."
"All three of these things, each one is uniquely rare among other formidable strong."
"If you manage to break through to divine spirit in the future, you could become among the top-tier existence among divine spirits."
"Even I won’t be a match for you."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong bashfully scratched his head and said, "Is that so, then that’s great, hahaha!"
Shen Yun glanced at him and said, "Look how smug you are, your mouth is about to reach your ears."
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "What’s wrong, are you jealous?"
"Jealous that I can slay divine spirits across tiers?
Or jealous of my talent?"
Shen Yun said speechlessly, "I’m jealous of your thick skin."
Listening to their conversation, the team members have gotten used to it.
Then, Han Xing took out the two black crystals the size of heads.
These were dropped from the two slain void royal species.
[Void Royal Crystal: Consuming it can increase divine power value by 10,000 points.]
(If consumed by a void royal species, it can increase potential value by one million points, with a chance to additionally increase four-dimensional attributes by 50,000 points.)
Seeing the attributes of this crystal, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
"Oh?
The crystal from the void royal species can enhance divine power?"
This was another unexpected delight!
The crystals from those demigod-level void beasts only increased four-dimensional attributes.
Although the divine power obtained from killing other divine spirits is still less,
This undoubtedly provides Han Xing with another means of boosting divine power value.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball was circling around Han Xing, constantly rubbing against him, its gaze intermittently lingering on the void royal crystal in Han Xing’s hand, appearing very eager.
Han Xing knew.
Coal Ball was just a step away from becoming a demigod, and if it consumed these [Void Crystals], it could transform towards demigod level.
Moreover, Coal Ball also possessed the bloodline of a void royal species, consuming these [Void Crystals] would grant additional attribute enhancement effects.
Thus, even though this void royal crystal greatly benefits Han Xing.
Han Xing still felt that he should first allow Coal Ball to break through to demigod level.
He laughed and said, "Little Coal Ball, wait a moment."
"The celestial rail strike device is almost completed, just a few more minutes,"
"After a few minutes, I’ll feed you these."
Coal Ball excitedly spun in circles, gasping in excitement, nodding repeatedly.
"Ha~ Ha~"
Han Xing patted its head, then turned his gaze to the progress bar in front of him.
[Celestial Rail Strike Device Remaining Construction Time: 2 minutes 32 seconds...]
At this moment, everyone turned their gaze over.
With the void beasts already repelled,
It seemed that there were no more creatures or situations here to interfere with Han Xing and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 478: Powerful Celestial Rail Strike Device_2
paragraphs: [Remaining time: 1 minute and 59 seconds...]
[Remaining time: 1 minute and 30 seconds...]
Time slowly passed by.
Soon, it reached the final 10 seconds of the countdown.
At the same time, the energy vortex gradually dissipated.
It seemed as though this device had absorbed enough energy halfway.
At this moment, the countdown reached zero.
The system prompt appeared.
[Congratulations! Celestial Rail Strike Device: Construction successful.]
"Buzz!!!"
The bow section of the ship immediately shone brightly!
The instant burst of light even surpassed the God of Radiance, directly illuminating the nearby void of millions of kilometers as if it were daylight!
Within this light, everyone also felt a sense of deadly crisis!
"What a terrifying power!" the God of Radiance exclaimed.
When the light gradually dissipated.
In front of Han Xing appeared a gigantic device with a transparent crystal-like luster.
This device had a crystal base below, and above it, a spherical, donut-like object was suspended.
One could even see starry sky patterns on it.
Everyone was frozen on the spot.
"Oh my... so beautiful..."
"Is this the Celestial Rail Strike Device? Why does it look like a crystal ball?"
At this time, Han Xing couldn’t wait to check the attributes of this thing.

[Special Device·Celestial Rail Strike Device: Concentrates a ray of destruction, causing devastating damage to enemies along a path of 1 million kilometers. Enemies hit will be sealed: Divine Power/Power of Rules/Power of the Demon/Power of the Void, all Divine-level abilities, effect lasts for 1~10 seconds]
[Attack Power: 50 million]
[Maximum Attack Range: 1 million kilometers]
[Defense Value: 5 million]
[Attack Interval: 120 seconds/each]
After reviewing the attributes of this thing, everyone was plunged into a strong shock.
"Oh my... 50 million Attack Power, almost 50 times the Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon! With the boost from the Sun Crown Stele, isn’t that 1.5 billion Attack Power?"
"My god! That’s too terrifying!"
Cheng Jianyong was aghast: "What’s even more terrifying is the strike range of a full 1 million kilometers! With the boost from the stele, that’s 3 million kilometers!"
"Even a True God can’t instantly traverse three million kilometers, right?"
Shen Yun said, "This thing is probably designed for dealing with Divine Spirits and entities above them."
"Sealing Divine Power and Power of Rules means those Divine Spirits cannot merge into the rules to escape."
"One shot, even if a True God survives, it can be paired with other defense towers to finish it off in one go!"
After hearing Shen Yun’s words, everyone realized just how terrifying the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] was.
It’s nearly a terrifying Divine Artifact encompassing damage, long-range strikes, and sealing all in one!
At this time, Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance and said with interest, "Radiance, want to try and test the power of this thing with me?"
The corner of the God of Radiance’s mouth twitched, and he quickly waved his hand, "No, no."
"Master, this device gives me a sense of deadly crisis that I can’t withstand..."
The God of Radiance, although not understanding what they meant by over a billion Attack Power.
But from the commotion of constructing this device, he could tell it was extremely terrifying.
Han Xing smiled and said no more
Then, he went to Coal Ball’s side and first fed it more than ten Demigod-level [Void Crystals].
Building its Potential Value up to 9 million.
Then, Han Xing took out a [Void Royal Crystal].
Under Coal Ball’s extremely eager gaze, he tossed the crystal over.
Coal Ball swallowed it in one gulp.
This seemed to be an extremely delicious thing for it.
It devoured it ravenously.
At the same time, its fur became visibly more glossy.
A system prompt appeared.
[Detected that your pet ’Coal Ball’ has met the conditions to breakthrough to the Demigod, proceed to breakthrough?]
This required no consideration, Han Xing directly clicked yes.
The next moment.
Coal Ball’s body suddenly paused in place.
It seemed to realize that it was about to undergo an extremely terrifying transformation.
So, Coal Ball voluntarily flew into the void.
At the same time, Coal Ball closed its eyes.
The nearby void, whose storm had finally settled, was once again swept up.
Whoosh—whoosh—
Void Energy formed a small vortex, all converging into Coal Ball’s body.
And then absorbed by it.
Although it wasn’t as terrifying as when constructing the Celestial Rail Strike Device, it affected an area of tens of thousands of kilometers.
At the same time, everyone felt that Coal Ball’s aura was rapidly escalating.
From the original top-tier Legendary Level, it instantly broke through the Legendary Limit.
And it was still continuously rising.
"Buzz!"
Countless Void Energy was being absorbed by it.
At this moment, it seemed to suddenly break through some critical point, and a wondrous change occurred in its whole body.
Coal Ball’s aura immediately disappeared from its original location.
No matter how many times everyone used Divine Power to probe, they couldn’t find any trace.
This situation was exactly like when those Void Beasts appeared.
Moreover, Coal Ball’s ability to conceal was obviously stronger than other Demigod-level Void Beasts.
Even the God of Radiance praised from the side, "Master, this Void Beast pet of yours is something different."
"It not only has the bloodline of the Void Royal Family, but I also sense a hint of the Beast of Calamity in it."
Hearing this, Han Xing was pensive.
Because he remembered that when Coal Ball was at Tier Four, Han Xing fed it quite a bit of Divine Blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 478: Powerful Celestial Rail Strike Device_3
paragraphs: And that blood comes from the Beast of Calamity.
Presumably, the blood of these Beasts of Calamity had some kind of influence on it.
At this moment, the storm in the void abruptly stopped.
A strong, threatening aura flashed by and quickly vanished into nothingness.
As if it had never happened.
At the same time, a system notification appeared.
[Your pet ’Coal Ball’ has completed its demigod advancement, current Level: SSS+]
[All Attributes increased by 200%.]
[Successfully activated new Skills: Ultimate Skill——Void Vortex, Ultimate Skill——Shield of Nothingness]
Seeing this notification, Han Xing felt a surge of joy in his heart.
At the same time, a black figure suddenly appeared.
A body nearly twenty meters long, exuding a fierce yet somewhat regal aura!
At this moment, Coal Ball stood on the deck of the battleship, howling madly to the sky.
"Roar!!!"
The terrifying sound wave spread as if it were material.
At this moment, it actually possessed the majesty of a middle-tier demigod level!
Just breaking through had already given it such majesty, which was quite impressive!
Han Xing felt a rush of happiness in his heart, "Good, good, a 200% attribute bonus is just slightly inferior to Cheng Jianyong and the others! Truly worthy of the Void Royal Family."
"And there’s also the two Ultimate Skills."
Han Xing opened Coal Ball’s panel to check these two Skills’ introduction.

[Ultimate Skill——Void Vortex: Centered around oneself, it attracts the endless power of the void, forming a vortex with suction power. All enemies within the vortex area will be bound and pulled, and then receive 5500% Attack Power as true damage.]

[Ultimate Skill——Shield of Nothingness (Passive Skill): The Void Royal Family automatically absorbs the power of the void, forming an energy shield on its body. The Defense Value of this shield is equal to the life force of the Void Royal Family, and it can withstand one fatal attack (ineffective against True God-level attacks).]
Seeing these two Skills’ introduction, Han Xing was filled with astonishment!
"Hiss! So strong!"
The first skill, [Void Vortex], naturally needs no further explanation.
As a skill that combines control and crowd gathering, it can truly be called a divine skill.
The most critical point is that it deals 5500% true damage!
Note that it’s true damage!
With such an outburst, it’s feared that below the Divine Spirit level, hardly any demigods can withstand it.
As for the second skill, [Shield of Nothingness], it is also a very powerful registration skill.
Not only does it have an extremely high Defense Shield, but it can also withstand one fatal attack.
This is almost akin to having an extra life!
Even those Divine-level Void Beasts don’t have as overpowered a skill as the Shield of Nothingness.
Otherwise, even the God of Light would find it difficult to kill these Divine-level Void Beasts.
And this has once again elevated the life-saving capability of the already troublesome Coal Ball by several levels.
"Little Coal Ball looks so majestic," Zhang Lianmeng praised.
This time, upon breaking through, Coal Ball did not enter a sleeping state.
Instead, its body expanded again to 20 meters, emanating an extremely terrifying aura.
And when it escaped into the void, this aura disappeared in an instant, as if it had never appeared.
Everyone was overjoyed, as they gained an additional demigod-level companion.
Han Xing saw the attribute of ’Coal Ball’ appear before him.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Tier Six Demigod Level)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV60]
[Attributes: Power 160069, Agility 197246, Spirit 166945, Constitution 172528]
[Affinity: 100]
[Satiety: 90 (Good)]
[Growth: SSS+ (Can increase pet growth through Potential Value, next Level: Z-level, required Potential Value: 1 billion)]
[Current Potential Value: 68923]

[Skills]: Body of Nothingness, Counterattack Spike, Power of the Void, Void Flashes, Void Absorption, Void Frenzy, Dark Eternal Night (Domain Skill), Dark End, Escape into the Void, Ultimate Skill——Void Vortex, Ultimate Skill——Shield of Nothingness.
"Truly strong," Han Xing praised.
Just after breaking through, Coal Ball already possessed attributes comparable to a middle-tier demigod.
In terms of actual combat power, it was even stronger than an average middle-tier demigod.
In terms of life-saving capabilities, it surpassed even some high-tier demigods.
It’s imaginable that once Coal Ball breaks through to the divine level, it will become tremendously powerful.
However, breaking through to the divine level is a bit challenging.
He actually needs 1 billion Potential Value.
Even if absorbing the [Void Royal Crystal], he needs to absorb one hundred of them.
In other words, Han Xing would have to take down a hundred Divine-level Void Beasts, or 50,000 demigod-level Void Beasts.
It could be called quite outrageous.
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t think about raising Coal Ball to the divine level in the short term.
"Brother Xing, what’s the next destination?" Shen Yun asked beside him.
Han Xing pondered for a moment, looking around.
Now, the [Celestial Rail Strike Device] has been completed, Coal Ball has evolved to a demigod.
It is equivalent to everything being ready.
And Han Xing, too, was sufficiently prepared.
So, he looked at his team members and said, "Get ready to set off, next stop, Land of Divine War!"
The team members glanced at each other, their faces also lighting up with joy.
Because they knew.
The next step is to let Han Xing also begin his transformation into a demigod.
At the same time, they all secretly made up their minds.
No matter what, they had to make Han Xing the third person, after the Hunter and the Demon Emperor, to break the rules.
Han Xing directly clicked on the [Teleportation] function, and the battleship’s voice broadcast appeared.
"Entering teleportation state, countdown five seconds..."
"Countdown one second..."
After the familiar voice prompt, the Divine Demon Battleship’s figure flashed and directly disappeared from its original place.
Seven days later.
In the void, a battleship maintained a flashing frequency, advancing continuously.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 479: Arrival at the Land of Divine War
paragraphs: On the way, Han Xing took out the Arrow that the Hunter had.
In the vast emptiness, this Arrow guided him to the unknown regions deep in the Void.
After sensing for a moment, Han Xing opened his eyes.
"It’s about ten days away from the Land of Divine War."
Everyone nodded.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at the God of Radiance beside him and asked, "Radiance, do you know what kind of place the Land of Divine War is?"
The God of Radiance pondered for a moment, then nodded, "I didn’t participate in that battle, but I have some understanding of the situation at the time."
"That battle was really terrifying, it even caused the whole Void to start shaking."
"Even though I was extremely far from the battlefield, I felt a terrible aura sweeping over me from above, with even a vague sense of imminent fall."
Fear showed on the face of the God of Radiance.
It should be known that he was also at the Divine Level back then.
Even from billions of kilometers away, he could feel the danger of falling, which suggests how terrifying the battle was at that time.
The God of Radiance continued, "That battle lasted for a long time."
"All I know is that strong individuals kept joining the battle and besieging the Hunter."
"The Beast of Calamity forced into the Void, those Evil Gods of the Alternate Space, the divine beings from the Forbidden Land, and various Divine-level Void Beasts hidden in the Void."
"Even I felt the Power of Rules urging me to go and fight."
Everyone exchanged a glance.
They seemed to learn some more details about that battle in those years.
There wasn’t a single simple being among those mentioned by the God of Radiance.
Yet so many terrifying creatures all went to besiege just the Hunter.
It can be imagined how many terrifying foes the Hunter faced alone at that time.
Han Xing asked puzzledly, "Even the Evil Gods of the Alternate Space and Void Beasts participated?
"Why?"
The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "Master, I don’t know about this."
"At that time, I only thought about saving my life and had no intent to participate in the war."
"On that day, I sensed the continuous breaking of the Power of Rules."
"Signs of the fall of various terrifying beings kept appearing."
"Those beings, each one was hundreds, thousands of times stronger than me, but they kept dying!"
"At that moment, I didn’t dare go outside, I hid until the battle was over before I dared to come out again."
After hearing this, everyone vaguely knew about the ferocity of that battle.
The God of Radiance continued, "Until many days later, the commotion of divine beings falling began to gradually stop."
"Then, it’s the sense of a death crisis sweeping over me that I mentioned before."
"That moment, I really thought I was going to die."
"But fortunately, that aura did not strike me."
Han Xing nodded, "What happened afterwards?"
The God of Radiance replied, "Later, I used some of my own means to inquire about the news of that battle."
"I don’t know the specifics, I only know that in the end, the Hunter lost."
"However, he didn’t lose that thoroughly, but left a measure that trapped all the strong ones from that battle."
Han Xing asked puzzledly, "A measure?"
The God of Radiance nodded.
"Yes."
"It is said that before the Hunter’s impending death, he shot an Arrow."
"That Arrow was extremely terrifying, carrying boundless terrifying aura, no being in the entire Void dared to bear that Arrow."
"Despite the effort of those strong individuals from the past who joined the war, they barely resisted the Hunter’s first wave of power."
"Later, that Arrow turned into a Galaxy in place, remaining there for tens of thousands of years.
Han Xing frowned again, "Galaxy?"
"Exactly."
"Within this Galaxy, it carries extremely terrifying Power of Destruction and Sealing Power."
"All terrifying beings who participated in the battle back then were sealed within that Galaxy."
"And the most crucial part is, the position of that Galaxy stands at the junction of the Forbidden Land and the Void."
"This led to, as long as that Star River exists for a day, those terrifying creatures from the Forbidden Land cannot come through the Void into the Holy Spirit Realm."
"Later, we called this Galaxy the Forbidden Galaxy."
Han Xing asked puzzledly, "You mean, within that Galaxy, there are many terrifying beings sealed, and it also blocked many divine beings from the Forbidden Land?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes."
Han Xing fell silent for a moment after listening.
Previously, the God of Radiance had mentioned the Forbidden Land.
But due to some restriction of rules, he couldn’t speak explicitly about it.
In this way, Han Xing’s enemy should be within the Forbidden Land.
It turns out that although the Hunter was defeated in the last battle, he didn’t do nothing.
He left behind a Forbidden Galaxy, buying the Holy Spirit Realm tens of thousands of years of time.
At this time, the God of Radiance added, "Because too many divine beings, True Gods died at that time, that Galaxy contained a large number of Rule Fragments, and complete rules."
"Every so often, as the Void Tide bursts, some precious treasures are sprayed out."
"In the Void, many existences or forces learned about the situation in the Land of Divine War, so they all began to station near the Forbidden Celestial Abyss."
"Over time, that place gathered a large number of strong individuals."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, understood and nodded.
Within that Forbidden Galaxy, occasionally Rule Fragments, or Divine Formats, would erupt.
And this, should be the opportunity that the Old Tree mentioned.
And Han Xing’s goal is to collect a large number of Divine Formats and complete rules.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 479: Arrival at the Land of Divine War (2)
paragraphs: It seems that this time he will encounter quite a few opponents in the Land of Divine War.
The God of Radiance continued, "However, that is news I learned several thousand years ago."
"Since I was hunted by the God of Light and hid within the body of the Beast, I have been unaware of the outside situation."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this, "It’s okay, we’re about to find out soon anyway."
"Once there, we’ll know what the situation is."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
The conversation with the God of Radiance indeed gave them insight into the current state of the Land of Divine War.
Meanwhile, the Divine Demon Battleship entered teleportation mode once more.
"Buzz!!"
The space in the Void began to ripple violently.
The warship entered teleportation mode.
In an instant, they traveled over ten million kilometers.
Then, continued sustaining teleportation mode.
Time flashed by, and ten days passed.
From a vast distance, Han Xing and the others saw a sparkling Star River stretching across the Void.
Without needing to look closer, they knew it was the ultimate strike that Hunter unleashed at the last moment.
It was then Han Xing realized just how enormous and magnificent that sparkling galaxy was.
With each teleportation, they drew closer to that dazzling galaxy.
Boundless might rushed towards them in waves.
The closer they got, the more Han Xing felt insignificant before the sparkling galaxy.
Their Divine Demon Battleship seemed as inconspicuous as a grain of sand in the ocean.
As everyone fully neared,
"How beautiful..." they couldn’t help but murmur.
Indeed, this galaxy was filled with a dangerous aura, yet it flickered in the Void.
It truly resembled a luminous galaxy in the universe.
Shen Yun remarked, "It’s truly unimaginable that such a terrifying thing could be an attack unleashed by a being."
"I’m afraid that even True Gods facing such a level of attack would have no ability to resist.
The God of Radiance watched from the side.
Upon hearing Shen Yun’s comment, he nodded and said, "Disciple, what you said is indeed correct."
"Even True Gods would be doomed if they came close to that galaxy, let alone directly confront it."
Shen Yun rolled his eyes at him.
Though he disliked being called disciple by the God of Radiance, he couldn’t refute it.
At this point, the God of Radiance said with some amazement, "I now strongly suspect that during that war, all participating Divine Spirits and True Gods were killed by Hunter alone."
"If so, that would be too terrifying!"
"And the rule fragments contained within this galaxy will reach an immense number."
Everyone nodded.
Before long, they entered a region still nearly fifty million kilometers away from the galaxy.
From afar, Han Xing saw some floating objects around.
Various fragments of Sky Islands, pieces of small worlds, and some massive monster carcass fragments drifting through the Void.
"Wow...so many fragments," Cheng Jianyong said to Han Xing, "Brother Xing, should we go to those fragments and have a search?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment, then shook his head, "Better not, I sensed that there’s nothing of value on those fragments."
"They’re just basic stones, not a single vein of gold can be seen."
"Even the monster corpses have completely decayed."
After hearing this, everyone nodded as well.
While feeling somewhat regretful inside.
The Divine Demon Battleship continued advancing along this boundless galaxy.
Against the current.
And at that moment, from within the galaxy, an exceptionally strong energy fluctuation suddenly emerged.
The energy fluctuation grew more intense, as if a vortex appeared in the ocean.
"Boom! Boom-boom!"
The surface of the Forbidden Galaxy kept vibrating.
The next moment, everyone suddenly noticed a giant mass of something erupting from that vortex.
Even before it appeared, it radiated an extremely terrifying feeling.
Han Xing and others focused their eyes and discovered the thing was gray all over, covered with scales and had a long tail.
Shen Yun asked with a puzzled expression, "Brother Xing, doesn’t this thing seem a bit familiar to you?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and nodded.
However, due to some discrepancy with his memory, Han Xing couldn’t recall it at the moment.
At this time, the God of Radiance said, "That is a fragment of the Beast’s corpse."
After hearing it, everyone raised their heads simultaneously.
Then they compared it to the memory of the Beast’s corpse.
And they suddenly nodded in realization.
"So that’s it."
The God of Radiance was right; it’s indeed a fragment of the Beast’s corpse.
However, only half remained.
It appeared to be more like the tail end of the Beast.
"Terrifying, a Beast like this, a Calamity Beast, has its entire body refined to be as sturdy as a Divine Artifact."
"Even a single scale could be used as Divine Artifact-level material, yet it was still forcibly sliced in half!"
Shen Yun marvelled.
Everyone nodded together.
One could imagine that the being who slew this Calamity Beast must have had combat power far beyond the True God Level.
At this moment, Han Xing glanced downward.
He noticed a faint bright light emerging from the tail of the Beast.
However, contrary to the entire Calamity Beast they had found earlier,
This Calamity Beast’s tail was hanging down.
Limp and powerless, which was why at first, no one recognized it.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Brother Xing, the Beast’s Tail Spike seems to still be there; should we retrieve it?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded, with a hint of joy on his face, "Of course we should retrieve it, considering my Giant Beast Tail Spike can only be used once more."

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 479: Arrival at the Land of Divine War (3)
paragraphs: Just as everyone was about to approach that half-body.
In the void, a massive black Sky Island suddenly appeared.
All the buildings on this Sky Island, including the ground, were black.
And standing on it were several creatures resembling giant crocodiles.
They directly maneuvered the Sky Island, blocking the Divine Demon Battleship.
Meanwhile, on that black Sky Island, a dozen black turrets suddenly adjusted their attack positions, aiming at Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
Everyone frowned.
Cheng Jianyong remarked, "What the hell are those things?"
"Do they want to start a war with us as soon as they came up?"
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Let’s wait and see."
At the same time, those crocodile-like creatures were babbling something.
After system translation, Han Xing and the others understood the words of these creatures.
"Get lost! We, the Blade Armor Demon Race, discovered this first!"
Han Xing and the others exchanged glances.
"What on earth is a Blade Armor Demon? Is there such a race in the Holy Spirit Realm?" Cheng Jianyong wondered.
None of the others had heard of the Blade Armor Demon Race either.
The God of Radiance explained, "These creatures, although they have demigod-level strength, their aura is somewhat similar to beings born in other small worlds."
Everyone nodded in realization.
"Oh, so these are creatures from other worlds? They truly look hideous!" Cheng Jianyong remarked.
Han Xing looked at the Blade Armor Demons, displaying the attributes of these advisors before him.
[Unknown World Creature · Blade Armor Demon]
[Level: Level 70 (High-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 418415, agility 452723, Spirit 473162, Constitution 492315]
[Skills: Scale Armor (Extra 40,000 Armor), Scale Tornado (Instantly triggers all body scales, dealing indiscriminate damage to enemies within 100,000 kilometers, each scale deals 33% Attack Power)
Creel Bite (Bites the enemy, suppresses 100,000 points of agility and Power, and inflicts 20 layers of bleeding effect on them)
High-level Life Domain (Possesses powerful life aura, forming a high-level Life Domain, Constitution increases by additional 80,000 points)

Ultimate Skill—Heaven-Breaking (Muster all body Power, perform a death spin, Charge forward, deal 50 segments * 120% damage to enemies within 100,000 kilometers and attach 100 layers of bleeding effect)]
[Divine Power Value: 84315]
Besides this Blade Armor Demon, the other Blade Armor Demons had Middle-tier Demigod strength or above.
No wonder these creatures dared to be so rampant.
However, to Han Xing and the others.
Demigod-level strength was already inadequate in their eyes.
Cheng Jianyong directly used the broadcast to say, "Is it yours just because you said you discovered it first?"
"I could also say we found it first!"
The voice, transmitted through Divine Power, started to automatically convey Cheng Jianyong’s intentions.
These Blade Armor Demons listened, exchanging glances.
Upon understanding the implication in Cheng Jianyong’s words.
One Blade Armor Demon with only one eye stepped forward and said, "A few little fellows, it seems like it’s your first time here in the Land of Divine War. You don’t know the rules here."
Cheng Jianyong immediately chuckled, "Rules? What kind of rules do you have here? Tell me."
This Blade Armor Demon showed a cruel smile at the corner of its mouth, "The rule is if two factions’ strong keep their eyes on a treasure simultaneously."
"Then the weaker must yield the treasure."
Cheng Jianyong heard and continued chuckling, "So your meaning is we’re the weaklings then?"
The Blade Armor Demon nodded, "Aren’t you?"
"On your side, there are only two demigod-level auras, accompanied by a few legendary ants."
"Whereas we have a total of six demigods."
"I advise you to be sensible."
"Otherwise, I’ll show you the consequences of provoking the Blade Armor Demon Race!"
Cheng Jianyong glanced at Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded, signaling for him to continue.
Cheng Jianyong instantly felt even more confident.
He laughed, "Really? I truly want to see what the consequences are of provoking the Blade Armor Demon Race.
Meanwhile, the group of Blade Armor Demons exchanged glances and showed a peculiar smile.
One of the demigod-level Blade Armor Demons laughed, "Fine, as you wish then."
As it finished speaking, they directly controlled several black turrets on the Sky Island, starting to prepare for attack.
"Buzz!"
These black turrets began to emit gloomy light.
Continuously compressing by absorbing Void Energy.
Han Xing noticed that those fifteen black turrets had demigod-level power at this moment.
"Interesting, defense towers at the same level as the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon?"
"The difference is they absorb Void Energy, which is too mixed, resulting in slower activation."
"Somewhat of a hassle."
Thinking this, Han Xing simply abandoned any intention of researching these black turrets.
Now, the Blade Armor Demons on the Sky Island, seeing the energy accumulation was completed.
One Blade Armor Demon waved its hand.
Those dozen black turrets simultaneously fired a gigantic shell with a diameter exceeding 1,000 meters!
"Boom! Boom!"
With so many black turrets activated simultaneously, the black Sky Island trembled!
Seeing the opponent attack without hesitation and seemingly aiming to destroy them.
Han Xing did not hold back.
He directly manipulated a hundred [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons] to initiate counterattacks instantly.
Thanks to the addition of the two Sun Crown Steles.
The energy accumulation time for the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon was drastically reduced to an extremely terrifying level.
Almost in an instant, it completed preparation for charging.
"Buzz!"
Over a hundred energy beams burst simultaneously, colliding with the opponent’s black shells.
In just a moment, those black shells dissolved like ice and snow.
Below, the Blade Armor Demons seeing this scene immediately showed a gaze of shock.

Now, the Blade Armor Demons on the Sky Island, seeing the energy accumulation was completed.
One Blade Armor Demon waved its hand.
Those dozen black turrets simultaneously fired a gigantic shell with a diameter exceeding 1,000 meters!
"Boom!
Boom!"
With so many black turrets activated simultaneously, the black Sky Island trembled!
Seeing the opponent attack without hesitation and seemingly aiming to destroy them.
Han Xing did not hold back.
He directly manipulated a hundred [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons] to initiate counterattacks instantly.
Thanks to the addition of the two Sun Crown Steles.
The energy accumulation time for the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon was drastically reduced to an extremely terrifying level.
Almost in an instant, it completed preparation for charging.
"Buzz!"
Over a hundred energy beams burst simultaneously, colliding with the opponent’s black shells.
In just a moment, those black shells dissolved like ice and snow.
Below, the Blade Armor Demons seeing this scene immediately showed a gaze of shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 480: The Second Calamity Beast Tail Spike
paragraphs: "What?!"
The group of Blade Armor Demons exclaimed in horror: "Our Void Thermal Energy Cannon can’t compete with their Energy Cannon!"
"How is this possible?"
However, before the shock in their pupils could dissipate, the energy attack from the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon neutralized dozens of black cannonballs but did not lose its momentum.
With a terrifying might, it directly blasted towards the Sky Island.
In an instant, a look of panic appeared in the eyes of the group of Blade Armor Demons!
"Damn it! Their attack is coming!"
"Run! Run!"
But obviously, their escape speed couldn’t match the attack speed of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
The next moment, hundreds of destruction beams already arrived.
And directly landed on this black Sky Island.
"Boom!!!"
A vast white curtain of light rose, instantly enveloping most of the Sky Island.
The strong energy fluctuations even made this group of Blade Armor Demons unable to open their eyes!
When the curtain of destruction was about to swallow them as well.
Those few demigod-level Blade Armor Demons seemed to realize something.
They exclaimed: "Escape! Quickly escape!"
"Use the Heaven-Breaking Combat Skill to flee!"
With that, all the Blade Armor Demons instantly began to spin rapidly, like an accelerating drill, and instantly shot out tens of thousands of meters.
And they paid no heed to the scene behind them.
Their one and only thought was to escape for their lives.
After the curtain of light dissipated.
The black Sky Island was completely destroyed, not leaving even a single fragment.
This is the power of a hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled at this moment: "These guys, their escape speed is quite fast."
"Brother Xing, shall I go after them?"
Han Xing laughed: "No need, let’s first get the Beast’s Tail Spike."
Watching the fleeing figures of those Blade Armor Demons.
Han Xing laughed: "This Land of Divine War is indeed very interesting."
"Even creatures from other worlds have emerged.
"It seems this place really attracts many strong beings to gather."
Just as the God of Radiance said.
After thousands of years, more and more strong beings have been drawn to this place.
Shaking his head, Han Xing didn’t pay it much mind.
At this moment, his full attention was on the Beast’s corpse.
"Now, let’s extract the Beast’s Tail Spike."
With this thought, Han Xing directly controlled over two hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons for a concentrated attack.
Last time, when extracting the Tail Spike, Han Xing also used this method.
Buzz!
Two hundred beams of energy merged into one, forming a terrifying attack.
The base area of the Beast’s Tail Spike was immediately enveloped by a mass of destructive light!
Such a level of attack could even severely injure a Divine Spirit!
However, should it be said the Beast truly deserves to be a True God-level existence?
Even though only half its body remained, and despite the many years that had passed.
After a surge of activation attacks.
Not even a crack appeared on the massive Tail Spike.
"Oh come on... so outrageous?" Cheng Jianyong said incredulously.
Han Xing nodded: "Last time we were lucky. When we discovered the Tail Spike, there was already a crack."
"This time, we’re not so lucky."
"So now, we can only rely on our own means to break this Tail Spike."
Cheng Jianyong nodded.
However, although this time they encountered a Giant Beast Tail Spike with no cracks.
But Han Xing and their Attack Power have already changed significantly since before.
The next moment, Han Xing mobilized 200 Tower of Annihilation Lightning, working with the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, to attack the same spot.
Buzz!
The entire Divine Demon Battleship, with over four hundred terrifying Defense Towers, absorbed energy at the same time.
This Void fell into a state of unrest.
Boom!
The next moment, the region at the Beast’s tail was enveloped by a mass of terrifying thunder and energy beams!
Such a level of attack is enough to instantly kill a Divine Spirit.
Yet, landing on the Beast’s Tail Spike, the surface remained smooth.
Not a single scar appeared.
Han Xing once again experienced the terror of a True God-level existence.
But he wasn’t discouraged.
His third attack had already launched.
"Crack!"
After a terrifying explosion sound.
Han Xing saw that a crack finally appeared on the Beast’s Tail Spike.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly: "It worked!"
Everyone’s faces lit up with joy.
Because now, extracting this Tail Spike has become certain.
After the first crack, things became much easier from then on.
"Crack!"
Another round of focused attacks followed.
The cracks on the Beast’s tail began to widen, victory was in sight.
"Crack! Crack!"
After the seventh wave of attacks.
The Beast’s Tail Spike finally broke with a crack.
Then, it directly plummeted into the Endless Void.
Han Xing glanced at the God of Radiance beside him, "Radiance, could you please fetch it for me?"
The Beast’s Tail Spike contains an extremely powerful Tearing Law.
Especially when it just broke, the Tearing Law was even stronger.
The God of Radiance nodded.
Without any extra words, he directly transformed into a stream of light and disappeared from the spot.
The next moment, everyone saw the stream of light appear below the falling Tail Spike.
As he approached, the God of Radiance paused slightly, frowning lightly.
Because even he felt a bit of a sting.
However, as someone about to break through to a True God, the God of Radiance could easily withstand the Tearing Law.
Then, he directly used Divine Power to wrap the Giant Beast Tail Spike and brought it back.
Again transforming into a stream of light, he appeared in the cabin.
At the moment the God of Radiance appeared, everyone felt a series of tearing sensations on their skin.

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 480: Second Calamity Beast Tail Spike (Part 2)
paragraphs: Because of past experience, Han Xing didn’t even look and directly put the tail spike into his backpack.
The system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Special Item: Beast of Calamity’s Tail Spike *1]
Han Xing checked the attributes of the tail spike.
[Beast of Calamity Tail Spike (Unknown Quality)]: A tail spike infused with divine power, one of the most powerful parts of the Beast of Calamity.
[Attached Effect]: God-Breaking Spike, Extreme Giant Beast Poison.
[Remaining Toxic Attack Uses]: 3.
Its attributes are exactly the same as the giant beast tail spike obtained last time.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with joy, "Great! This means we have three more uses of the Giant Beast Poison!"
Just arriving at the Land of Divine War and already finding treasures, this trip was definitely worth it.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong looked at the void, at the beast’s corpse, and asked, "Brother Xing, are there any other treasures from the remaining parts?"
Han Xing laughed and said, "Of course."
"Have you forgotten? Xiaoyunzi’s shield is made from the beast’s scales."
The group realized something upon hearing this.
Then, their figures flashed, and they climbed onto the massive body.
This part of the body was covered with many scales, although many were damaged due to severe injuries.
But on it, there were still some intact scales visible.
And those intact scales were Han Xing and the others’ target.
Previously, they weren’t capable of forcibly removing them.
Even now, they still couldn’t forcibly remove these scales.
But, they had the God of Radiance!
Thus, under Han Xing’s command, the God of Radiance reluctantly shot two beams of light from his pupils.
"Buzz!"
These two beams of light contained extremely strong destructive power.
Then they began to cut the scales on the beast’s body.
"Screech... screech screech..."
Like a cutting machine, the divine light from the God of Radiance’s pupils began cutting along the edges of the beast’s scales.
Though it took a long time, it was effective in the end.
Soon, they managed to remove the scales one by one.
System prompts continuously appeared.
[Obtained Calamity Beast Scale (Red) *1]
[Obtained Calamity Beast Scale (Red) *1]
[Obtained...]
"So many divine-level materials, we’re rich, we’re rich!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in awe.
Two hours later, Han Xing had gathered over a thousand Calamity Beast Scales!
The more they collected, the more excited everyone became!
Although it took a bit more time, the rewards were truly worthwhile.
Han Xing praised from the side, "Radiance, well done!"
Clearly, if they hadn’t brought the God of Radiance, it would have been difficult to collect these scales.
Now with the God of Radiance, it was much easier.
He was a humanoid cutting machine, cutting wherever pointed.
The God of Radiance looked helpless.
As a top-tier divine spirit, to be doing such work now left him speechless.
However, seeing the group’s excited eyes and smiling faces.
Though the God of Radiance felt helpless, he had no real objections.
On the contrary, he somewhat enjoyed the process.
In Han Xing and the others, he seemed to see the shadow of his younger self.
Back then, he was also fearless, believing himself to be the world’s number one.
With that spirit, he quickly advanced to the divine realm.
Yet, upon reaching the divine realm, he experienced his first setbacks in life.
Among the divine spirits, there were countless who were more talented and powerful than he was.
Not to mention, there were stronger true gods above.
Then, under repeated setbacks, the God of Radiance gradually lost his sharpness.
He began to hold back his pride and learned to survive and escape.
At that moment, the God of Radiance couldn’t help thinking.
"If only I could maintain that invincible spirit like them."
The God of Radiance shook his head, brushing those thoughts aside, and focused on the task at hand.
About ten hours later.
The whole giant beast’s body surface, all intact scales had been separated by the God of Radiance.
Altogether, the group collected around 21,352 giant beast scales.
Joyful harvest was reflected in everyone’s eyes.
Cheng Jianyong praised, "This feeling of being surrounded by divine artifact materials is awesome!"
"Like picking up money!"
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Although, so far, they only knew these scales could be used to forge divine artifact equipment, not what else they could do.
But just this one function was terrifying enough.
After scavenging the scales, Han Xing turned his gaze to the beast’s body.
"Do you think the body of the Beast of Calamity can be broken down?"
The God of Radiance hurriedly coughed twice, interrupting Han Xing’s thought.
"Cough, cough..."
"Master, don’t think about that."
"This beast was killed by a true god, with true god-level laws remaining on it, eradicating all life force."
"Thus, the flesh of the beast’s body has no use and will decay soon."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this, then with slight regret said, "Alright, never mind then, let’s move on to the next spot."
The God of Radiance breathed a sigh of relief.
Then, with a flash, everyone returned to the cabin of the Divine Demon Battleship.
They began to continue their journey upstream along this brilliant galaxy.
Meanwhile, the Blade Armor Demons, surviving by a stroke of luck from a cannon hit by Han Xing and his team, quickly returned to their headquarters.
Before them appeared a massive Sky Island Continent.
Like the previous Sky Island, its entire surface was pitch-black, with a metallic sheen.

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 480: The Second Calamity Beast Tail Spike (3)
paragraphs: Various black skyscrapers, large machines, and defense towers.
Formed a steel city.
"Crack!"
Below, hundreds of thousands of Blade Armor Demons were working together to drag a massive piece of metal.
Then they dragged it to a nearby Sky Island, where a huge processing plant extracted it.
They clumsily moved the giant metal piece like black beetles.
"Hoo! Ha!"
"Hoo! Ha!"
The Blade Armor Demons shouted slogans in unison.
At this time, several demigod-level Blade Armor Demons released their entire aura.
This aura carried their battle cry!
The next moment.
Dozens of terrifying auras rose from the Steel Sky Island.
"Buzz!"
A terrifying pressure enveloped the entire steel city.
The lower-level Blade Armor Demons set down their work, respectfully kneeled on the ground.
Meanwhile, those auras rapidly flew towards the edge of the Sky Island City.
All the powerful Blade Armor Demons on the entire Sky Island were mobilized, something they hadn’t encountered in hundreds of years.
The lower-level Blade Armor Demons looked up at the sky, not knowing what was happening.
At this moment, a small crocodile creature pointed at a figure covering the sky and sun above and said, "Look, that seems to be the Moya Race Lord."
Upon hearing this, nearby Blade Armor Demons raised their heads.
Next to this small crocodile, an elderly Blade Armor Demon hurriedly covered its mouth and pulled it down to kneel as well.
"Remo, don’t speak out of turn."
"Have you forgotten how I taught you? When you see these big figures, kneel immediately, and keep your mouth shut!"
The small crocodile nodded confusedly, "I remember, Grandpa Uday!"
Meanwhile, they all gazed at the terrifying figure over ten thousand meters long overhead.
The aura it emitted even surpassed a demigod.
This was a Divine Blade Armor Demon!
At this moment, the massive body of this Divine Blade Armor Demon stretched across the sky, like a crocodile in predatory mode, with dangerous glints in its eyes.
Being scanned by its pupils was like being eyed by a prehistoric beast.
The demigod Blade Armor Demons that sent distress signals respectfully knelt in the Void.
After a while, the Divine Blade Armor Demon opened its mouth full of sharp teeth.
"Anatuo, what happened?"
Anatuo was one of the Blade Armor Demons with a high-tier demigod level.
It raised its head and faithfully recounted their encounter with Han Xing.
After listening to its account.
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon, with enormous strength, pondered for a while.
Its grim pupils gradually shrank into vertical black lines.
"A defense tower capable of instantly defeating a high-tier demigod, has another new powerhouse arrived at the Land of Divine War?"
"I also don’t know if they’re here just for a quick gain, or if they’ll stay long like us."
"If it’s the latter, it could be a bit troublesome."
At this time, Anatuo continued, "Back to the Clan Chief, the auras of those few beings aren’t very strong, just two demigods, and a few legends."
Because the God of Radiance hid its aura at the time.
So these Blade Armor Demons did not sense a Divine Spirit Level aura.
Upon hearing this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon’s pupils widened, it excitedly asked.
"You mean, those guys only have demigod and legend strength, yet possess such a powerful defense tower?"
Anatuo nodded, "Yes, Clan Chief!"
Then, Anatuo tentatively asked, "Clan Chief, have you ever encountered such a strange race?"
The Divine Blade Armor Demon nodded with interest.
"Encountered before, but rarely."
"Previously, some peculiar races came to the Land of Divine War."
"Their individual strength wasn’t strong, but they had weapons capable of seriously injuring demigods and even Divine Spirits."
"The Void Thermal Energy Cannon we are using now was obtained from these races."
Nearby, dozens of Blade Armor Demons quietly listened.
After a while, the Divine Blade Armor Demon said, "Anatuo, lead the way.
"Go and capture those guys for me."
"That kind of weapon is wasted in their hands!"
"If we can control it, it would greatly strengthen the Blade Armor Demon Race."
"At that point, even if we attend the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms meeting in Silent City, we would have more confidence."
This Blade Armor Demon named Anatuo respectfully replied, "Yes, Clan Chief!"
"The Clan Chief personally takes action, you’ll surely take down those guys easily!"
With that, he turned around and led the other Blade Armor Demons to fly out.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing and others continued moving upstream along this massive Galaxy.
A group of terrifying figures were also rapidly coming down.
They soon encountered each other.
Looking at the crocodile-like beings, the familiar figures, Han Xing halted the warship.
Cheng Jianyong laughed through the virtual screen, "Yo, it seems that group of black crocodiles has come again."
"These guys, are they back for revenge this time?"
Shen Yun also chimed in, "Judging by their stance, it’s very likely."
"These guys, given the chance to escape once, don’t know to cherish it, are they rushing to their deaths?"
Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t know, let’s see what’s happening first."
"If they want to make a move again, then just take them down directly."
Everyone nodded, all preparing for battle.
At this time, the God of Radiance frowned and said, "Master, be cautious. I sensed a Divine Level aura among that group of Blade Armor Demons ahead."
"Divine Level?"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He seemed to think of something and immediately ordered, "Radiance, hide your aura first, don’t scare that Divine Level away."

Next to this small crocodile, an elderly Blade Armor Demon hurriedly covered its mouth and pulled it down to kneel as well.
"Remo, don’t speak out of turn."
"Have you forgotten how I taught you?
When you see these big figures, kneel immediately, and keep your mouth shut!"
The small crocodile nodded confusedly, "I remember, Grandpa Uday!"
Meanwhile, they all gazed at the terrifying figure over ten thousand meters long overhead.
The aura it emitted even surpassed a demigod.
This was a Divine Blade Armor Demon!
At this moment, the massive body of this Divine Blade Armor Demon stretched across the sky, like a crocodile in predatory mode, with dangerous glints in its eyes.
Being scanned by its pupils was like being eyed by a prehistoric beast.
The demigod Blade Armor Demons that sent distress signals respectfully knelt in the Void.
After a while, the Divine Blade Armor Demon opened its mouth full of sharp teeth.
"Anatuo, what happened?"
Anatuo was one of the Blade Armor Demons with a high-tier demigod level.
It raised its head and faithfully recounted their encounter with Han Xing.
After listening to its account.
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon, with enormous strength, pondered for a while.
Its grim pupils gradually shrank into vertical black lines.
"A defense tower capable of instantly defeating a high-tier demigod, has another new powerhouse arrived at the Land of Divine War?"
"I also don’t know if they’re here just for a quick gain, or if they’ll stay long like us."
"If it’s the latter, it could be a bit troublesome."
At this time, Anatuo continued, "Back to the Clan Chief, the auras of those few beings aren’t very strong, just two demigods, and a few legends."
Because the God of Radiance hid its aura at the time.
So these Blade Armor Demons did not sense a Divine Spirit Level aura.
Upon hearing this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon’s pupils widened, it excitedly asked.
"You mean, those guys only have demigod and legend strength, yet possess such a powerful defense tower?"
Anatuo nodded, "Yes, Clan Chief!"
Then, Anatuo tentatively asked, "Clan Chief, have you ever encountered such a strange race?"
The Divine Blade Armor Demon nodded with interest.
"Encountered before, but rarely."
"Previously, some peculiar races came to the Land of Divine War."
"Their individual strength wasn’t strong, but they had weapons capable of seriously injuring demigods and even Divine Spirits."
"The Void Thermal Energy Cannon we are using now was obtained from these races."
Nearby, dozens of Blade Armor Demons quietly listened.
After a while, the Divine Blade Armor Demon said, "Anatuo, lead the way.
"Go and capture those guys for me."
"That kind of weapon is wasted in their hands!"
"If we can control it, it would greatly strengthen the Blade Armor Demon Race."
"At that point, even if we attend the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms meeting in Silent City, we would have more confidence."
This Blade Armor Demon named Anatuo respectfully replied, "Yes, Clan Chief!"
"The Clan Chief personally takes action, you’ll surely take down those guys easily!"
With that, he turned around and led the other Blade Armor Demons to fly out.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing and others continued moving upstream along this massive Galaxy.
A group of terrifying figures were also rapidly coming down.
They soon encountered each other.
Looking at the crocodile-like beings, the familiar figures, Han Xing halted the warship.
Cheng Jianyong laughed through the virtual screen, "Yo, it seems that group of black crocodiles has come again."
"These guys, are they back for revenge this time?"
Shen Yun also chimed in, "Judging by their stance, it’s very likely."
"These guys, given the chance to escape once, don’t know to cherish it, are they rushing to their deaths?"
Han Xing shook his head, "I don’t know, let’s see what’s happening first."
"If they want to make a move again, then just take them down directly."
Everyone nodded, all preparing for battle.
At this time, the God of Radiance frowned and said, "Master, be cautious.
I sensed a Divine Level aura among that group of Blade Armor Demons ahead."
"Divine Level?"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He seemed to think of something and immediately ordered, "Radiance, hide your aura first, don’t scare that Divine Level away."

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 481: Bombarding the Divine Blade Armor Demon
paragraphs: "When I tell you to make a move, do it immediately!"
The God of Radiance seemed to understand something upon hearing this.
He quickly deepened the concealment of his own aura.
Meanwhile,
A group of Blade Armor Demons, all with at least middle-tier demigod strength, rushed towards the Divine Demon Battleship at high speed.
The Divine Blade Armor Demon frowned slightly.
As a divine-level being, its sense of danger was extremely sharp.
It could vaguely sense a threatening aura emanating from that battleship.
However, after releasing its aura to probe several times,
it discovered that it was just a few demigods and some legendary level guys.
The source of the crisis probably came from the turret on this battleship belonging to Anatuo.
Thinking of this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon felt a bit more at ease.
It rapidly approached Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Then, both sides stopped at a distance of about five thousand kilometers apart.
Neither side spoke, just staying put.
A moment later, a Blade Armor Demon with a sinister gaze stepped out.
Han Xing and the others recognized it; it was the same Blade Armor Demon that had been blasted away previously.
It sneered coldly, "You bunch better hand over the body of the Beast of Calamity!"
"Otherwise, you’ll all be buried here today!"
Han Xing and the others exchanged a glance but didn’t respond.
After waiting for a moment,
the Blade Armor Demon continued to taunt, "What’s wrong? Are you scared silent by the aura of so many of our strong? "
"If you come out of that tin shell now, kneel before us, and apologize, "
"I might spare your life."
Its eyes were filled with a smug expression.
However, Han Xing and the others still didn’t respond.
This Blade Armor Demon seemed a bit embarrassed.
It questioned, "Are you deaf or dumb? Can’t you hear me talking to you?"
At this moment, Han Xing finally spoke.
"Heard you loud and clear, I just don’t think there’s any point in speaking much to a dying fool."
Hearing this, the Blade Armor Demon was immediately infuriated.
It shook its body violently.
From its body, thousands of black scales suddenly burst forth, attacking the Divine Demon Battleship forcefully.
And at that moment, Han Xing controlled five Spiritual Godslaying Cannons, unleashing a wave of fire.
Boom!
The black scales were vaporized before getting close.
Moreover, the residual energy beams continued to blast towards that Blade Armor Demon.
It sensed a powerful threat.
The Blade Armor Demon’s figure flashed and narrowly dodged the attack.
"Damn! You dare to retaliate!"
Han Xing said nonchalantly, "Why wouldn’t we dare?"
The Blade Armor Demon couldn’t hold its face anymore and shouted at Han Xing and others, "If you have the guts, come out and face me head-on!"
Clearly, the Blade Armor Demon didn’t attack immediately because it obeyed the divine-level Blade Armor Demon’s order.
They were worried that using force might destroy the powerful turret on that battleship.
So, they tried to force out Han Xing and his companions first.
Cheng Jianyong also said with a helpless face, "Asking us to come out just because you said so, wouldn’t that be embarrassing for us?"
The Blade Armor Demon’s eyes showed a mocking expression, disdainfully saying, "What? Don’t dare to face us head-on, just hiding inside that tin shell?"
Cheng Jianyong replied, "You’re right, we have a powerful battleship, why would we leave it and fight you?"
The Blade Armor Demon was at a loss for words when questioned.
And just then,
Han Xing saw,
ten or so Blade Armor Demons surrounded the front, back, left, and right of the Divine Demon Battleship simultaneously.
They approached cautiously, concealing all divine power fluctuations, moving very carefully.
Yet, this scene made everyone want to laugh a bit.
Shen Yun said speechlessly, "Do these guys think that we can’t see anything inside the battleship?"
The Blade Armor Demon race’s tactics left Han Xing and the others speechless.
At this moment, the Blade Armor Demon named Anatuo continued speaking, trying to attract Han Xing and his companions’ attention.
The other Blade Armor Demons had already moved closer to the Divine Demon Battleship.
And were about to enter the ten-thousand-meter range of the Divine Demon Battleship.
The Blade Armor Demon continued, "A bunch of kids, I advise you to surrender quickly."
"Otherwise, you’ll soon know the consequences!"
At this time, Han Xing’s indifferent voice emerged.
"Is this the consequence you’re talking about?"
In its confused gaze,
it suddenly saw two hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons on both sides of the Divine Demon Battleship explode with dazzling light simultaneously.
The Blade Armor Demon’s expression changed, urgently shouting, "Damn! We’ve been discovered, retreat!"
Having experienced the fearsome Godslaying Cannon, these Blade Armor Demons tried to dodge.
And at that moment,
the firepower of a hundred Frozen Star Cannons and a hundred Dark Energy Cannons struck instantly.
The terrifying shells almost covered all their escape paths!
Moreover, an extremely deadly sense of crisis came from the shells.
The group of Blade Armor Demons exclaimed, "What is this?"
"So terrifying! Completely unstoppable!"
"Run! Quickly!"
However, they were now so close to the battleship.
At this distance, how could they escape?
"Buzz!"
"Boom!"
The attacks of the Frozen Star Cannons, Dark Energy Cannons, and Spiritual Godslaying Cannons hit simultaneously!
The entire ten-thousand-meter radius around the Divine Demon Battleship was immediately enveloped in a terrifying explosion.
At this moment, Han Xing showed them the true meaning of overwhelming firepower!
