chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 481: Bombarding the Divine Blade Armor Demon (Part 2)
paragraphs: A few Demigod Blade Armor Demons were instantly blasted to pieces!
The sudden incident left everyone in shock.
Including the Divine Blade Armor Demon.
Until a few demons, fortunate enough not to be engulfed by the firepower, rushed out from the area.
Their faces were filled with extreme fear, their bodies covered in wounds.
Though the recent wave of attack did not take them away, it left them critically injured and near death.
As the cannons on that battleship began charging up again.
Their eyes flashed with terror, and they shouted, "Clan Leader, save us!!!"
Meanwhile.
Suddenly, a terrifying aura erupted over Sky Island.
Then, a gigantic beast covered in black scales appeared as though lurking in the Void.
Its crocodile-like tail lashed out, snatching the few High-tier Demigods away.
However, this is precisely what Han Xing was waiting for.
This is the moment he was anticipating.
In the next instance, he commanded all Calamity Defense Towers and Advanced Cannon Towers on the Divine Demon Battleship to attack.
"Boom!"
"Buzz!"
Hundreds of Silent Annihilation Lightnings struck instantly.
The speed was so fast that even the Divine Blade Armor Demon couldn’t react.
It only felt a terrifying energy wave blasting towards its body.
"Pa!"
With a horrifying blast sound!
The scales of this demon instantly exploded, revealing the red flesh underneath.
The Divine Blade Armor Demon was heavily injured, spitting out black blood.
It looked at the battleship behind it in shock, exclaiming, "I’m a Divine Blade Armor Demon, ordinary Divine existences can’t even break through my defenses!"
"Damn it! How is there such a powerful Defense Tower?"
Realizing this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon lashed its tail, attempting to escape.
However, the Power of Thunder ravaged within its body, causing brief paralysis.
It was the paralytic effect from the Tower of Annihilation Lightning!
At the same moment, terrifying Withered Snowflakes, Silent Annihilation Rain, and attacks from the Dark Energy Cannon, Frozen Star Cannon, and Spiritual Godslaying Cannon all descended!
A sense of impending death completely enveloped it.
Nearby, the surviving Demigod Blade Armor Demons all showed expressions of fear.
They realized that this wave of attack, even for their Clan Leader, likely meant certain death!
"Quick, save the Clan Leader!"
"The Clan Leader cannot die!!"
This group of demons charged forward frantically, seemingly wanting to shield their Clan Leader from the attack.
The Divine Blade Armor Demon could hardly have imagined.
These few Legends possessing not defense towers against Demigods.
But rather terrifying firepower capable of dispatching Divine Spirits in one wave!
At this moment, it realized something needed to be done.
No matter the cost, it couldn’t die now.
"Roar!!!"
The demon suddenly roared loudly.
Its previously million-meter long body instantly expanded several times over!
Its body transformed into a size of several hundred thousand kilometers, rivaling the size of the Beast of Calamity.
And at this time, Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship’s attacks had already arrived.
"Boom! Boom!"
The area was completely shrouded in various terrifying energies.
An attack capable of instantly killing top-tier Divine Spirits landed on the demon.
Its massive body started showing dense cracks.
It was on the verge of exploding!
Its aura drastically decreased at that instant and seemed about to drop out of the Divine Realm.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing and others were jaw-dropped, saying, "Wow... it didn’t get taken out instantly?"
"Is this guy so absurd?"
It’s known that this wave of concentrated firepower from Han Xing, although it did not use the Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon nor the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
But just activating those Calamity Defense Towers in one move could instantly kill a top-tier Divine Spirit like the God of Radiance.
Not taking out this Blade Armor Demon was indeed unexpected for them.
At this moment, the God of Radiance explained, "Master, the small worlds in the Void are incredibly mysterious; these worlds might have unique environments and rules of their own."
"Some excel in Element control, some excel in combat paths, while others might excel in revival paths."
"This Divine-level creature’s world might be extremely proficient in defense."
"Therefore, it was able to withstand your concentrated firepower."
Han Xing nodded in realization.
Their eyes turned again.
At this time, that Blade Armor Demon, although withstanding the attack wave, had already lost all combat ability.
Moreover, even nearby Demigod Blade Armor Demons suffered heavily, with a lot of casualties.
Only a few Demigod Blade Armor Demons remained, barely alive.
Han Xing’s Defense Towers aren’t easy to tackle.
"Puff!"
The Divine Blade Armor Demon spat out a mouthful of black blood, its body rapidly shrinking.
In a blink, it shrank to less than fifty thousand meters.
With difficulty, it spoke, "Go... quickly go..."
The Demigod Blade Armor Demons mustered their last bit of energy, transforming into a spinning drill, escaping rapidly.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing, who initially intended to finish them off directly, suddenly had a different idea.
"Radiance, go control them." Han Xing commanded.
The God of Radiance, upon hearing this, flashed his figure, transforming into a stream of light appearing before the demons.
Then, with divine power bursting out, transformed into endless Chains of Light, completely enveloping this area.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 481: Bombarding the Divine Blade Armor Demon (Part 3)
paragraphs: This group of Blade Armor Demons, along with the massive black Sky Island, was completely under control.
The Divine Blade Armor Demon struggled for a moment, finding itself utterly immobile.
In horror, it said, "Divine Spirit! And a top-tier Divine Spirit, how is this possible?"
The God of Radiance did not respond.
Instead, he gazed at the group of Blade Armor Demons with a commanding look.
Meanwhile, Han Xing and others arrived.
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon exclaimed, "Which world’s Divine Spirit are you? So powerful, yet I’ve never heard of you!"
"We are the Blade Armor Demon Race from the Silent City Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms, you cannot kill me!"
The God of Radiance still did not reply but turned his gaze towards Han Xing.
Han Xing then asked, "What is Silent City, and what is the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms?"
The Blade Armor Demon did not look to answer Han Xing but fearfully gazed at the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance frowned and said, "My master is asking you a question, are you deaf?"
After speaking, he directly raised his hand, and an iron chain formed by Divine Power lashed out fiercely.
"Snap!"
After a crisp sound, the Blade Armor Demon flinched.
The intense pain made its whole body shudder.
However, what shook it more was the words of the God of Radiance.
In terror, it said, "What did you say, this Legendary-level ant is your master!"
"But you are a top-tier Divine Spirit, how can you recognize a Legend as a master?"
Yet, the God of Radiance continued coldly, "Don’t ask what you shouldn’t. Answer quickly when asked."
"If it weren’t for my master speaking, you would have already been dead, understand?"
Hearing this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon trembled as it looked at Han Xing.
It took a deep breath, seemingly accepting this fact.
The Legendary-level human before it was indeed the person in charge here.
Then, the Divine Blade Armor Demon slowly spoke.
"Silent City is a main city Sky Island created by the True God of Yellow Sand in the Land of Divine War, where strong figures from various worlds can trade resources."
"And we, the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms, are a coalition formed by various large and small worlds."
"There are many Divine-level beings among us, and even True Gods exist, so you can’t kill me!"
After listening to this explanation, Han Xing was thoughtful.
It seems, as the God of Radiance said.
The Land of Divine War has evolved over ten thousand years, gathering various forces.
Now, they’ve even built a public area like Silent City.
However, upon hearing the mention of True God level, Han Xing smiled.
"You don’t think that by bringing up the True God, I won’t dare to kill you, do you?"
Simultaneously, the God of Radiance had already formed ten Light Spears, each ten thousand meters long.
He would launch an attack without hesitation as soon as Han Xing gave the order.
The Blade Armor Demon shuddered all over.
"No... don’t kill me!"
"I can offer you many treasures! Many precious Divine Artifacts!"
Han Xing did not act immediately but asked, "Really?"
"So, to survive, what are you willing to offer?"
Hearing this, the Blade Armor Demon seemed to see a glimmer of hope.
With excitement, it said, "Whatever you need, I can give you!"
"By the way! Our Blade Armor Demon Race has a base in the Land of Divine War with many treasures of our race and our most beautiful women!"
"I can offer these peerless beauties entirely to this lord!"
The preceding sentences were normal.
However, upon hearing the last sentence, Han Xing rolled his eyes.
He pulled back the bowstring and shot an arrow directly at the Blade Armor Demon.
Given the beauty standards of the Blade Armor Demon Race, the so-called peerless beauties likely look like these creatures covered in black scales...
Just thinking about it made Han Xing shudder.
Suddenly shot with an arrow, the Divine Blade Armor Demon appeared somewhat confused.
Han Xing then said, "Enough, don’t play dumb with me."
"If you want to live, I can give you a chance.
"The condition is, you must be willing to give up everything."
At this moment, in the eyes of the Divine Blade Armor Demon, nothing was more important than its life.
Even if the man before it wanted its entire Blade Armor Demon Race, it would still agree without hesitation.
However, Han Xing’s next words brought hesitance.
"Then, you must swear to the Supreme Rule, from this moment on, acknowledge me as your master, and unconditionally obey my commands."
This time, Han Xing gave no deadline.
But directly demanded lifelong obedience.
Killing this Divine Blade Armor Demon would certainly yield great rewards.
Yet, Han Xing also heard that there are strong figures from various worlds here,
there are many at Divine Spirit level.
And Han Xing could deal with several Divine Spirits, along with the God of Radiance, possibly ten Divine Spirits at once.
However, the guy also mentioned there are True God level beings here.
Uncertain whether the Celestial Rail Strike Device could defeat those at True God level.
Therefore, before that, Han Xing plans to maintain a low profile.
He needs to proceed steadily, and increase his strength whenever possible.
Upon hearing this, the Blade Armor Demon furiously said, "You want to enslave me? Impossible!"
However, Han Xing shrugged and said, "It doesn’t matter, the choice is yours."
"Choose to die now, or become my henchman."
The Divine Blade Armor Demon’s gaze swept over the God of Radiance, shifting from firm rejection to slight hesitation.
It looked at Han Xing and said, "Can I pledge allegiance to you for a period of time?"
"A thousand years, even ten thousand years would be acceptable."
For beings at the Divine Spirit level, their lifespan is extremely long.
Being subservient to one person for life would mean a dim future...

The Divine Blade Armor Demon struggled for a moment, finding itself utterly immobile.
In horror, it said, "Divine Spirit!
And a top-tier Divine Spirit, how is this possible?"
The God of Radiance did not respond.
Instead, he gazed at the group of Blade Armor Demons with a commanding look.

So powerful, yet I’ve never heard of you!"
"We are the Blade Armor Demon Race from the Silent City Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms, you cannot kill me!"
The God of Radiance still did not reply but turned his gaze towards Han Xing.
Han Xing then asked, "What is Silent City, and what is the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms?"
The Blade Armor Demon did not look to answer Han Xing but fearfully gazed at the God of Radiance.
The God of Radiance frowned and said, "My master is asking you a question, are you deaf?"
After speaking, he directly raised his hand, and an iron chain formed by Divine Power lashed out fiercely.
"Snap!"
After a crisp sound, the Blade Armor Demon flinched.
The intense pain made its whole body shudder.
However, what shook it more was the words of the God of Radiance.
In terror, it said, "What did you say, this Legendary-level ant is your master!"
"But you are a top-tier Divine Spirit, how can you recognize a Legend as a master?"
Yet, the God of Radiance continued coldly, "Don’t ask what you shouldn’t.
Answer quickly when asked."
"If it weren’t for my master speaking, you would have already been dead, understand?"
Hearing this, the Divine Blade Armor Demon trembled as it looked at Han Xing.
It took a deep breath, seemingly accepting this fact.
The Legendary-level human before it was indeed the person in charge here.
Then, the Divine Blade Armor Demon slowly spoke.
"Silent City is a main city Sky Island created by the True God of Yellow Sand in the Land of Divine War, where strong figures from various worlds can trade resources."
"And we, the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms, are a coalition formed by various large and small worlds."
"There are many Divine-level beings among us, and even True Gods exist, so you can’t kill me!"

It seems, as the God of Radiance said.
The Land of Divine War has evolved over ten thousand years, gathering various forces.
Now, they’ve even built a public area like Silent City.

"I can offer you many treasures!

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 482: Five Divine Formats, Half a Power of Rules
paragraphs: Han Xing shook his head and said, "Do you think there’s any difference?"
"It’s whether you choose to be wiped out by me now, or to submit for life—consider it yourself."
"My time is limited, I’ll give you ten seconds."
"Ten."
With that, the countdown had already started.
The struggle was visible in the Blade Armor Demon’s eyes.
"Five."
Upon hearing this number, the Blade Armor Demon’s pupils widened suddenly.
Well, is the countdown in your world really like this?
"Two."
When Han Xing was about to extend the last finger, the Blade Armor Demon spoke, "I am willing to submit!"
Han Xing did not continue speaking but nodded.
Under everyone’s gaze.
Finally, this Blade Armor Demon still swore to the Supreme Rule.
As soon as the words fell.
Four thick neuronal networks emerged, seemingly recording its vow.
At this moment, Han Xing knew the vow had taken effect.
A moment later, the Blade Armor Demon shyly exclaimed, "Ma...Master..."
Han Xing nodded.
Meanwhile, Han Xing walked over and picked up all the fragments exploded from the dying Demigod Blade Armor Demons.
On those fragments, Han Xing sensed intense waves of Divine Power.
[Obtained Blade Armor Demon Divine Power Fragment *1]
[Obtained Blade Armor Demon Divine Power Fragment *1]
System prompts kept appearing.
In the end, Han Xing totaled 12 Divine Power Fragments.
Then, he checked the attributes of this Divine Power Fragment.
[Blade Armor Demon Divine Power Fragment: Special item]
[Effect one: Collecting five Blade Armor Demon fragments allows synthesis into one Divine Format: Blade Armor]
[Effect two: When absorbed by a Legend or Above Legendary spirit, it can increase Divine Power Value by 1000 points]
Seeing the attribute introduction of this item, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
Goodness, these fragments can be synthesized into a Divine Format and also enhance Divine Power Value!
This was something he had never expected.
Previously, when Han Xing was killing those demigods, no Divine Format would explode.
Because when those demigods died, their Power of Rules would shatter too.
The scattered Power of Rules was partially absorbed by Han Xing, and the majority reintegrated into the rules.
But these Blade Armor Demons, though unable to absorb Divine Power when killed, still could release [Blade Armor Demon Fragments], which was very favorable.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon gazed at the fragments in Han Xing’s hand and awkwardly spoke, "Master, these are our clan’s Divine Power Fragments..."
"All our clansmen need these fragments to enhance their strength."
Its intention was to ask Han Xing to return them.
However, Han Xing nodded and said, "I know, but anyway, your clan’s demigods are almost all dead and won’t need these anymore."
"Just as well, let me absorb them to enhance my strength."
With that, without waiting for the Divine Blade Armor Demon to speak further.
Han Xing crushed all those fragments before the Divine Blade Armor Demon’s eyes.
"Crunch!"
The Blade Armor Demon was stunned on the spot.
At the same time, Han Xing released Divine Power and absorbed all the Divine Power overflowing from the fragments.
System prompts appeared.
[Successfully absorbed Blade Armor Demon Fragment, Divine Power Value +1000]
[Successfully absorbed Blade Armor Demon Fragment, Divine Power Value +1000]
After twelve prompts, Han Xing’s Divine Power Value surged an additional twelve thousand.
He glanced at his Attribute Panel!
[Divine Power Value: 60231]
"Good, good, good, finally over sixty thousand!"
"Closer to twenty thousand more steps."
Han Xing was delighted.
In contrast, the Blade Armor Demon beside him wore a somewhat constipated expression.
Han Xing then asked, "By the way, what’s your name?"
This Divine Blade Armor Demon took a few deep breaths and then replied, "Report to Master, my name is Balumonger Maya."
Han Xing nodded, "Fine, let’s call you Samoyed then."
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang let out a laugh together.
Even Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong couldn’t hold back a smile,
This Blade Armor Demon was confused, seemingly not understanding why Han Xing called it that.
Or why the other humans were laughing.
Before it could react.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Samoyed, roughly how long will it take for your injuries to recover?"
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon’s scales had fallen off en masse, revealing the fresh red flesh within.
In many areas, there were horrifying wounds, making it look incomparably miserable.
If it were any ordinary Divine Spirit Level existence, it would have died by now.
It survived solely due to its extremely thick Life Force.
This Divine Blade Armor Demon seemed to accept Han Xing’s naming, replying, "To Master, my injuries are quite severe now."
"If I recover slowly, it will take at least five to six years."
"Besides, even if I recover, I likely won’t return to my previous strength."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing asked with doubt, "Oh? Why is that?"
Samoyed smiled wryly, "Master, your Defense Tower has terrifying power and strength."
"Average middle-tier Divine Spirits simply have no chance of surviving."
"Even I had to pay an extremely serious price to barely escape with my life."
"The price is that I may be stuck in the Low-tier Divine Realm for life."
Saying this, Samoyed grew a bit sentimental.
He also felt some regret about provoking these troublesome gods.
Cheng Jianyong consoled from the side, "Samoyed, it’s already quite fortunate you’ve managed to keep your life."
"Before, we killed a Divine Spirit even stronger than you, and he didn’t even get a word out before we directly wiped him out, you know?"

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 482: Five Divine Formats, Half a Power of Rules_2
paragraphs: Samoyed chuckled bitterly and nodded.
How could he not know that surviving was a stroke of luck?
Han Xing continued, "Samoyed, you mentioned that your Blade Armor Demon Race has a floating island base in the Land of Divine War, right?"
The Blade Armor Demon nodded, "Yes, master."
Han Xing asked, "How many years have you been settled here?"
The Blade Armor Demon recalled for a moment.
Then he said, "Back to master, it’s been about three thousand years."
"That long?"
"Yes." Samoyed replied honestly.
Han Xing nodded and continued, "So how did you find this place?"
Hearing this, Samoyed thought for a bit, then answered.
"Three thousand years ago, there was a place in the void called Scale Armor World."
"On a certain day, a high-tier demigod wandered out of the world barrier and began a journey of void wandering."
"Then, it was caught by a group of powerful beings and spent years as a slave, suffering greatly."
"It was then that the Blade Armor Demon realized that there are countless strong beings in the void, and a high-tier demigod is only starting the journey."
"After lying low for many years, the Blade Armor Demon was brought to the Land of Divine War and fortunately gained a complete rule."
"Using this rule, it broke through to a divine spirit and escaped from the race that captured it."
"Later, it gradually developed its own force in the Land of Divine War, establishing a foothold."
"It wasn’t until it broke through to a middle-tier divine spirit that it returned to Scale Armor World and brought its fellow clan members out."
Upon hearing the Blade Armor Demon’s words, everyone nodded in realization.
Cheng Jianyong said, "The Blade Armor Demon you mentioned is you, right?"
Samoyed nodded with a hint of embarrassment.
Han Xing asked, "Are you saying you haven’t been enslaved for years?"
"Yes, master.
"What was the name of the race that enslaved you back then? Were they very strong?"
Samoyed nodded, "That race was called the Painful Blood Spider Race, and they had more than one divine spirit."
"Their clan leader, with top-tier divine spirit strength, was named the Painful Empress."
"This race feeds on the suffering of living beings; the more pain you’re in, the more excited they become."
"I suffered greatly at their hands."
"After becoming a divine spirit and escaping, the Painful Empress tried to capture me again."
"Out of desperation, I joined the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms in Silent City, forcing the Painful Empress to back off."
Cheng Jianyong then reassured, "Samoyed, I didn’t expect you had such a past."
Samoyed chuckled bitterly twice.
Han Xing changed the subject, "You’ve led the Blade Armor Demon Race here for three thousand years."
"Have you studied the time frequency or patterns of treasure eruptions related to the Forbidden Star River?"
The Blade Armor Demon replied again, "Back to master, the time and location of treasure eruptions from the Forbidden Star River are very irregular."
"As you’ve seen, we’ve been here for hundreds of years and might not witness an eruption of treasures from the Star River even once."
"Yet when you arrived, you encountered the body of the Beast of Calamity, a valuable opportunity."
"So, you are indeed very lucky."
Han Xing and the others nodded.
They were indeed quite lucky.
This might be related to several pieces of equipment he had that boosted his luck.
Moreover, ever since awakening the SS-level talent [Human Emperor’s Destiny], his luck value increased significantly.
Samoyed continued, "However, although we haven’t witnessed many eruptions from the Forbidden Star River in those three thousand years.
"In the past hundred years, the frequency of these eruptions has increased."
"In the last hundred years, I’ve witnessed about three large-scale eruptions."
"Each eruption produces several complete rules, and once, I even saw a True God-level rule appear."
"That True God-level rule attracted at least a hundred factions vying for it, ultimately seized by a divine spirit from the Ghostly Bat Race."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was a bit surprised, "True God-level rule?"
"Is the Ghostly Bat Race still around?"
Samoyed shook his head, "As you suspected, master."
"The divine spirit of that race, after obtaining the True God-level rule wasn’t around for long, wiped out by some mysterious force."
"Not only the divine spirit but the entire Ghostly Bat Race was exterminated."
"Not even a single tier one Ghostly Bat was left."
"So, who ultimately took that True God-level rule remains unknown to everyone."
"This incident became an unsolved mystery."
Han Xing nodded in realization.
They all suspected that a True God-level entity was involved.
But which True God took action remains unknown.
Perhaps the True God wants to save face and doesn’t want people pointing fingers or taking precautions against him.
Han Xing shook his head, "Alright, I’ve gathered about enough intel concerning the Forbidden Galaxy."
"Now, hand over the godhead or the Power of Rules in your possession to me."
Upon hearing this, Samoyed was taken aback, shaking his head hurriedly.
"Master... I... I don’t possess such things."
Han Xing squinted and said, "Are you sure?"
"The oath of the Supreme Rule states clearly that you must not deceive me, right?"
"Think carefully before you speak!"

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 482: Five Divine Formats, Half a Power of Rules_3
paragraphs: At the same time.
Above the heads of everyone, four nerve networks appeared once again, slowly glowing faintly.
Samoyed suddenly felt a terrifying sense of crisis, as if it might be directly erased at any moment!
The Supreme Rule holds no leniency; if you violate the vows, you will inevitably face punishment.
Even a True God cannot change this.
Samoyed was extremely frightened, hurriedly nodding: "Master, I have! I have!"
Han Xing smiled and asked: "How many?"
Samoyed was completely scared at this point and spoke fearfully: "In the last few hundred years, we’ve managed to snatch around five pieces of Divine Format and half a strand of Power of Rules."
Upon hearing this number, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
Good heavens, that’s quite a quantity.
It’s even comparable to the harvest from the Light God’s Treasure Vault.

[Divine Format: Domination]

The controllers of these Divine Formats are at most only within the Divine Realm, with no True Gods or Top-tier Divine Spirits among them.

Samoyed smiled bitterly and shook his head, "I am no match for the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race..."

They really thought, that the Blade Armor Demon Race was the kind that wouldn’t settle scores after being bullied.
Turns out they couldn’t overpower the others.

Just upon arriving at the Land of Divine War, and already seeking trouble with a major race here.

"The Bone-Eroding Griffin Race, though devoid of Top-tier Divine Spirits, has a strong sense of retaliation and never lets grievances go unavenged."
"If you offend them, this group of griffins will hunt you across the entire Void."
"Therefore, hardly any race in the Land of Divine War dares provoke them."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing suddenly laughed: "The Bone-Eroding Griffin Race is tough, do you think we’re easy to take on?"

At this moment, it seemed to grasp something.
Indeed, these few humans are calamities!
Moreover, their power is terrifyingly formidable.

Samoyed seemed to apprehend that the arrival of Han Xing and others was set to change the landscape of the Land of Divine War.
"Lead the way, Samoyed."
At this moment, the Divine Blade Armor Demon nodded.
It began to swiftly advance forward, recovering its injuries along the way.
However, as previously mentioned, its current injuries were too severe.
In the short term, it’s likely to be without combat power.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 483: Surrounded by Wolves
paragraphs: Within the Forbidden Star River, there exist many powerhouses from various Great Worlds.
Throughout the journey, the injuries on the Blade Armor Demon naturally attracted the attention of those powerhouses.
They all looked curiously at the injuries on Samoyed.
Some high-tier demigods, even top demigods, came over to inquire about what had happened to the Blade Armor Demon.
These guys pretended to be familiar.
"Moya, did you encounter any trouble?"
A creature with antennae on its head, resembling an ant, came over and asked.
However, seeing this, Samoyed coldly replied, "What are you? Am I well acquainted with you?"
"A mere small demigod, how dare you call me by my name when meeting me? Are you looking to die?"
At the same time, Moya gathered a breath, causing the Ant Race powerhouse’s face to change dramatically.
Although Samoyed currently lacked combat power, as a middle-tier Divine Spirit, even just a breath wasn’t something these demigods could withstand.
The creature retreated dejectedly.
Samoyed continued to maintain a distant attitude as it proceeded.
Because it knew, these creatures did not have good intentions.
Seeing how weak it was, they felt there was an opportunity.
In such a place, everyone came from different worlds, and there wasn’t any camaraderie to speak of.
Once you show a hint of weakness, a pack of wolves will immediately target you.
And Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship was following from afar behind Samoyed.
Next, a few more weird-looking demigod-level creatures approached Samoyed, probing.
Similarly, they were forcefully dismissed by Samoyed.
But because of its injuries, it did not make a move along the way.
What Samoyed didn’t realize is that this very behavior caused those forces and powerhouses of various races to further doubt the Blade Armor Demon’s current state.
And right then, signs of a battle between two demigods suddenly appeared ahead.
One looked like a combination of a hyena and a lion, while the other resembled a chicken.
However, the chicken’s feathers were multicolored, and liquid was dripping from them.
At this moment, the battle between the two high-tier demigods seemed extremely frantic.
Both sides were aggressively attacking.
"Cluck-cluck-cluck!"
The multicolored chicken delivered a peck, leaving a terrifying blood hole on the hyena.
"Awooo—"
The hyena screamed miserably, then turned and bit the chicken.
At this moment, as the fight continued, they began drawing closer to Samoyed.
Samoyed stopped its steps.
Han Xing asked, "What’s the situation, Samoyed?"
Samoyed replied, "Master, it’s a demigod from the Water Poison Lizard Chicken and Gray Rock Dog Lion races having a fight."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing replied, "Avoid them."
Samoyed complied, turning its massive body in the Void.
But just as it was about to evade.
The Water Poison Lizard Chicken and Gray Rock Dog Lion suddenly changed direction, charging at Samoyed at full speed.
At this moment, Samoyed keenly sensed something amiss.
"Hmm? Are these two targeting me?"
Samoyed knew that at such times, it should never show weakness.
Gathering its strength, it ejected a scale from its body, shooting it forward with great intensity!
"Get out of my way!"
Whoosh!
The scale carried the divine-level surge.
The Water Poison Lizard Chicken and Gray Rock Dog Lion showed horrified expressions in their eyes.
For they sensed a crisis of death descending upon them.
Then, the Gray Rock Dog Lion suddenly opened its large mouth, directly swallowing Samoyed’s scale.
Splat!
The scale pierced through its mouth, directly penetrating its body.
Yet, the Gray Rock Dog Lion didn’t die.
Its eyes showed a joyful surprise, having survived a catastrophe.
Then, it shouted loudly in the void, "Moya! You really seem weakened, you couldn’t even kill a demigod like me in one strike anymore!"
"What’s happening to you?"
Samoyed didn’t respond, but a trace of coldness appeared in its eyes.
In the next instant, it ejected four more scales from its body.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The sound of breaking through the air emerged, the four scales transforming into four streaks of light, at terrifying speeds.
Splat! Splat! Splat! Splat!
All four scales hit their marks.
Before the Water Poison Lizard Chicken and Gray Rock Dog Lion could make a sound, they were instantly killed!
Bang!
In that zone, the corpses of the two demigods exploded, and the power of rules shattered into countless pieces, disappearing into the air.
Samoyed snorted coldly.
It noticed that in the surrounding area, many presences were watching.
The Water Poison Lizard Chicken and Dog Lion were likely sent out to test it.
Just now, the move revealed its weakness to those nearby.
But Samoyed had no other choice; it couldn’t just start killing all of them now.
It could only continue to feign strength and leave the area.
Once Samoyed left.
A dozen demigods quickly appeared in the battlefield and exchanged glances.
"Did you notice?"
"I did, Moya indeed seems weakened; it needed two strikes to solve a middle-tier demigod."
"Yes, even its aura is weak, completely unlike a divine-level."
At this time, a creature resembling a tree stump, entirely black and purple, spoke up: "Everyone, report this to our Clan Leader."
"The Blade Armor Demon Race has been stationed near the Forbidden Galaxy for over three thousand years; they must possess many treasures."
"This is a rare opportunity!"
Upon hearing this, the other demigods nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 483: Surrounded by Wolves (Part 2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile, the news of Samoyed, this middle-tier divine spirit, being severely injured, spread quickly.
Soon, it reached the ears of various powerful tribes in the Land of Divine War.
Through various investigative methods, these powerful beings confirmed the truth of this matter.
At this moment.
In a region tens of millions of miles away from Han Xing and his companions.
There is a massive Sky Island City.
This city seems to be built on the back of a gigantic beast.
The beast sprawled there like a white continent, its flesh body enduring eternally.
Its size is actually tens of times larger than the complete Beast of Calamity!
However, its appearance bears no resemblance to the Beast of Calamity.
It is a white giant wolf sleeping in the Void.
On top of this white continent, various buildings are constructed.
There are medieval-style city castles, dark forests, and deep lakes.
This is Silent City.
Every area here represents the power of a tribe.
And among them.
In a city covered with blood and spider webs.
Stands a massive ancient castle.
In the grand hall of the castle.
A woman wearing a long black robe, with a spider’s body but a human head, sits on the throne.
Her appearance is extremely alluring and seductive.
Scarlet lips, long narrow eyes, quite a beauty indeed.
In terms of looks alone, she is no less than the Dark Night Goddess Han Xing has seen.
And at this moment.
The gates of the castle are pushed open.
Above, two creatures with spider bodies haul in the corpse of an insect.
Those two female spiders softly said, "Your Majesty, your dessert has arrived."
At this moment, the Spider Empress licks her lips.
A spider silk shoots out instantly, grabbing the insect.
Then, her alluring face suddenly transforms into a terrifying giant mouth, swallowing the massive insect whole.
"Crunch! Crunch!"
The sound of scales and flesh being crushed resonates.
Moments later.
She contentedly licks her lips.
"Well done, I really liked today’s dessert~"
At this moment, one female spider laughed softly, "Your Majesty, as long as you like it."
Another spider said, "Your Majesty, there is one matter to report to you."
Seated on her throne, the Painful Empress extended her right hand, revealing fingers like black spikes, swaying in the air.
Then, she lightly glanced at the female spider below and asked, "What’s the matter?"
This female spider recounted the intelligence about Moya.
After hearing it, the Painful Empress’s long brows twitched.
"Interesting... The little insect that escaped from us those years ago is severely wounded now?"
"Seems like this is an opportunity for me."
After a moment of contemplation, this noble empress rose from her throne.
Then, using her eight long spider legs, she slowly walked forward.
"Let’s go, it’s time to bring this little insect back into my web."
"No one can escape my control, hehe~"
On this day, the Painful Empress, a top-tier divine spirit who hadn’t moved for a long time, departed from Silent City.
At the same time.
As Samoyed continued moving forward.
The number of strong beings trailing behind also grew.
Apart from the mid-to-high tier demigods.
Han Xing also sensed the presence of two divine spirits.
They seemed to be probing Samoyed’s situation.
Once it showed any sign of weakness, they wouldn’t hesitate to pounce, devouring it completely.
And this, is one of the dangers old tree mentioned.
Without the power of a high-tier demigod, nor a faction to rely on.
Coming to the Land of Divine War leads only to being enslaved or devoured.
Sensing the restless inclination of those beings.
Samoyed spoke from behind: "Master, what now? The followers are increasing!"
Han Xing shook his head and replied, "Don’t mind them, just keep moving forward."
Samoyed nodded without further questions.
Because it trusts its master can resolve everything.
After advancing over two million kilometers.
The gathering of strong beings behind it grew larger.
Han Xing sensed an additional divine spirit’s presence.
They are like wolves in the desert, following from afar.
And at this moment.
One divine-level entity suddenly launched an attack.
Whizz!
A purple vine suddenly grew out of the Void and rushed forward, seemingly trying to pierce Samoyed’s body.
The sudden burst of power surprisingly reached middle-tier divine level.
Samoyed’s eyes showed panic.
Even at its peak, it possessed middle-tier divine level strength, yet had no confidence to withstand this blow.
Let alone now.
In a moment of crisis, Samoyed gritted its teeth, seemingly using some method,
Its black body instantly entered a high-speed spinning state, charging tens of thousands of kilometers, barely dodging the vine’s attack.
"Phew... that was close..."
Samoyed exhaled deeply.
However, it realized that this scene had revealed its situation to the others lurking behind.
Next, those divine spirits will surely make their move.
Samoyed, frowning, worriedly asked, "Master, the one who attacked me earlier is called Borco, a middle-tier divine spirit."
"It already sees my injuries, and is expected to make a move soon."
Han Xing stated, "Samoyed, change direction."
"Where to, Master?"
Han Xing replied, "To a place you think has fewer people, where actions won’t be noticed."

Without the power of a high-tier demigod, nor a faction to rely on.
Coming to the Land of Divine War leads only to being enslaved or devoured.
Sensing the restless inclination of those beings.
Samoyed spoke from behind: "Master, what now?
The followers are increasing!"
Han Xing shook his head and replied, "Don’t mind them, just keep moving forward."
Samoyed nodded without further questions.
Because it trusts its master can resolve everything.
After advancing over two million kilometers.
The gathering of strong beings behind it grew larger.
Han Xing sensed an additional divine spirit’s presence.
They are like wolves in the desert, following from afar.
And at this moment.
One divine-level entity suddenly launched an attack.
Whizz!
A purple vine suddenly grew out of the Void and rushed forward, seemingly trying to pierce Samoyed’s body.
The sudden burst of power surprisingly reached middle-tier divine level.
Samoyed’s eyes showed panic.
Even at its peak, it possessed middle-tier divine level strength, yet had no confidence to withstand this blow.
Let alone now.
In a moment of crisis, Samoyed gritted its teeth, seemingly using some method,
Its black body instantly entered a high-speed spinning state, charging tens of thousands of kilometers, barely dodging the vine’s attack.
"Phew... that was close..."
Samoyed exhaled deeply.
However, it realized that this scene had revealed its situation to the others lurking behind.
Next, those divine spirits will surely make their move.
Samoyed, frowning, worriedly asked, "Master, the one who attacked me earlier is called Borco, a middle-tier divine spirit."
"It already sees my injuries, and is expected to make a move soon."
Han Xing stated, "Samoyed, change direction."
"Where to, Master?"
Han Xing replied, "To a place you think has fewer people, where actions won’t be noticed."

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 483: Encircled by Wolves (Part 3)
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, Samoyed’s expression hardened.
It seemed to understand what Han Xing implied.
It nodded excitedly and said, "Alright, Master."
"I happen to know a place nearby that can shield the fluctuations of the rules."
Then, Samoyed changed its direction, heading to the left side of the Void.
Meanwhile.
The following races were whispering among themselves, "Moya changed direction, do you think it’s trying to escape?"
"I don’t know, let’s follow."
"However, this shows that Samoyed is truly at its limit."
"This creature has been stationed in the Land of Divine War for so long, it must have many treasures."
"Even if it has no treasures, it possesses a mid-level Divine rule of power."
"Borco is originally in the middle-tier Divine realm, if it then devours Moya’s power of rules, it might directly break through to the middle-tier Divine Spirit realm, maybe."
Interests have always moved people’s hearts throughout history.
Even at the Divine level, it’s the same.
Moreover, at this realm, there are almost no treasures that can move these beings.
The remaining goal is to absorb more power of rules and break through to a stronger realm.
Very soon, those strong beings followed Samoyed to an uninhabited area.
The void energy here was extremely chaotic, and there were even energy vortices.
These vortices could directly pull in powerhouses below the Divine Spirit level, then be torn apart by the terrifying energy.
Samoyed released divine power to Han Xing and said, "Master, it’s here."
"The void energy in this area is in a violent state, if a fight breaks out, it won’t be sensed by the outside world."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
"Alright, Samoyed, stop here."
Samoyed finally halted.
At this moment.
Its body, shrinking to a mere five hundred thousand meters, slowly turned and said.
"You guys have been following me all the way, is there something you want?"
At this moment, a being with ant-like antennae on its head, covered with insect carapace, and draped in a black cloak, spoke.
"Moya, we’re just here to see if anything happened to you?"
Beside it, a creature with a rooster-like head also laughed and said, "Moya, Kaggs is right."
"We’re just a bit concerned about you, no other meaning."
Samoyed sneered.
"I’m fine, don’t need your concern."
"If there’s nothing else, you can leave now."
However, upon hearing this.
The three Divine-level creatures, along with the remaining demigods and Divine Spirits, all let out a knowing laugh.
"Moya, you seem to be severely injured?"
"Yes, let us confirm it, if you’re seriously hurt, we’ll take you to Silent City."
After speaking, regardless of whether Samoyed agreed or not, they all closed in on Samoyed together.
Han Xing swept his gaze, fixing his vision on the terrifying aura of those three creatures.
[Giant Whale Ant·Kaggs]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
[Water Poison Lizard Chicken·Eliza]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
[Evil Ghost Tree Demon·Borco]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
[Divine Power Value: ???]
Three Divine-level creatures, hailing from three different worlds.
The mid-to-high tier demigods following behind were also from these three races.
Han Xing, being of too low a level, couldn’t see their specific attributes.
Then, he looked at the God of Radiance beside him and asked, "Radiance, can you probe their strength?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Two low-tier Divine Spirits, one middle-tier Divine Spirit."
"Master, should I intervene?"
Han Xing shook his head, "You’re my trump card, you can’t be exposed so soon."
"Leave these guys to me, it’s fine."
"Your task is, if they try to escape, stop them directly."
The God of Radiance was stunned, then nodded.
He also understood Han Xing’s intention, to prepare to capture all these invading powerhouses in one fell swoop.
Meanwhile.
The three Divine Spirits, with a large group of demigods, pressed step by step.
Samoyed frowned and said, "A word of advice, stop here."
"If you continue to advance, I will consider you enemies."
Samoyed exuded a trace of murderous intent.
However, the Giant Whale Ant and Water Poison Lizard Chicken both laughed, "Moya, you’re being too distant with us, we just want to check in on you,"
The Giant Whale Ant beside it also nodded with a smile.
"Exactly, enemy or not, we’re all members of the Ten Thousand Realms Alliance, we’re allies."
Despite saying so, they were all poised for battle, ready to guard against Samoyed suddenly making a move.
However, after pressing closer for a while, Samoyed still did not attack.
At this moment, the Water Poison Lizard Chicken and the Giant Whale Ant exchanged glances, each seeing the look of joy in the other’s eyes.
"Moya, you appear to be seriously injured."
"Do you need us to take you back to Silent City to recover?"
Samoyed sneered, "No need."
"A word of advice, you’d better leave quickly, or soon, it will be too late to leave!"
However, they completely ignored Samoyed’s warning.
Seeing them about to approach and ready to strike.
At Han Xing’s indication, Samoyed decisively unleashed dozens of scales, shooting them out.
Simultaneously, the pupils of the opposing strong squeezed tightly.
"Moya, you dare to attack me first!"
"Then we won’t be polite to you either!"

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 484: Firepower Suppression, Three Gods Fall!
paragraphs: With those words, the Giant Whale Ant and Water Poison Lizard Chicken simultaneously stirred their Divine Power, and a terrifying aura erupted.
Then, their bodies rapidly transformed, expanding!
In the blink of an eye.
Two colossal figures appeared in the Void.
A creature over a million meters large, covered entirely in white scales.
Beside it was a being with multicolored feathers and the head of a chicken.
The difference was that the chicken had a lizard’s tail.
At the same time, the Giant Whale Ant and Water Poison Lizard Chicken launched attacks concurrently.
Two powerful auras surged forward.
Samoyed was severely injured at the time, forced into a desperate retreat.
However, Samoyed’s move was still a step too slow.
Its tail was pecked by the Water Poison Lizard Chicken’s long beak, bringing forth a splash of blood, staining the Void.
The Water Poison Lizard Chicken squinted, delighted, and said: "Moya, you’ve become so weak?"
"You can’t even muster the power of a top Demigod now."
"All tribesmen, attack!"
Upon hearing these words.
Those Demigod-level beings had no more reservations and simultaneously launched attacks.
Samoyed was struck and fled frantically, continually escaping in the Void.
The group of Divine Spirits and Demigods relentlessly pursued from behind.
"Hahaha! Moya, why are you running?"
"Moya, our tribe’s youngsters want to greet you, don’t be so unfriendly!"
"Useless! Not even a match for a Demigod!"
Listening to the mockery from behind, Samoyed felt deeply aggrieved.
As a Middle-tier Divine Spirit, being chased and beaten by a group of Demigods was indeed embarrassing.
And at that moment, it finally reached the location Han Xing had told it.
Then, Han Xing’s voice sounded softly from behind.
"Samoyed, lower your head."
Although Samoyed didn’t know what was happening, it instinctively chose to comply.
Its body lowered, disappearing on the spot.
Meanwhile.
Those three Divine Spirits and several Demigods suddenly saw Moya falling.
And in the location where it was previously standing, a battleship more than a thousand kilometers long appeared!
This battleship was densely packed with energy cannon ports.
Moreover, these energy cannons instantly entered charging state.
Including the main cannon of the Divine Demon Battleship.
At that moment, confusion appeared in the eyes of those Divine Spirits.
"These... are technological artifacts?"
"Are they allies summoned by Moya?"
The Water Poison Lizard Chicken was greatly puzzled.
The Giant Whale Ant shook its head and said: "Not sure, but no matter how strong technological artifacts are, that’s all they are."
"Able to handle high-tier Demigods is already the limit, having no effect on us Divine Spirits."
The Divine Spirit of the Water Poison Lizard Chicken Race also nodded.
It had lived for many years, being active in this Land of Divine War for so long.
New world powerhouses continually came to the Land of Divine War,
Among them were races exceptionally skilled in technology development.
However, no matter how strong this technology was, since it couldn’t utilize Power of Rules, handling Demigods was already the limit.
It’s simply impossible for technological artifacts to handle Divine Spirit Level.
At this moment, the purple stump hidden among the many Divine Spirits, the only Middle-tier Demigod, issued a command.
"Attack! Capture Moya!"
Powerful beings from each race charged forward.
At this moment, Samoyed could no longer emanate intimidation upon them.
In their eyes, Samoyed had become a tasty piece, everyone wanted a bite.
"Charge!"
"Capture Moya! I also want to break through to Divine Spirit!"
"Hahaha, give me a piece of Divine Format too."
They even thought about dividing up Samoyed’s Divine Format.
And at this moment.
All Defense Towers on the Divine Demon Battleship were quickly fully charged.
A terrifying energy fluctuation immediately radiated outward.
Buzz!
Ripples surfaced in the Void.
At this moment, not only the two Divine Spirits, but also the black-purple tree-stump-like creature behind couldn’t help but lift its head.
"Such strong aura... What is it?"
"Is it the energy cannon on that battleship?"
Incredulous expressions appeared in the eyes of several Divine Spirits and Demigods.
Before they could react.
Han Xing, decisively chose to fire!
"Boom!"
A terrifying attack instantly erupted!
At this moment, the Divine Spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race’s expression drastically changed.
Its true form was exposed instantly.
It was a tree-sized at ten million meters, entirely black-purple, full of devil’s eyes.
The Evil Tree Demon exclaimed in panic: "Hurry away!"
Using almost all its strength, it shouted that, with its voice echoing across the Void.
However, its warning was still a step too late.
Over a hundred [Tower of Annihilation Lightning]’s attacks fused into a terrifying arc over ten thousand meters long, falling instantly.
"Snap!"
In an instant.
That region was engulfed by terrifying power of lightning.
Then, the blue plasma instantly transformed into a sea of blue!
The electrical energy was so terrifying it even formed a dreadful magnetic field.
The magnetic field spun furiously, destroying all matter and energy in the Void!
"Sizzle... Sizzle..."
The hair-raising sound of electric current rang out.
Particles collided madly, generating dreadful heat energy.
This sea of plasma was evolving toward the Sea of Dirac!
Those Middle-tier Demigods, at the moment the plasma sea descended, were already turned to charcoal, their bodies disintegrated into fundamental particles.
And those High-tier Demigods, also entirely charred, bodies convulsing, already on the verge of collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 484: Firepower Suppression, Three Gods Fall! (2)
paragraphs: Relying on their resilient bodies, they barely managed to hold on.
As for the remaining three divine spirits.
They were desperately trying to uphold layers of divine power shields.
These divine power shields were destroyed the instant they appeared.
In order to resist the attacks from the sea of plasma, they could only continuously conjure new divine power shields.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of shattering was incessant.
"Ahhhh! Block it! Block it for me!!"
The giant whale ant shouted in desperation, "Borco! What kind of attack is this?"
"I can’t hold on much longer!"
Meanwhile, the divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race named Borco was also struggling to fend off the devastation of the plasma.
As the only middle-tier divine spirit on the scene.
It extended a few branch-like tendrils, seemingly intending to help the giant whale ant and the water ghost poison lizard.
And at this moment.
The sky was filled with snowflakes, invisible torrential rain.
And attacks from Dark Energy Cannons, Frozen Star Cannons, and Spiritual Gods Cannons all descended upon them.
The most terrifying was the colossal cannon at the bow section of the Divine Demon Battleship, with a diameter reaching nearly ten thousand meters!
"Boom!"
The energy disturbance erupted instantly, reaching the limit of the divine level.
"Top-tier divine spirit! An energy weapon sufficient to make a top-tier divine spirit fall!"
"Damn it! Block it quickly!"
The middle-tier divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race hesitated no longer.
It directly split its massive body, endless branches sprawling crazily, nearly filling the entire void.
"Crash!"
Meanwhile.
The giant whale ant and the water poison lizard chicken realized that the situation was at its most critical, and they unleashed their ultimate techniques.
Three thick nerve networks appeared in the sky.
These were their powers of rules.
The attacks from the Divine Demon Battleship’s main cannon and other energy cannons simultaneously arrived.
Buzz!!!
The area was instantly filled with terrifying energies.
Plasma, ice and snow, rainwater, dark energy, spiritual energy, and the Divine Demon Battleship’s main cannon piercing heaven and earth.
This void erupted into waves of energy storms due to the violent energy fluctuations.
Boom! Boom!
The explosions were incessant.
The Divine Demon Battleship rocked like a small boat in the ocean.
Standing below, Samoyed swallowed hard while watching this scene.
He looked up at the Divine Demon Battleship above, then down at his own injuries.
Only then did he realize that when Han Xing dealt with him, he hadn’t even used full strength.
Now, he witnessed how terrifying the Divine Demon Battleship, or rather Ten Thousand Stars City, was in its full burst state.
Despite the three divine spirits jointly resisting.
Even summoning the power of rules.
Above that void, three glowing nerve networks appeared.
Due to the frantic absorption of the power of rules, those three nerve networks radiated endless light.
However, despite this.
Their power still seemed minuscule compared to the concentrated fire of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Crack! Crack!
In Samoyed’s shocked gaze.
Countless cracks appeared on the two smaller nerve networks.
Then, with a crisp sound.
The entire void within billions of kilometers fell into a terrifying tremor again.
This was a sign of a divine spirit’s fall!
Samoyed’s eyes widened in horror, "Dead... they are dead..."
Two of the top-tier powerhouses that had roamed the Land of Divine War for thousands of years fell just like that.
They couldn’t even make a sound before falling on the spot.
The remaining thicker energy nerve was not broken but was covered with dense cracks.
Rumble——
The energy storms swept across in waves.
Moments later.
The first wave of concentrated fire from Ten Thousand Stars City came to an end.
Meanwhile.
Samoyed saw that the giant whale ant and the water poison lizard chicken had disappeared.
The moment their body rule networks broke, they were reduced to basic particles by the terrifying energy bombardment.
Only five blue glowing divine formats and five green glowing divine formats remained, floating in the void.
As for the middle-tier demigods and high-tier demigods, they were dead with nothing left.
At this moment, Samoyed truly realized how terrifying the firepower on that warship was.
In addition, there was a heavily scarred huge tree stump spanning across the void.
It was the middle-tier divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
With the deaths of the other two divine spirits, it managed to block Han Xing’s wave of concentrated fire without dying.
However, like the Blade Armor Demon, it was now completely out of combat strength.
No, it was even worse off than the Blade Armor Demon.
At least the Blade Armor Demon retained its consciousness.
This Evil Ghost Tree Demon had fallen into a state of spiritual collapse.
Seeing this, the Blade Armor Demon cracked a smile.
No need for Han Xing to say anything more.
It rushed over, grabbed the trunk of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon, and slapped it across the face.
"Slap!"
"Borco, wake up for me!"
However, the Evil Ghost Tree Demon had already fallen into deep coma, no slapping could wake it.
Samoyed, upon seeing this, showed no mercy and started slapping continuously.
"Slap! Slap slap slap!"
It mercilessly slapped again and again.
The sounds of crisp slaps echoed continuously throughout the void.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, watching the commotion with amusement, said, "Samoyed, that guy, is venting some personal vendetta."
Cheng Jianyong echoed, "Haha, indeed, but who told this big tree stump to target it."
"By the way, he’d better control himself, don’t slap this big tree stump to death."

The giant whale ant shouted in desperation, "Borco!

"I can’t hold on much longer!"
Meanwhile, the divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race named Borco was also struggling to fend off the devastation of the plasma.
As the only middle-tier divine spirit on the scene.
It extended a few branch-like tendrils, seemingly intending to help the giant whale ant and the water ghost poison lizard.
And at this moment.
The sky was filled with snowflakes, invisible torrential rain.
And attacks from Dark Energy Cannons, Frozen Star Cannons, and Spiritual Gods Cannons all descended upon them.
The most terrifying was the colossal cannon at the bow section of the Divine Demon Battleship, with a diameter reaching nearly ten thousand meters!
"Boom!"
The energy disturbance erupted instantly, reaching the limit of the divine level.
"Top-tier divine spirit!
An energy weapon sufficient to make a top-tier divine spirit fall!"
"Damn it!
Block it quickly!"
The middle-tier divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race hesitated no longer.
It directly split its massive body, endless branches sprawling crazily, nearly filling the entire void.
"Crash!"
Meanwhile.
The giant whale ant and the water poison lizard chicken realized that the situation was at its most critical, and they unleashed their ultimate techniques.
Three thick nerve networks appeared in the sky.
These were their powers of rules.
The attacks from the Divine Demon Battleship’s main cannon and other energy cannons simultaneously arrived.
Buzz!!!
The area was instantly filled with terrifying energies.
Plasma, ice and snow, rainwater, dark energy, spiritual energy, and the Divine Demon Battleship’s main cannon piercing heaven and earth.
This void erupted into waves of energy storms due to the violent energy fluctuations.
Boom!
Boom!
The explosions were incessant.
The Divine Demon Battleship rocked like a small boat in the ocean.
Standing below, Samoyed swallowed hard while watching this scene.
He looked up at the Divine Demon Battleship above, then down at his own injuries.
Only then did he realize that when Han Xing dealt with him, he hadn’t even used full strength.
Now, he witnessed how terrifying the Divine Demon Battleship, or rather Ten Thousand Stars City, was in its full burst state.
Despite the three divine spirits jointly resisting.
Even summoning the power of rules.
Above that void, three glowing nerve networks appeared.
Due to the frantic absorption of the power of rules, those three nerve networks radiated endless light.
However, despite this.
Their power still seemed minuscule compared to the concentrated fire of Ten Thousand Stars City.
Crack!
Crack!
In Samoyed’s shocked gaze.
Countless cracks appeared on the two smaller nerve networks.
Then, with a crisp sound.
The entire void within billions of kilometers fell into a terrifying tremor again.
This was a sign of a divine spirit’s fall!
Samoyed’s eyes widened in horror, "Dead... they are dead..."
Two of the top-tier powerhouses that had roamed the Land of Divine War for thousands of years fell just like that.
They couldn’t even make a sound before falling on the spot.
The remaining thicker energy nerve was not broken but was covered with dense cracks.
Rumble——
The energy storms swept across in waves.
Moments later.
The first wave of concentrated fire from Ten Thousand Stars City came to an end.
Meanwhile.
Samoyed saw that the giant whale ant and the water poison lizard chicken had disappeared.
The moment their body rule networks broke, they were reduced to basic particles by the terrifying energy bombardment.
Only five blue glowing divine formats and five green glowing divine formats remained, floating in the void.
As for the middle-tier demigods and high-tier demigods, they were dead with nothing left.
At this moment, Samoyed truly realized how terrifying the firepower on that warship was.
In addition, there was a heavily scarred huge tree stump spanning across the void.
It was the middle-tier divine spirit of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon Race.
With the deaths of the other two divine spirits, it managed to block Han Xing’s wave of concentrated fire without dying.
However, like the Blade Armor Demon, it was now completely out of combat strength.
No, it was even worse off than the Blade Armor Demon.
At least the Blade Armor Demon retained its consciousness.
This Evil Ghost Tree Demon had fallen into a state of spiritual collapse.
Seeing this, the Blade Armor Demon cracked a smile.
No need for Han Xing to say anything more.
It rushed over, grabbed the trunk of the Evil Ghost Tree Demon, and slapped it across the face.
"Slap!"
"Borco, wake up for me!"
However, the Evil Ghost Tree Demon had already fallen into deep coma, no slapping could wake it.
Samoyed, upon seeing this, showed no mercy and started slapping continuously.
"Slap!
Slap slap slap!"
It mercilessly slapped again and again.
The sounds of crisp slaps echoed continuously throughout the void.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun, watching the commotion with amusement, said, "Samoyed, that guy, is venting some personal vendetta."
Cheng Jianyong echoed, "Haha, indeed, but who told this big tree stump to target it."
"By the way, he’d better control himself, don’t slap this big tree stump to death."

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 484: Firepower Suppression, Three Deities Fall! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing smiled and led the team out of the warship.
Then came to the side of the ten floating divine formats.
At this moment.
Under the traction of his divine power.
Five blue divine formats merged together, forming a new nerve network, which is a complete rule.
The other five green divine formats did the same.
They were all drawn and formed by him.
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of these two nerve networks appeared.
[Power of Rules]: Special item.
[Attributes]: Ant
[Effect]: The complete ’Ant’ rule can, upon reaching the demigod limit, break through to the divine realm and become the new Ant God, or be directly absorbed to increase 10,000 divine power values.
[Power of Rules]: Special item.
[Attributes]: Poison

[Effect]: The complete ’Poison’ rule can, upon reaching the demigod limit, break through to the divine realm and become the new Poison God, or be directly absorbed to increase 10,000 divine power values.
A look of surprise appeared on Han Xing’s face.
"Great, great, I collected two complete rules again,"
"Now, I have three semi-complete rules in my hands!"
"This Land of Divine War was really the right place to come!"
Before this, encountering a single divine spirit was extremely difficult for Han Xing.
But in the Land of Divine War, divine spirits are obviously common.
There are quite a few middle-to-high tier divine spirits.
As long as you have the strength, you can quickly become stronger here.
At the same time, Han Xing looked at the Evil Tree Demon being continuously slapped by Samoyed.
This guy was also a middle-tier divine spirit.
After being slapped by Samoyed for half a day, the Evil Tree Demon finally woke up.
It looked blankly at Han Xing and the others ahead, and the Blade Armor Demon beside it gripping its head.
"Moya..."
The next moment, it seemed to understand something, and a look of fear appeared in its eyes.
Buzz!
A wave of purple divine power appeared on its body.
At this moment, Samoyed’s eyes moved.
"Hmm, trying to run?
Its tail flicked directly at the Evil Tree Demon.
"Poof!"
The Evil Tree Demon spewed a mouthful of black blood again, and its attempted escape was interrupted.
"Cough, cough..."
"Moya... you tricked me!"
The Evil Tree Demon said hatefully, seeming very unconvinced.
Samoyed rolled its eyes and said, "Who tricked you?"
"Obviously, you guys were plotting against me, seen through by my master!"
"Now you’re on the verge of death, and it’s your own doing."
Hearing Moya mention its master, a look of astonishment flashed in the Evil Tree Demon’s eyes.
The Evil Tree Demon spoke with difficulty, "Cough, cough... who is this master you speak of?"
"Is it that one?"
It looked toward the God of Radiance behind it.
Because up to now, it hadn’t sensed the aura from this presence.
And to achieve this, it was clearly a presence greater than itself.
However, Moya shook its head and said, "Don’t look around, my master is this one."
It looked toward Han Xing.
As the Evil Tree Demon sensed Han Xing’s strength, a puzzled expression appeared in its eyes: "Moya, are you serious?"
"You truly acknowledged this legendary level human as your master?"
Samoyed nodded and said, "Could there be any falsehood?"
Hearing these words, a twisted smile appeared on the Evil Tree Demon’s face.
It opened its cracked mouth and laughed up to the sky.
"Ha ha! Ha ha ha ha!"
"A middle-tier divine spirit like you actually acknowledged a legend as your master, that’s laughable!"
"Ha ha ha ha! Worthless Moya!"
Its laughter was uninhibited, echoing in this void.
Han Xing also laughed and said, "Is it very funny?"
The Evil Tree Demon responded while laughing, "Of course it’s funny!"
"A middle-tier divine spirit acknowledging a legend as a master."
"It’s like having a giant dragon at the beck and call of an ant."
"It truly disgraces us divine spirits!"
The Evil Tree Demon directly cursed.
However, Samoyed remained unmoved.
If it were before, it might have thought like the Evil Tree Demon.
However, after witnessing Han Xing’s terrifying strength, it had completely submitted.
Cheng Jianyong laughed at this moment: "You sorry excuse for a tree stump, why don’t you look at your situation first before talking?"
But the Evil Tree Demon laughed and said, "So what?"
"Aren’t I just about to be beaten to death by you?"
Hearing this, everyone frowned.
The Evil Tree Demon continued, "I know, you spared me so you want me to submit to you like Moya."
"But I’ll tell you! That’s impossible!"
"I’m not some worthless being like Moya."
"Even if I die on the spot, I will never submit to an ant."
Hearing this, Han Xing understood its intention.
Nodded and said, "Alright, then as you wish."
With those words, Han Xing pulled out an arrow.
At this time, the Evil Tree Demon was already in a dying state.
In this condition, even a demigod could come and take it down.
And this time, Han Xing directly used the ultimate skill—the Sun-Destroying Arrow.
Whoosh!
The flame ignited.
Feeling the terror of this arrow, the Evil Tree Demon exclaimingly said, "Wait, what do you want to do?"
Han Xing coldly said, "Weren’t you asking for death? I’ll grant it."
"No! That’s not what I meant, why don’t you use that energy cannon on the warship to blast me to death!"
"I’d rather die under those energy cannons than at your hands!"
However, Han Xing sneered and said, "That’s not for you to decide."
"You’re just a dying creature, not qualified to negotiate with me."
Under the watchful eyes of everyone.
This enormous Evil Tree Demon was enveloped by a huge sun.
"Boom!"
The terrifying energy unleashed.
The Evil Tree Demon screamed in despair, "No!!!"
Crack!
The thick nerve network above its head shattered directly.
And the Evil Tree Demon’s voice abruptly stopped.
A system prompt appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 485: The Mighty Divine Demon Battleship
paragraphs: [Successfully killed Evil Ghost Tree Demon·Borco (Middle-tier Divine Spirit), gained 27.69132 trillion Experience Value (Experience Value has reached the limit), automatically absorbed the Divine Power from the opponent, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Due to your outstanding Battle Merit this time, received extra reward: Legendary Points +1000]
Meanwhile.
Everyone looked towards the sky above.
The fragmented Power of Rules gradually gathered together, then transformed into ten dark purple Divine Formats.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
"Oh? Wow, there are actually ten Divine Formats!"
He stepped forward.
After collecting all these Divine Formats, he synthesized a complete Nerve Network.
In front of him, the attributes of this rule also appeared.
[Power of Rules]: Special Item.
[Attributes]: Evil Ghost

[Effect]: Complete ’Evil Ghost’ rule, can break through to Divine Realm upon reaching demigod limits, becoming the new God of Evil Ghosts, or can directly absorb, increasing Divine Power Value by 20,000 points.
Comparing to the previous two rules, this Power of Rules provides more Divine Power Value upon absorption.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
He had no extra thoughts about the Evil Ghost Tree Demon’s refusal to submit.
In any case, whether it was willing to serve or not, Han Xing wouldn’t suffer any loss.
"Very good, now I have four half-complete Powers of Rules in my hand."
"Just five and a half more to complete one of the conditions for breaking through demigod."
"Then enhance Divine Power Value by more than a hundred thousand, and I can start attempting the breakthrough."
From their arrival at the Land of Divine War, less than a day had passed.
Han Xing accomplished such a terrifying melee, it can be said to be rapid.
"Samoyed, continue leading the way, we are heading to the territory of those Bone-Eroding Griffins."
At this moment, Samoyed was already thoroughly convinced.
It almost followed Han Xing’s commands without question.
It twisted its massive body and walked towards the outside.
Before long, it led Han Xing out of this chaotic area.
And Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship remained hidden behind Samoyed.
Meanwhile, the moment Samoyed re-emerged, many powers tracking it also immediately noticed its whereabouts.
Those demigods behind discussed: "Strange, why did Moya come out?"
"Could it be, Borco let Moya go?"
"Impossible, right? The Divine Spirits from the Giant Whale Ant Race and Water Poison Lizard Chicken Race went together, they shouldn’t have let Moya go."
They kept speculating.
"But, something’s wrong!"
"Why didn’t Borco and the others come out?"
The demigods were extremely puzzled, they absolutely wouldn’t have guessed.
In less than ten minutes.
Three Divine Spirits, plus more than a dozen demigods, all perished in that Void.
Their bones completely vanished.
Samoyed ignored the demigods and led Han Xing forward.
After they left, those demigods rushed into the void area one after another.
As soon as they entered, they felt intense energy fluctuations.
Including divine-level combat aura.
"Seems there was a battle here, I also sensed Borco and two other Divine Spirits’ auras."
"Damn it, where are they now?"
This was the issue all the strong figures were concerned with.
That was, where did the three Divine Spirits go!
"Search nearby, see if any clues can be found."
Upon hearing this, the demigods of each race began to take action.
If they couldn’t find anything, they would definitely go mad!
After all, these were three Divine Spirits, including one Middle-tier Divine Spirit.
If they all disappeared, that would be a matter shocking the entire Forbidden Galaxy!
After a period of searching.
A creature resembling a centaur found a piece of wood debris in the Void.
This piece of wood debris still had an eye on it.
The right hand of the centaur holding the debris trembled slightly.
It exclaimed in a terrified tone: "This this this..."
"Could this be Borco’s body fragment?"
The centaur was suddenly startled by its own thought.
Then, it quickly summoned other demigods over.
"Come quickly! I found something here!"
Meanwhile, nearby demigods gathered around.
After some research, they finally confirmed, this was Borco’s body fragment.
The Middle-tier Divine Spirit, died!
A chill surged from their feet to their heads!
Fear showed in all demigods’ eyes.
"Oh my god! Borco is dead!"
"It was a Middle-tier Divine Spirit, with two Low-tier Divine Spirits beside it!"
"What kind of existence could silently eliminate such a strong one?"
They suddenly thought of a possibility.
"Do you think it might be Moya, deliberately faking injured state?"
"Might it have broken through to High-tier Divine Spirit, then pretended to be injured to lure Borco and the others?"
"Then eliminate them in one wave, devouring the Power of Rules from these beings?"
After the demigod spoke, other strong figures also considered this possibility.
Clearly, this was the most likely guess.
They all stopped speaking, and all demigod-level strong silently departed.
The news about this spread swiftly, reaching the ears of those powerful in the Forbidden Galaxy region.
Upon learning that Moya might not be injured, merely pretending, the entire Forbidden Star River stirred.
All races preparing to strike the Blade Armor Demon Race halted their actions.
Including those demigod strong already surrounded the Blade Armor Demon Race’s Sky Island, they fled in first fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 485: Powerful Divine Demon Battleship (2)
paragraphs: They originally planned to wait until Moya confirmed the news over there and was truly incapable, then directly make a move to seize the Blade Armor Demon Race’s treasure.
But now, they could only hope that Moya wouldn’t cause them any trouble.
Meanwhile.
The Painful Empress, who was rushing over.
A top-tier Divine Spirit also received the news.
She stopped her steps in the void, then said with keen interest, "Oh? This little bug broke through to a high-tier Divine Spirit? Even killed Borco?"
"Interesting..."
She stretched out her spike-like fingers, randomly grabbing in the void.
The two female spiders following behind her also asked confusedly, "Your Majesty, do we still need to find Moya?"
The Painful Empress pondered for a moment and shook her head.
She didn’t speak, but her eyes gazed ahead.
If any other creatures were here, they would definitely put things down in terror.
In this area, in the void spanning hundreds of thousands of miles, a terrifying giant net had appeared.
In the void, Moya was still constantly absorbing the energy in the void to heal his injuries.
He also noticed that the demigods and divine spirits following him were getting fewer and fewer.
Moya turned his head and said, "Master, it seems like no other guys are following us anymore."
Han Xing, upon hearing this, said, "No more? They dared not continue probing after just one time?"
He appeared a bit regretful.
After all, he still wanted to use Samoyed to reel in a few more catches.
If a few more divine spirits came to cause them trouble.
By then, Han Xing might not need to find those Bone-Eroding Griffins and could gather the conditions to break through to demigod.
Moya, with a somewhat forced smile, said, "The races that can thrive in the Forbidden Star River all have their own unique ways of survival."
"Their perception of crisis is very sharp, and they are very cautious."
"This time, Master directly took down three divine spirits, including Borco.
"They definitely dare not act rashly now."
Han Xing nodded and didn’t think too much.
After all, even if those guys didn’t come, Han Xing could also proceed with the original plan.
Han Xing had Samoyed advance at full speed.
He knew that after this, the strong ones in the Forbidden Star River would investigate Borco’s death.
Relying on the means of those divine spirits, they would soon know that Borco was not killed by Moya.
But by a powerful energy weapon.
Therefore, his strength couldn’t be hidden for long.
And Han Xing’s goal was to reap enough benefits before he was thoroughly exposed!
"Buzz!"
The Divine Demon Battleship advanced at full power.
As they hadn’t activated the teleportation function.
They spent nearly six hours.
Before reaching the position Samoyed mentioned.
From afar, everyone saw a gigantic bird’s nest appearing in the void.
This bird’s nest was constructed entirely from various metal frameworks and wood.
A layer of dry grass was spread over the surface.
The diameter of this bird’s nest at least reached a million kilometers.
Almost rivaling the size of a star.
Moreover, inside that bird’s nest, Han Xing sensed a vast number of life forms.
Even those below Tier One were there.
"Samoyed, is that the nest of the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race?"
The Blade Armor Demon nodded, "Yes, Master."
"This is the lair of those Bone-Eroding Griffins. They breed offspring here and place resources they’ve looted from all over in this nest."
"However, because a Divine Spirit Level being has long been stationed at this nest, other races in the void don’t dare to covet it."
Han Xing asked, "Can you sense if the Bone-Eroding Griffin that took away half of your rule is in there?"
Moya released divine power and carefully sensed for a moment.
After a while, his expression brightened, "It’s there, Master. I’ve sensed its presence!"
Han Xing nodded, "Then go, ask that guy to return that half rule."
"At your command, Master."
Samoyed nodded.
Then, he flew directly to the front of the nest and loudly shouted, "Franco, come out for me!"
"Come out!!"
"Come out!!!"
The voice transformed into sound waves and spread millions of miles.
The entire bird’s nest was silent for a moment, then a dense flapping of wings sounded.
"Roar! Roar!"
Billions of Bone-Eroding Griffins flew up from the bird’s nest.
The terrifying number directly covered the sky.
These griffins had lion bodies, vulture heads, and two black wings.
Billions of pairs of avian eyes all locked onto Samoyed’s massive body, with specters of ghost fire appearing in their violet eyes.
After a moment, a Bone-Eroding Griffin with three heads flew out from the flock.
Its six eyes gazed at the Blade Armor Demon, and with keen interest, it said, "Moya, are you talking to me?"
Samoyed nodded, "What else?"
"Three hundred years ago, it was you who snatched away half my Power of Rules."
Upon hearing this, the Bone-Eroding Griffin froze for a moment.
It seemed not to have expected Moya to still come looking for that half rule after so long.
In this case, of course, it couldn’t admit it.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin sneered, "Moya, you say I snatched it, so I snatched it?"
"Do you have any evidence?"
Hearing this, Samoyed knew that the other party intended to deny it to the end.
"Franco, I’d advise you to obediently hand it over. If you remain stubborn, you may attract endless troubles."
"By then, it won’t end well for you."
Hearing this, the Bone-Eroding Griffin on the other side burst into laughter.
