chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 485: The Powerful Divine Demon Battleship (Part 3)
paragraphs: Then, his eyes turned cold, and he asked, "Moya, have you recently gone mad?"
"Do you know who you are talking to?"
"I hunted you down for twenty years back in the day, almost drove you out of the Forbidden Galaxy."
"To beg me to spare you, you willingly became my mount for two years."
"And now, you dare speak to me like this?"
Samoyed’s face immediately fell.
He hadn’t expected this Vulture would divulge his embarrassing past directly.
Yet Han Xing and the others had awkward expressions.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "Wow, I didn’t think Samoyed had such tragic moments, being chased for twenty years and even becoming a mount, tsk tsk!"
Shen Yun also laughed, "Indeed, no wonder Samoyed is so afraid of Bone-Eroding Griffin Race."
This matter, Han Xing and the others previously hadn’t heard of it.
It seems now, Samoyed intends to use Han Xing’s Power to retaliate against this group of Bone-Eroding Griffins.
This guy looks a bit straightforward, but he’s actually quite cunning.

Samoyed was embarrassed being exposed in public, reluctantly turned around and said, "Master, that’s all in the past, later when I broke through to Middle-tier Divine Spirit, I wasn’t afraid of it anymore."
Han Xing waved his hand dismissively, indicating Samoyed to continue talking.
However, before Moya could say more.
He was already surrounded by numerous Bone-Eroding Griffins, encircling Han Xing and the others.
"Franco, what are you trying to do?" Samoyed asked coldly.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin named Franco laughed, "Moya, I heard you got seriously injured, nearly lost your life."
"I sensed it, your aura is indeed very weak, it should be true."
"Although I don’t know who hurt you, since you’ve come forth, I won’t be polite!"
Franco directly flapped his wings, ready to charge at Moya.
Moya loudly questioned, "Franco, you better think clearly, if you act against me now, you won’t end it well!"
However, Franco on the opposite side laughed aloud, "End it? How do you want me to not end it well?"
"Moya, let me tell you!"
"Hundreds of years ago, I already wanted to devour you, but never found the opportunity!"
"I’ve been circling your Blade Armor Demon Race’s territory for many times, sometimes craving ridiculously, secretly ate a couple of your Demigods.
Speaking here, the Griffin licked its lips, drool running down its mouth.
Yet Moya was shocked and furious, "Damn, turns out the Demigods who died in my race over the years were eaten by you!"
"Franco, you insidious creature!"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin’s expression didn’t change, still carrying a mad look said, "That’s right, I not only ate your people, now I’m going to swallow you too."
"Moya, don’t resist, let me swallow you willingly!"
"Perhaps, by consuming your Power of Rules, I might break through to High-tier Divine Spirit at once."
"By then, you will join me in enjoying that supreme glory!"
Moya still wanted to say something.
The opponent didn’t want to continue talks with Samoyed, directly commanding a large number of Bone-Eroding Griffins to attack them.
"Damn it!"
Samoyed didn’t expect this guy to be so decisive.
This Bone-Eroding Griffin has the strength of a Middle-tier Divine Spirit, which is also its confidence.
As more and more Bone-Eroding Griffins surrounded them.
Moya looked helplessly towards the Divine Demon Battleship behind.
Because right now he really had no combat ability.
Han Xing nodded, "It seems, these Bone-Eroding Griffins are indeed like you said, extremely arrogant and unable to communicate."
"Step back, leave this to me."
At those words, Han Xing directly controlled all energy cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, entering charge mode.
"Buzz!"
The Void was stirred.
Terrifying energy fluctuations spilled forth!
The Bone-Eroding Griffin named Franco noticeably felt something was amiss.
"Moya, what did you do?"
"Why is there such intense Divine Power fluctuations?"
Moya looked at him and said, "Franco, I told you, if you don’t listen, you will attract endless troubles for yourself."
"Now, retribution is here."
Then, under the frightened gaze of the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
Moya suddenly fell rapidly downward.
And behind him, a Divine Demon Battleship spanning thousands of kilometers, filled with various energy cannons appeared.
"What is... this thing?"
Franco wondered, "A battleship? Moya, you’re not seriously relying on this to deal with a Middle-tier Divine Spirit, are you?"
Moya didn’t speak.
Because at this moment the Divine Demon Battleship had finished charging.
The next moment, all energy cannon towers unleashed firepower in all directions, 360 degrees without pattern.
"Boom!"
Mushroom clouds of various colors rose consecutively.
An area within hundreds of thousands of kilometers was instantly enveloped by terrifying energy fluctuations.
After the first wave of attacks dissipated.
The Divine Level Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes shifted from initial confusion to horror.
Because it saw, the tens of billions of Griffin comrades sent to besiege, were completely wiped out.
It felt its heart bleed after the initial shock.
That was, their Bone-Eroding Griffin Race, accumulated over thousands of years, only to be wiped out in one stroke, not even bone fragments left!
"Damn! What happened?"
This Divine Level Bone-Eroding Griffin, apart from surging resentment.
More was terror!
From that wave of attacks it felt a deadly sense of crisis.
If those shells weren’t targeting other Griffins, but hit it.
Then it might have fallen instantly!
"Moya! What is this thing?"
"How can there be such powerful technology cannon towers?"

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 486: The Fourth Power of Rules
paragraphs: "Moya! What is that thing?"
"How can there be such a powerful Technology Defense Tower?"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin asked in terror.
However, Samoyed just shook his head. "Why should I explain anything to you?"
"Weren’t you acting all high and mighty?"
"Weren’t you planning to eat me?"
"Franco, why aren’t you laughing anymore?"
"Ahahahaha!"
Right now Samoyed’s eyes were full of smug delight.
He saw the heartache in this Divine Level Griffin’s eyes, and inside he was overflowing with the thrill of revenge!
Chasing me for twenty years, making me your mount—karma’s here now, isn’t it?
But at this moment, that Bone-Eroding Griffin called Franco was staring at Han Xing’s battleship with eyes full of hatred.
He had been completely Devoured by hatred, even forgetting how terrifying that last wave of Attack had been.
"You damned bastards! I don’t care who you are!"
"You slaughtered so many of my own kind, I’ll make you pay in blood!"
"All clansmen, kill with me!"
As his words fell, he beat his wings, turning into a streak of purple light, and charged madly toward Han Xing and the others.
At the same time.
Inside that massive Bird’s Nest, hundreds of millions of Bone-Eroding Griffins followed Franco’s order and took to the air together.
Their eyes were blood-Red, itching to tear this battleship to pieces!
In that instant, Han Xing finally understood what Samoyed meant.
This Bone-Eroding Griffin Race really held grudges!
Facing an enemy, they were insanely ferocious, even though Han Xing had just focused fire in one wave to show his strength.
Yet these Bone-Eroding Griffins still charged in without regard for their own lives.
They were willing to pay with their Life just to rip a chunk of flesh off Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship.
However, along the way Han Xing and the others had seen races even crazier than them.
In terms of brutality, this Bone-Eroding Griffin flock couldn’t compare to those Demons from the Abyss Realm at all.
Their strength was far inferior too.
And Han Xing felt no pity whatsoever.
He simply kept driving all kinds of cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, starting a frenzied massacre.
"Boom! Boom!"
This stretch of Void was shaken again and again by all sorts of terrifying Energy Cannons.
Almost every second, hundreds of millions of Bone-Eroding Griffins were vaporized, no corpses left behind.
That Bone-Eroding Griffin with Mid-level Divine strength had just wanted to rush in.
Han Xing directly fired up the Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon and all the Towers of Annihilation Lightning, blasting out in one volley!
"Weng!"
A column of Energy with a diameter of over ten thousand meters appeared.
15,000,000 Attack Power, enough to heavily wound a Middle-tier Divine Spirit.
This Divine Level Griffin’s six pupils shrank sharply, utterly shocked.
"Damn it! There’s actually an Energy Cannon even stronger than those Technology Defense Towers!"
In his panic, this Divine Level Griffin could only scramble to dodge.
But in just those few short seconds.
The Griffins that had rushed in were already slaughtered by the Divine Demon Battleship by more than half.
This Divine Level Griffin may have barely dodged that one strike,
but as he watched his clansmen die one after another,
he finally realized what a terrifying enemy he’d provoked!
Before absolute firepower suppression, it wasn’t about how vicious they were.
Nor could sheer numbers solve the opponent.
And when he finally realized this, it was already too late.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin Race had already been slaughtered by the Divine Demon Battleship by nearly eighty percent.
This Divine Level Griffin screamed in terror, "Come back! All of you, come back!"
"Don’t rush in anymore, don’t rush in!"
However, it was easy for those Bone-Eroding Griffins to charge in, but now it was hard for them to escape.
Within Han Xing’s fire coverage, mushroom clouds rose one after another, triggering violent commotion in the Void.
And Han Xing was still shelling without pause.
The Void Energy mixed with the explosive Energy from these Defense Towers, triggering some kind of strange reaction.
All around, terrifying Energy Vortexes appeared one after another.
Every Bone-Eroding Griffin that got close was dragged in by the vortex, unable to move at all.
Even Han Xing’s Divine Demon Battleship started spinning wildly under the pull of the vortex.
Inside the cabin, everyone steadied themselves, feeling the world spin around them.
"Damn... what the hell is going on?"
"I’m seriously getting dizzy here!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise.
Han Xing said, "Everyone, release Divine Power to resist the pull of the vortices around us."
Then he added another line.
"Radiance, you don’t need to release Divine Power, don’t expose yourself."
Everyone followed his orders.
Although the God of Radiance didn’t make a move.
The five of them were all beings with extremely powerful Divine Power.
Very soon, they managed to stop the crazily spinning Divine Demon Battleship.
At the same time.
Only then did everyone realize that all the Bone-Eroding Griffins around them had already been completely wiped out.
Then Han Xing aimed the cannons of the Divine Demon Battleship at that Divine Level Bone-Eroding Griffin.
Through the terrifying Energy Vortex, that Divine Level Griffin’s eyes filled with fear.
At this moment, he no longer cared about so-called hatred or so-called pride.
"Gaa!"
He let out a strange shriek toward the sky, flapped his wings and started fleeing madly.
He didn’t even care about his lair anymore.
As they watched him fly farther and farther away,
Samoyed, trapped in the Void Vortex, grew visibly anxious.
"Master, Franco is about to escape. With this guy’s personality, once he gets away this time, he’ll definitely hide far away."
"And he’ll keep watching us from the shadows, looking for a chance to take revenge."
Han Xing heard this and nodded. "Got it. Samoyed, you stay here and wait for us for now."

Very soon, they managed to stop the crazily spinning Divine Demon Battleship.
At the same time.
Only then did everyone realize that all the Bone-Eroding Griffins around them had already been completely wiped out.
Then Han Xing aimed the cannons of the Divine Demon Battleship at that Divine Level Bone-Eroding Griffin.
Through the terrifying Energy Vortex, that Divine Level Griffin’s eyes filled with fear.
At this moment, he no longer cared about so-called hatred or so-called pride.
"Gaa!"
He let out a strange shriek toward the sky, flapped his wings and started fleeing madly.
He didn’t even care about his lair anymore.
As they watched him fly farther and farther away,
Samoyed, trapped in the Void Vortex, grew visibly anxious.
"Master, Franco is about to escape.
With this guy’s personality, once he gets away this time, he’ll definitely hide far away."
"And he’ll keep watching us from the shadows, looking for a chance to take revenge."
Han Xing heard this and nodded.
"Got it.
Samoyed, you stay here and wait for us for now."

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 486: Power of Rules No. 4_2
paragraphs: The Blade Armor Demon’s eyes showed a hint of confusion.
Han Xing did not explain.
Instead, he directly pressed the [Teleportation] button.
He added to the control center of the warship, "Activate low-power teleportation mode, set this teleportation distance to 3 million kilometers."
The Bone-Eroding Griffin had only escaped for a few seconds.
The mobility of a Middle-tier Divine Spirit is indeed strong.
However, it’s impossible to cover tens of millions of kilometers in an instant.
The voice broadcast appeared.
"Command received, low-power teleportation state is being activated, countdown three seconds..."
"Three..."
"Buzz!"
The Divine Demon Battleship directly disappeared from its original location.
And directly crossed the terrifying Void Vortex area.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin, in a frantic escape, had eyes filled with not only fear but also a venomous look.
"Damn it! Damn it all!!!"
"Moya! You actually brought such a strong individual to deal with me!"
"If I, Franco, escape today, I will definitely get my revenge!"
"I will slaughter all of you and throw you into the nest to feed my young!"
"And those on that warship, I will definitely rip out your intestines and give you the cruelest death to vent the hatred in my heart!"
However, before it could finish speaking, it saw a ripple appear in the void.
A massive warship swiftly passed by its side.
"Buzz!"
Then, this warship directly revealed itself and blocked its path.
At this moment, intense fear appeared once more in the eyes of the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
It had never seen such a strange warship.
Not only did it possess terrifying firepower enough to slay a god, but it also had at least High-tier Divine Spirit level mobility.
"What kind of warship is this!?" the Bone-Eroding Griffin questioned.
Han Xing did not answer its question.
Instead, he calmly said, "Choose, submit or die."
At this moment, the Bone-Eroding Griffin sensed Han Xing’s power through the wave of Divine Power.
Hearing Han Xing’s words, it was momentarily stunned.
Moments later, it sneered, "You want me to submit to a Legend? Wishful thinking!"
Han Xing nodded slightly and said no more.
In the next moment, he directly activated all the energy cannons and Calamity Defense Towers on the warship, plus a Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin sensed the energy fluctuations, and its expression changed.
It instantly flapped its wings and disappeared from its original position.
And when it saw that the warship was still adjusting its attack angle to follow its shadow.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin seemed to understand something.
It shouted loudly, "I see, the technological weapons on this warship are powerful, but they also have obvious weaknesses!"
"You simply can’t keep up with Divine-level movement speed!"
"I know your weakness now, you can’t kill me today, hahaha!"
Han Xing did not speak.
Because what the Bone-Eroding Griffin said was indeed true.
The energy cannon towers, including the Calamity Defense Towers, all needed charging time.
Even though the two Sun Crown Steles had already reduced the charging time of these defense towers to an extremely short span.
But from the perspective of Divine-level movement speed, this time was enough for them to escape far away.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin sneered, "Heaven won’t allow me to perish!"
"All of you just wait, if I escape this time, I will follow you for life!"
"I will make you restless and sleepless, becoming your nightmare!"
"You better stay inside this warship for life, don’t let me find an opportunity."
"Otherwise, I will make you experience the most cruel pains of this world, hahaha!
It laughed wildly, seemingly thinking it already had the upper hand.
However, it did not know, this was not all of Han Xing’s means.
Han Xing then said, "Radiance, go, pin it down."
The God of Radiance understood.
The next moment, he flashed into appearance at the prow of the ship.
Then, a chain of light with a diameter of 100,000 meters burst forth.
Sensing the aura of the God of Radiance.
The smile on the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s face froze, then turned into an expression of extreme terror.
"Top-tier Divine Spirit! Damn it! You actually hid a top-tier Divine Spirit!"
At this moment, the Bone-Eroding Griffin almost without hesitation tried to turn and flee.
However, no matter how fast it was, it could not be faster than the attack speed of the God of Radiance.
After all, that was a top-tier Divine Spirit who mastered the Light Element Rules.
"Bang!"
The Chain of Light instantly spanned tens of thousands of kilometers, directly hitting the massive body of the Bone-Eroding Griffin, pinning it firmly in the void.
At the same time, Han Xing’s defense tower attacks also burst forth at this moment.
This Bone-Eroding Griffin no longer had the previous pride and arrogance, shouting in terror, "No! Have mercy on me! Have mercy!"
"I was wrong, I swear I will never trouble you again!"
It felt that it definitely could not survive this wave of concentrated fire.
In the face of death, the Bone-Eroding Griffin abandoned its pride, shouting, "Don’t kill me, I am willing to submit!"
"I am willing to become your slave forever!"
However, Han Xing had already made up his mind to kill this creature.
There was no fluctuation to its compromise.
From its previous words, it was clear that this was a creature with a strong desire for revenge.
Even if it were made to submit for a lifetime, it would not be safe.
If one day Han Xing met with an accident, this creature would be the first to target those around him.
So, there was simply no need to keep such a creature around.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 486: Power of the Fourth Rule_3
paragraphs: "Boom!"
A terrifying energy beam blasted over.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin was completely engulfed by the firepower from Ten Thousand Stars City.
The area underwent intense fluctuations, shattering everything.
Even its scream could no longer be transmitted.
At the same time, a thick nerve network appeared in the sky.
This was the law belonging to the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
Crack!
With a crisp sound.
This law directly shattered into fragments.
And because the defense tower killed it, Han Xing didn’t hear the kill notification.
When the energy fluctuations subsided.
Han Xing piloted the Divine Demon Battleship to the area where the Bone-Eroding Griffin died.
At the site, 13 dark yellow divine formats appeared.
Han Xing was delighted, "13 divine formats, this guy seems slightly stronger than that Evil Tree Demon."
After collecting them all, he synthesized them into a complete rule again.
In front of him, the attributes of this rule appeared.
[Power of Rules]: Special item.
[Attribute]: Bone Erosion

[Effect]: A complete ’Bone Erosion’ rule can break through to the Divine Realm upon reaching the demigod limit, becoming the new god of Bone Erosion, or can be directly absorbed to increase by 26,000 divine power value.
This complete rule was noticeably thicker.
Similarly.
The divine power value it could increase was also greater.
A complete rule could directly increase divine power by 26,000.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
"Five more; just four and a half more to go!"
The teammates looked forward to it, too.
The breakthrough for Han Xing to become a demigod was one step closer.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong seemed to remember something and suddenly said, "Brother Xing, didn’t Samoyed say that this Bone-Eroding Griffin snatched half a rule from him hundreds of years ago?"
"Why don’t we see where that half rule is? Has it been absorbed by it?"
Han Xing was also puzzled.
Then suddenly.
The Blade Armor Demon escaped from the Void Vortex and quickly approached Han Xing.
"Master... Master, you’ve solved it?"
During its rush, it sensed the terrifying energy fluctuations when battleship focused fire.
Similarly, it saw the shattered power of rules.
Han Xing nodded faintly.
Samoyed’s eyes showed a strong shock.
From the time it was freed, less than a minute had passed overall.
One of its major enemies had been resolved by Han Xing.
It was simply like a dream.
Samoyed couldn’t help but feel grateful for deciding to recognize Han Xing as master.
Han Xing continued to ask, "Samoyed, where’s the remaining half of the rule?"
Samoyed thought for a moment, then said, "Master, the Bone-Eroding Griffin race has more than one divine spirit."
"There’s another wandering divine spirit outside, responsible for collecting resources."
"It roams the Forbidden Star River, looking for targets."
"There are two possibilities: either Franco swallowed the half rule, or another divine level Bone-Eroding Griffin carries it."
Han Xing nodded, "Any way to lure out that Bone-Eroding Griffin?"
Samoyed nodded, "Yes."
"The Griffin’s nest is something they value heavily."
"I also saw many unhatched griffin eggs in there."
"If it senses Franco is dead, it will know there’s a disturbance in the nest."
"Given how these Griffins value their race, they’ll return to investigate, no matter what."
Han Xing wondered, "You mean we just wait here at the nest, and the Griffin will come on its own."
"Are these Griffins really that foolish?
Samoyed nodded, "Yes, Master."
"The Griffin race is extremely vengeful and has strong racial awareness."
"Now Franco’s dead, and many Griffins are killed."
"They’ll risk coming back to find out who the enemy is."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
The Endless Void was so vast, spawning countless small worlds.
In those small worlds, the appearance of strange creatures seemed normal.
At this point, Samoyed added, "By the way, Master."
"The Bone-Eroding Griffin race is known as the robbers around the Forbidden Galaxy."
"They’ve stolen plenty of treasures, hidden in their nests."
This made Han Xing’s eyes light up, "You mean there’s a lot of treasure in that Griffin nest?"
Moya nodded.
Han Xing instantly declared, "Then what are we waiting for, let’s go now!"
With that, he piloted the Divine Demon Battleship toward the huge nest.
At this moment, the huge nest still contained many Bone-Eroding Griffins.
But they only had Tier Three and Tier Four strength.
They were kept in the nest, not following Franco’s order to charge out.
Otherwise, not one Griffin would have been left here.
After all, Han Xing’s [Divine Demon Battleship] firepower was no joke.
In full power burst mode, it could wipe out an entire race in a short time.
The Griffins recognized these people as their enemies, eyes burning with hate, charged at Han Xing.
Han Xing casually glanced at them.
Next instant, the Griffins’ bodies stiffened.
In a moment, they lost all signs of life.
Like kites with broken strings, they all fell.
Meanwhile, other Griffins also charged at Han Xing and the team.
As if determined to tear off a piece of flesh from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 487: Bird’s Nest
paragraphs: Crash!
A swarm of Bone-Eroding Griffins flew in.
In this nest, there were still many Griffins left.
However, Han Xing and the others had no reaction,
No matter how many Bone-Eroding Griffins charged at them, they were instantly killed by their Divine Powers.
The God of Radiance didn’t need to take action at all.
The team members watched everything with indifference.
They all knew, from the previous conflict,
they and the Bone-Eroding Griffin race had become mortal enemies.
If they didn’t kill all these crazy and vengeful Griffins this time, they would find every way to deal with them in the future.
It’s even possible, if they couldn’t deal with Han Xing and his people, they would redirect their hatred towards other Human Race members.
Therefore, to prevent this from happening, Han Xing decided to eliminate every Bone-Eroding Griffin he could see.
The silhouettes of those big birds continued to fall, dead beyond doubt.
A few minutes later.
After confirming no more Bone-Eroding Griffins were flying around, Han Xing said, "Let’s go inside the bird’s nest."
Everyone nodded.
Then, their figures flashed, appearing inside the bird’s nest.
At this moment, Samoyed also transformed its body size.
Its originally colossal body, tens of thousands of meters large, rapidly shrank to only two meters.
It looked like an upright-walking crocodile.
With its short limbs and long tail, it looked especially comical.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, two young girls, couldn’t help but laugh.
Cheng Jianyong, however, was indifferent, directly putting an arm around Samoyed’s shoulder.
"Samoyed, your style is great, you’d definitely be a celebrity pet in a zoo."
"I think you shouldn’t transform back to your original form, this shape is just fine."
Samoyed gave an awkward laugh.
At this moment, they stood within this bird’s nest world, comparable to the size of a star.
Their figures were small as specks of dust.
Looking around, they could see many piles of hay and bird droppings everywhere.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Look, there are a lot of eggs there!"
Hearing this, everyone looked in the direction Cheng Jianyong was pointing.
Sure enough, they saw a pile of hatching giant purple eggs.
Some of these giant eggs already had cracks.
Crack! Crack!
The sound of eggshells breaking came in waves.
It seemed like many young birds were about to break out of their shells.
Han Xing sensed there was still a lot of magma active beneath this nest.
Isolated by a special material, continuously radiating heat.
This was indeed an excellent incubation site.
Looking at the giant eggs nearby, Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, should we destroy all these bird eggs?"
Inside these bird eggs, although they contained new lives,
but as mentioned before, they had already formed a mortal enmity with this race.
These bird eggs couldn’t be spared either.
Of course, such an act was a bit excessive.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong volunteered to be the executioner and bear the corresponding consequences.
After a brief thought, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No rush, a Divine-Level Bone-Eroding Griffin hasn’t returned yet."
"If we destroy everything now, this creature might sense its kin are all dead and won’t come back."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, saying no more.
Everyone continued advancing in this filthy bird’s nest.
They didn’t walk far.
Shen Yun said, "It seems like a lot of young birds have hatched there.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over.
Ahead, in a section, there was a large group of Bone-Eroding Griffin chicks.
They seemed to have just emerged from their shells, still smeared with egg shell fragments and purple slime.
However, even though they had just hatched, they already had the ability to walk independently.
They limped toward a certain direction, featherless and somewhat disgusting in appearance.
However, when everyone saw those chicks beginning to feed,
it was even more nauseating.
Cheng Jianyong nearly vomited on the spot,
Their food consisted of plump, massive maggots.
Each maggot was as large as an adult’s arm, squirming on the ground.
The swarm of young birds rushed ahead, gulping down maggot after maggot.
However, if only the feeding scene, it wouldn’t have elicited such a reaction.
The primary cause of their discomfort was the source of the maggots.
Ahead, there was a massive humanoid creature bound with chains.
It was a Six-armed Giant.
At this moment, it lay dying, like a mountain of flesh.
Its body was nailed with countless steel spikes, sealing off its Divine Power and restricting its mobility.
Its body was smeared with various slime and griffin excrement.
The filth on its wounds rapidly bred microorganisms, quickly turning into maggots.
Maggots crawled all over the giant’s body, feasting on its flesh, each seemingly well-fed.
"Gurgle, gurgle..."
And those griffin chicks’ maggot meals were crawling out of the Six-armed Giant.
This Six-armed Giant was a massive mountain of maggots, providing nutrients for the growth of the young birds.
And more horrifying still, the Six-armed Giant wasn’t dead!
In other words, it was aware while enduring such inhuman torture.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, both girls, outright vomited.

Of course, such an act was a bit excessive.
Thus, Cheng Jianyong volunteered to be the executioner and bear the corresponding consequences.
After a brief thought, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No rush, a Divine-Level Bone-Eroding Griffin hasn’t returned yet."
"If we destroy everything now, this creature might sense its kin are all dead and won’t come back."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, saying no more.
Everyone continued advancing in this filthy bird’s nest.
They didn’t walk far.
Shen Yun said, "It seems like a lot of young birds have hatched there.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked over.
Ahead, in a section, there was a large group of Bone-Eroding Griffin chicks.
They seemed to have just emerged from their shells, still smeared with egg shell fragments and purple slime.
However, even though they had just hatched, they already had the ability to walk independently.
They limped toward a certain direction, featherless and somewhat disgusting in appearance.
However, when everyone saw those chicks beginning to feed,
it was even more nauseating.
Cheng Jianyong nearly vomited on the spot,
Their food consisted of plump, massive maggots.
Each maggot was as large as an adult’s arm, squirming on the ground.
The swarm of young birds rushed ahead, gulping down maggot after maggot.
However, if only the feeding scene, it wouldn’t have elicited such a reaction.
The primary cause of their discomfort was the source of the maggots.
Ahead, there was a massive humanoid creature bound with chains.
It was a Six-armed Giant.
At this moment, it lay dying, like a mountain of flesh.
Its body was nailed with countless steel spikes, sealing off its Divine Power and restricting its mobility.
Its body was smeared with various slime and griffin excrement.
The filth on its wounds rapidly bred microorganisms, quickly turning into maggots.
Maggots crawled all over the giant’s body, feasting on its flesh, each seemingly well-fed.
"Gurgle, gurgle..."
And those griffin chicks’ maggot meals were crawling out of the Six-armed Giant.
This Six-armed Giant was a massive mountain of maggots, providing nutrients for the growth of the young birds.
And more horrifying still, the Six-armed Giant wasn’t dead!
In other words, it was aware while enduring such inhuman torture.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, both girls, outright vomited.

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 487: Bird’s Nest (Part 2)
paragraphs: Even Han Xing felt somewhat uneasy upon seeing this scene.
Samoyed explained from the side, "Master, this is the Six-armed Giant Race, a race that escaped from a minor world."
"The Six-armed Giant Race possesses immense brute strength and regenerative abilities."
"When they first arrived at the Land of Divine War back then, they were targeted by the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race."
"Froggo took a liking to the regenerative abilities of this race and captured them all, sealed them inside the nest, and turned them into food dishes."

"And in order for these Six-armed Giants to continuously provide food for the young birds below, they were not killed, but instead periodically fed with treasures containing extremely potent life force."
"Up to now, almost a thousand years have passed..."
Upon hearing Samoyed’s explanation, everyone felt a chill run down their spines.
Imagine being captured by a group of monstrous birds and brought into their nest, nailed with so many spikes that even your fingers cannot move.
This ordeal must be unbearably painful and torturous, such that even legendary powerhouses would struggle to remain composed.
Yet, this is not the end. Soon, a large number of young birds would flock to its body, pecking at the maggots upon it, a process surely more agonizing than death itself.
Moreover, due to their impressive regenerative ability, they remained unable to die.
Such days have persisted for a millennium.
Just the thought of it makes one’s skin crawl.
At the same time, they gained a deeper understanding of the brutality of the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race.
Cheng Jianyong was the first to lose patience, cursing, "These disgusting Bone-Eroding Griffins!"
With those words, he unleashed a surge of divine power.
The nearby Bone-Eroding Griffin nestlings perished silently.
Even the maggots upon that Six-armed Giant died instantly.
Then, Cheng Jianyong, wielding the Holy Artifact [Immortal Giant], generated waves of axe energy.
"Swish, swish, swish!"
The steel spikes imbued with sealing power snapped consecutively.
Snap! Snap!
In just a moment, all the steel spikes on the Six-armed Giant disappeared.
At this moment, the Six-armed Giant slowly lifted its eyes, giving Cheng Jianyong a deep look.
Cheng Jianyong then said, "Escape."
However, the Six-armed Giant simply turned its body with difficulty and let out a comfortable moan.
A moment later, it turned back over, writhing like a giant meatball.
"Rumble, rumble!"
At this time, everyone saw tears glistening at the corner of the Six-armed Giant’s eyes.
It gratefully glanced at Cheng Jianyong, without uttering a word.
Shortly thereafter, its body trembled, and then it was lifeless.
Everyone realized then that the Six-armed Giant had committed suicide.
Shen Yun sighed, "After being tormented for a thousand years, it has completely lost its dignity as a living being."
"Now, this release might be the best way for them."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
They stepped past this Six-armed Giant and continued forward.
Just then, shadows suddenly flew across the sky.
"Caw!"
A piercing screech emerged.
Those were several Bone-Eroding Griffins with Tier Three and Tier Four strength.
Although, in the recent battle, Han Xing and his group had nearly wiped out the combat-capable Bone-Eroding Griffins.
But given the bird nest’s vast size, it’s not surprising that some Bone-Eroding Griffins hadn’t participated.
These Griffins charged forward recklessly, their eyes filled with hatred.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong rushed ahead, striking with an axe.
"Swish!
The void seemed to split.
These Bone-Eroding Griffins of Tier Three and Tier Four didn’t even fly close before being sliced into pieces.
They continued advancing.
Along the way, they saw several more Six-armed Giants, their bodies festering, used as food dishes.
Similarly, upon spotting them, Cheng Jianyong would promptly rescue these Six-armed Giants.
However, after being rescued, these Six-armed Giants generally had the same reaction.
They would choose to end their lives at the first opportunity.
Continuing forward, they found not only the Six-armed Giant Race but also the Rock Giant Elephant Race, Arcane Giant Lizard Race, Sand Worm Race, and others...
All trapped in the Griffin nest, existing as food dishes.
This place births new life every day and is exceedingly filthy.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse, "Damn, this Bone-Eroding Griffin Race has no reason to exist. Once we’re out, I’ll blow this nest..."
"No, I’ll blow up this den of horrors!"
No one else spoke; they had intended to do just that.
Carrying heavy hearts, they journeyed tens of thousands of kilometers through the bird nest, nearing its center.
Han Xing asked, "Radiance, have you sensed where the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race’s treasure is kept?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Yes, sensed it, it’s not far ahead."
"I also sensed a middle-tier demigod level presence there."
Han Xing nodded, unconcerned.
To them, a middle-tier demigod no longer posed a threat.
Soon, they arrived at the nest’s central area.
Here, several small nests made of piled grass appeared.
Inside them were large chunks of Philosopher’s Stone and Shimmering Terra Stone.
Even millstone-sized Calamity Divine Gold was plentiful, and with just a glance around, they saw a heap of divine artifact materials.

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 487: Bird’s Nest_3
paragraphs: [Philosopher’s Stone (Large): Can be dismantled into Philosopher’s Stone *500]
[Shimmering Terra Stone (Extra Large): Can be dismantled into Shimmering Terra Stone *2000]
[Calamity Divine Gold (Large): Can be dismantled into Calamity Divine Gold *200]
Besides that, they also saw a huge pile of [Thunder Divine Stones], [Extreme Ice Divine Stones], [Red Flame Divine Stones], and so on here.
Joy appeared in everyone’s eyes at the same time.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Holy shit! So many Divine Stones, so much Divine Gold!"
"These Griffins really stashed a ton of treasure!"
The others nodded as well.
And just as they were about to pack all these materials away—
A gigantic Bone-Eroding Griffin appeared.
It flew into midair, its deep avian eyes staring down at the group below.
This Bone-Eroding Griffin was exactly that Middle-tier Demigod they had sensed earlier.
Also the last Demigod-level powerhouse in this entire Bird’s Nest.
However, that Bone-Eroding Griffin looked incomparably old.
Its feathers were almost all gone, and even its brows had turned whitish.
[Bone-Eroding Griffin: Barolome]
[Level: 65 (Middle-tier Demigod)]
[Attributes: Power 173215, agility 168235, Spirit 185324, Constitution 153266]
[Skills: Bone-Eroding Feather, Heaven Fall, Lightning Strike, Griffin’s Beak, Ultimate Skill—Purple Rain]
[Divine Power Value: 52316]
Very ordinary Attributes, completely incapable of posing any threat to them.

The old Griffin stared at Han Xing and the others, then slowly spoke: "You lot have already slaughtered nearly ninety percent of my clan. Are you really not going to spare even our last bit of heritage?
Cheng Jianyong replied, "Old bastard, get this straight: it was your people who attacked us first, we were just fighting back."
"Don’t try to play word games here."
The old Griffin on the other side let out a sigh. "You’re right, it was indeed my clansmen who were blind and offended you first."
"Now, you’ve already made my clan pay the price we should pay."
"Even if this price is so tragic, we can only accept it."
"This old man kneels here to beg you all to leave my clan a path to live."
As the old Griffin spoke, it flew down and knelt before Han Xing and the others.
Everyone exchanged glances; for a moment, none of them knew how to respond.
However, Samoyed at the side said, "Barolome, I know you."
"You’re the very first Bone-Eroding Griffin that came to the Forbidden Star River."
Hearing Samoyed call its name, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s brow twitched. "Moya Divine Master, it’s rare that you still remember this old man."
"I wonder if you might, for the sake of us all being members of the Alliance of Ten Thousand Realms, plead with this Human Race friend to spare our Bone-Eroding Griffin Race?"
"This old man will remember your favor, generation after generation, for all eternity!"
Moya continued to sneer. "Enough. I really can’t afford the ’favor’ of an old bastard like you."
"Others might not know what you’re really like, but I know all too well."
"Back then you were just an Initial-tier Demigod. After coming to the Forbidden Star River, you knew how insignificant you were."
"So you quickly threw in with a High-tier Demigod of the Flame Eye Race, then led your clan to become the Flame曈 Race’s mounts, waging war across the Forbidden Star River."
Hearing Moya bring up this bit of past history, the old Griffin clearly felt something was off.
But it still pretended to be calm as it said, "Moya Divine Master, back then our clan was indeed the Flame曈 Race’s mounts, and we will forever remember the Flame曈 Race’s kindness."
Moya’s eyes were filled with contempt. "Remember the Flame曈 Race’s kindness? More like you remembered them into your stomachs."
The old Griffin’s brow twitched and it shook its head. "Moya Divine Master, what are you talking about?"
Moya answered, "Enough, stop playing dumb.
"Other people might not know, but I sure as hell do."
"After you spent a few hundred years as mounts for the Flame曈 Race, you smoothly broke through to Middle-tier Demigod, and even built this enormous Bird’s Nest in the Void."
"Once you’d earned the trust of the Flame曈 Race, you used the pretext of a visit to trick the then Flame曈 Clan Leader into coming to your Bird’s Nest."
"From that day on, the entire Forbidden Galaxy never saw the Flame曈 Clan Leader’s figure again."
"And not long after that, the entire Flame曈 Race quietly vanished from the Forbidden Galaxy without a sound."

Hearing Samoyed recount things in such detail, the old Griffin’s expression changed drastically, and it hurriedly denied, "Moya Divine Master, all of that is just rumor. Our clan has never done such things!"
Samoyed gave it a calm glance and said, "So what you’re saying is that I’m just making things up out of thin air?"
The old Griffin’s body trembled at once; it didn’t dare publicly question a Divine Spirit.
Samoyed went on, "They say the Bone-Eroding Griffin Race is insidious and vengeful."
"But that temperament and those instincts all come from you, this old bastard."
"Even the two Divine Spirits in your clan were taught by you."
After listening, Cheng Jianyong immediately laughed. "Well, well, so it’s you, this old piece of crap, pulling strings from behind the scenes!"
"And here you were acting all pitiful in front of us. We almost let you fool us, old bastard."
Finished speaking, Cheng Jianyong stepped forward, ready to grab this old Griffin.
However, at this moment, the lowered face of the old Griffin turned even more sinister.
It shot a vicious glare at Moya beside it and said in a deep voice, "Moya, you Blade Armor Demon Race really do love meddling in other people’s business."
"Ever heard the saying ’the bird that sticks its head out gets shot’?"
"Moya, you’ll soon pay the price for what you did today. I’ll drag your entire Blade Armor Demon Race over here, turn you all into feeding troughs to sustain my clan’s descendants."
"And you Human Race bastards, you just wait for me too!"
Hearing that, Cheng Jianyong laughed and said, "Oh? You old bastard still dares to threaten us?"
"I’ll chop you up and see how cocky you are then!"
With that, Cheng Jianyong swung his axe down.
And right at that moment, a black stone appeared in front of the Bone-Eroding Griffin, and that stone was radiating an intense spatial fluctuation!

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 488: Harvest, Waiting for the Rabbit
paragraphs: The next moment, this stone burst forth with a formidable aura, completely enveloping the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
The old Griffin’s body became increasingly illusory.
Cheng Jianyong swung the axe down, but it was like cutting through air, causing no harm to it.
Samoyed then said, "Master, this is the Void Illusion Stone, it can instantly transport to incredibly distant places."
"We must interrupt it, otherwise the old fellow will escape and it will be troublesome to find it again."
The old Griffin’s figure became more and more illusory, as it looked at the crowd in front of it, a hint of a sinister smile in its eyes.
It slowly raised its wings and then made a throat-slashing gesture towards the crowd.
This creature actually dared to threaten Han Xing and the others.
To its threats, Han Xing felt no fluctuations in his heart.
Instead, he glanced at the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, strike."
The God of Radiance nodded.
The next moment, boundless divine light burst forth from him, completely enveloping the entire Giant Bird’s Nest.
The formerly proud expression of the old Griffin suddenly froze.
Then, it became utterly terrified!
It witnessed with its own eyes, those powers of radiance piercing through the illusion of the Void Illusion Stone, instantly locking onto itself.
Moreover, those powers of radiance transformed into a Radiant Chain.
Spanning countless distances, forcibly locking it.
Then, the God of Radiance reached out and pulled.
The old Griffin was yanked out of its teleportation state.
Startled, it looked at Han Xing and others, exclaiming in shock, "Top-tier Divine Spirit! You actually have the presence of a Top-tier Divine Spirit!"
Yes, the teleportation function of the Void Illusion Stone is very powerful, similar to the teleportation effect of the Oracle Throne.
Even regular divine spirits cannot interrupt it.
However, this does not mean that a top-tier divine spirit like the God of Radiance cannot do so.
Under the full burst of the God of Radiance, penetrating through space, forcibly pulling this creature out.
Meanwhile,
Cheng Jianyong lifted the Holy Artifact Battleaxe, approaching as he said, "Old thing, what did you just say?
"You said you would make us pay a price?"
"Hmm?"
At this moment, the old Griffin no longer had its previous ferocity, terror in its eyes as it spoke, "Spare me, master! Spare me, master!"
"It is the senile foolishness that caused offense to everyone!"
"Please be lenient and spare the old me once!"
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing.
And Han Xing, unwilling to have any entanglement with this cunning old Griffin, waved his hand directly saying, "Dispose of it."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, raising the war axe to strike down.
The old Griffin, seeing its submission and pleading had no effect.
A glimpse of cruelty appeared in its eyes.
It looked at Cheng Jianyong, angrily saying, "Damn brat, an Initial-tier Demigod dares to repeatedly offend the old me!"
"Well, if I can drag you down with me before dying, it’s worth it!"
As soon as the words fell, a deep, ancient aura burst forth from it.
Then, like an arrow leaving the string, it charged fiercely towards Cheng Jianyong.
At this moment, a hint of a smile appeared at the corner of Cheng Jianyong’s mouth.
"Old creature, truly naïve."
"Watch the strongest ultimate skill of Barbaric War God."
As the words fell,
Cheng Jianyong suddenly raised the war axe high.
In this instant, the entire Giant Bird’s Nest felt a terrifying sense of oppression!
The Gryphon chicks couldn’t help but raise their heads, looking towards the sky.
They seemed to see, in the sky, the figures of three people holding giant axes.
In the same posture, they swung down the axe.
Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Ultimate Skill, Three Extremes Axe!"
In a flash, the three figures merged into one.
The three giant axes combined into one, with absolute power, striking down mercilessly!
Crack!
Everyone heard a cracking sound near their ears.
However, they didn’t know what was being severed!
The next moment, the old Griffin stared blankly at its own body.
Before it could react, its body disintegrated into flesh instantly.
After disposing of the old Griffin.
Cheng Jianyong put away the Holy Artifact Battleaxe, turned around, and showed a proud smile to everyone.
He looked at the God of Radiance and said, "How was it, Radiance."
"Wasn’t my axe impressive enough to kill some low-tier divine spirits?"
The God of Radiance, hearing this, shook his head with a smile and said, "Cheng Jianyong, little brother, your axe indeed reached a terrifying level."
"At least at the demigod level, no strong opponent should be able to withstand your attack."
"However, it’s still a bit short of slaying divine spirits."
Nonetheless, upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong wasn’t discouraged.
He cheerfully said, "Just a bit short?"
"No problem, when I swung that axe, I hadn’t received the state buff from Xiaoyunzi yet."
"When he gives the two blessings, tosses the sun."
"Rounding up, I, Old Cheng, too possess the combat capability of slaying divine spirits, hahaha!"
He laughed with hands on hips, filled with excitement.
Everyone gave him a helpless look but didn’t say more.
Because Cheng Jianyong was indeed correct.
With the cooperation of the team, an all-out strike, he now truly possesses the ability to Godslay.
It is important to know.
Even Han Xing, without the help of the Defense Tower and Giant Beast Tail Spike, couldn’t achieve this.
Now Cheng Jianyong has become the strongest among them.
Han Xing shook his head, not caring.
Instead, he smiled and said, "Alright, the enemy has been dealt with, now gather all these materials!"

The old Griffin’s body became increasingly illusory.
Cheng Jianyong swung the axe down, but it was like cutting through air, causing no harm to it.
Samoyed then said, "Master, this is the Void Illusion Stone, it can instantly transport to incredibly distant places."
"We must interrupt it, otherwise the old fellow will escape and it will be troublesome to find it again."
The old Griffin’s figure became more and more illusory, as it looked at the crowd in front of it, a hint of a sinister smile in its eyes.
It slowly raised its wings and then made a throat-slashing gesture towards the crowd.
This creature actually dared to threaten Han Xing and the others.
To its threats, Han Xing felt no fluctuations in his heart.
Instead, he glanced at the God of Radiance beside him and said, "Radiance, strike."
The God of Radiance nodded.
The next moment, boundless divine light burst forth from him, completely enveloping the entire Giant Bird’s Nest.
The formerly proud expression of the old Griffin suddenly froze.
Then, it became utterly terrified!
It witnessed with its own eyes, those powers of radiance piercing through the illusion of the Void Illusion Stone, instantly locking onto itself.
Moreover, those powers of radiance transformed into a Radiant Chain.
Spanning countless distances, forcibly locking it.
Then, the God of Radiance reached out and pulled.
The old Griffin was yanked out of its teleportation state.
Startled, it looked at Han Xing and others, exclaiming in shock, "Top-tier Divine Spirit!
You actually have the presence of a Top-tier Divine Spirit!"
Yes, the teleportation function of the Void Illusion Stone is very powerful, similar to the teleportation effect of the Oracle Throne.
Even regular divine spirits cannot interrupt it.
However, this does not mean that a top-tier divine spirit like the God of Radiance cannot do so.
Under the full burst of the God of Radiance, penetrating through space, forcibly pulling this creature out.

"You said you would make us pay a price?"
"Hmm?"
At this moment, the old Griffin no longer had its previous ferocity, terror in its eyes as it spoke, "Spare me, master!
Spare me, master!"
"It is the senile foolishness that caused offense to everyone!"
"Please be lenient and spare the old me once!"
Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing.
And Han Xing, unwilling to have any entanglement with this cunning old Griffin, waved his hand directly saying, "Dispose of it."

The old Griffin, seeing its submission and pleading had no effect.
A glimpse of cruelty appeared in its eyes.

In a flash, the three figures merged into one.
The three giant axes combined into one, with absolute power, striking down mercilessly!
Crack!
Everyone heard a cracking sound near their ears.

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 488: Harvest, Waiting for the Hare (Part 2)
paragraphs: After hearing this, everyone immediately complied.
They began to act separately, collecting all the scattered Divine Gold and Divine Stones around the Bird’s Nest.
System notifications kept popping up.
[Acquired Philosopher’s Stone (Large) *171]
[Acquired Shimmering Terra Stone (Large) *104]
[Acquired Calamity Divine Gold (Large) *75]
After searching this area, they had roughly acquired [Philosopher’s Stone] *1.76 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone] *1.57 million
[Calamity Divine Gold] *120,000
Other four-attribute metals and Divine Stones added up to over 4 million!
This was quite a good haul.
A look of delight appeared in everyone’s eyes.
Han Xing said, "Let’s switch places and continue searching."
"This Bird’s Nest is so large, there are plenty of areas with these Divine Gold deposits!"
Hearing this, everyone started moving again.
About half an hour later.
They finally emptied the entire massive Bird’s Nest.
Cumulatively acquired [Philosopher’s Stone] *37.64 million
[Shimmering Terra Stone] *29.54 million
[Calamity Divine Gold] *2.32 million
[Chaos Divine Stone] *1.64 million
Plus [Shadow Divine Stone], [Thunder Divine Stone], [Red Flame Divine Gold], [Extreme Ice Divine Stone], totaling 47.24 million!
Everyone was ecstatic.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed excitedly, "Good heavens, these Bone-Eroding Griffins actually hid so many treasures!"
"The harvest here is more than what we’d take from raiding a Divine Treasure Vault!"
Moya also nodded, saying, "Races capable of staying in the Forbidden Star River possess considerable strength.
"Over the years, they’ve amassed substantial wealth and treasures."
"In fact, the Bone-Eroding Griffins possess far more than this, but most of it has been handed over to Silent City, and another portion used to enhance themselves."
"The treasures that the master collected, compared to what they’ve accumulated over the years, probably don’t even account for one-tenth."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong, as if recalling something, suddenly asked, "Samoyed, are you implying that your Blade Armor Demon Race has many treasures too?"
"You’ve been stationed here for over 3,000 years, surely you’ve stored quite a lot of Divine Stones and Divine Gold?"
Samoyed’s face stiffened; it wanted to deny.
But remembering the Supreme Law’s oath, it hurriedly and awkwardly said, "Not much... not much... a bit less than the Bone-Eroding Griffins."
"Most of those treasures have been used to enhance my strength, and now there’s very little left."
It seemed a bit embarrassed.
At this time, Han Xing, with interest, said, "Samoyed, once I finish handling things here, I’ll accompany you to your Blade Armor Demon Race’s base."
Upon hearing this, Moya’s face showed a constipated expression, as if his heart were bleeding.
Because he knew that once Han Xing and the others went over, his years of effort would be utterly gone.
But Han Xing’s next words plunged Samoyed into stunned silence.
"Samoyed, I don’t need everything from your Blade Armor Demon Race. Just hand over half to me; this number should be fine, right?"
After all, Samoyed is now my subordinate.
As a clan leader of a major race, it also has to consider the development of its race.
Han Xing also didn’t want to go too far.
Samoyed originally thought it would have to hand over everything.
Hearing this, its face changed to excitement, "No problem, no problem!"
Cheng Jianyong threw an arm around its shoulder, saying, "Samoyed, you’re sensible."
"Letting you only hand over half is a benefit to you."
"Every place we’ve passed by before had nothing left. Even the wall skin is scraped off for you!"
Moya nodded awkwardly, "Thank you, merciful master; Moya will exhaust all efforts for the master, loyal to the end!"
He solemnly pledged.
However, Han Xing didn’t seem to mind. Instead, he looked at the materials in his bag, his face showing delight.
"Great, the Philosopher’s Stone is about to surpass one billion, and Shimmering Terra Stone also has tens of millions."
"The Divine Gold and Divine Stones in my possession are enough to craft another Celestial Rail Strike Device or build a dozen Lingxiao ships!"
These two things can both enhance Han Xing’s combat power.
However, to craft these two items, key materials are missing.
One is the Power of Rules, and the other is World Will.
Thus, Han Xing still can’t convert these Divine Gold and Divine Stones into his combat power.
Meanwhile,
Shen Yun came to Han Xing’s side with a peculiar expression, saying, "Brother Xing, we’ve searched the whole Bird’s Nest and only found 3 formats."
"As Samoyed mentioned, the Bone-Eroding Griffins have used most of the resources they’ve gotten over the years."
Han Xing nodded, "No problem, 3 formats are still good."
Shen Yun nodded and then handed over the three formats to Han Xing.
System notifications popped up.
[Acquired Divine Format·Absorption *1]
[Acquired Divine Format: Distortion *1]
[Acquired Divine Breath *1]
Han Xing checked the attributes of these three formats.
Among them, ’Absorption’ and ’Breath’ are ordinary formats, only able to increase 2,000~3,000 Divine Power Value points.
Only the ’Distortion’ format could increase 3,000~5,000 Divine Power Value points.
Han Xing gazed at the rhombic crystal in his hand, covered with twisted patterns, and asked, "Radiance, is the God of Distortion still alive?"
The God of Radiance nodded, "Still alive."
Han Xing: "How strong is this guy?"
The God of Radiance thought for a moment and replied, "Quite strong. Several thousand years ago, he was already a High-tier Divine Spirit."
"With all these years passing, he may have broken through to Top-tier Divine Spirit."
Saying this, the God of Radiance added, "However, the God of Distortion is also in the Forbidden Land, affected by the Forbidden Galaxy, so he’s unlikely to come over."

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 488: Harvest and Waiting for the Prey (Part 3)
paragraphs: Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
This way, he could confidently absorb the Divine Format from the opponent.
After finishing the search of the Bird’s Nest.
Han Xing said, "Let’s go up and see if that Bone-Eroding Griffin will come over."
The group, hearing this, all flew into the Void.
At the same time, Samoyed also re-manifested its true form, transforming into a giant steel crocodile spanning five hundred thousand meters, standing across the Void.
However, after waiting for about half an hour, they still did not sense the presence of any other Divine Spirit nearby.
Han Xing asked, "Samoyed, do you think that Bone-Eroding Griffin, upon sensing that all the strong ones of its Race are dead, might not come?"
Samoyed was also a bit uncertain at this point, as so much time had passed.
Although the Forbidden Star River is vast and boundless.
The Griffin clan generally doesn’t venture too far from their old nest.
With Divine Level mobility, it should have arrived near the Bird’s Nest by now.
However, it still hasn’t spotted any other Divine Spirit from the Griffin clan.
Samoyed’s gaze wandered, somewhat afraid to meet Han Xing’s eyes.
Just then, the God of Radiance suddenly reacted and hastily reported, "It’s here."
"Master, I sensed an Initial-tier Divine Spirit nearby."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up, "It’s finally here!"
"Radiance, keep a close watch. If this guy tries to escape, act immediately, don’t hesitate."
The God of Radiance nodded respectfully, "Yes, Master."
On Han Xing’s side, he worked hard to conceal his aura, sending Samoyed to stand in front of them.
The Divine Demon Battleship, when not in an attack state, appears like an ordinary battleship.
Posing no threat to these Divine Level entities.
Meanwhile.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin, seeing the giant crocodile spanning tens of thousands of meters in the Void, immediately showed anger in its eyes.
"Moya! Damn it, it’s you!
"You killed Franco and so many of my kin!"
Moya faced the accusations with immense strength.
"So what if I killed them?"
"Years ago, Franco dared to steal my Power of Rules and even hunted me down, forcing me to be its mount!"
"I wished to tear it to a thousand pieces and devour it on the spot."
At this point, Moya licked its lips and said, "Though, devouring it was quite nice."
"The taste of your Bone-Eroding Griffin clan is truly delicious!"
"I devoured Franco and ate many of your Griffin clan’s spirits, almost slightly recovering some of my injuries."
Moya deliberately provoked the Bone-Eroding Griffin across from it.
Upon hearing this, the Griffin’s eyes indeed showed a blood-red gaze.
"Ahhh! Damn Moya! I will kill you!"
"Franco shouldn’t have spared you back then, but should’ve taken your Divine Power and nailed you to our Race’s Divine Nest as a feeding basin for eternity!!"
Moya’s expression remained unchanged, "Biggs, stop shouting."
"Just devouring Franco wasn’t enough for me to recover from my injuries, so now I want to eat all the remaining Griffin Eggs in your nest."
"Afterward, I’ll devour you too, completely restoring my powers!"
Upon hearing this, the Bone-Eroding Griffin slightly moved.
Moya was injured, possibly severely.
To the extent that its aura was extremely weak, dropping to the Initial-tier Divine Spirit Level.
Although Moya’s words had many issues, seemingly deliberately provoking it.
The Griffin seemed to sense great flaws in Moya’s words.
However, Moya wouldn’t give this Griffin extra time to think.
As the words fell, it flicked its tail.
Thousands of giant Griffin Eggs were seized.
Crunch!
Then right in front of the Bone-Eroding Griffin, Moya devoured all these Griffin Eggs, not even spitting out the shells.
Moments later, Moya licked its lips contentedly, "So delicious...
"I must indulge in this taste enough today."
With that said, it flicked its tail again and seized thousands more Griffin Eggs.
This scene made the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes turn completely red.
It had no time to think; its heart was already consumed with the flames of revenge.
In the concept of the Griffin clan, the development of their Race takes precedence over all, deeply ingrained in their minds.
It spread its wings and flew over.
Seeing this, the crowd knew Samoyed succeeded.
It succeeded in angering this Griffin and luring it over.
Next, as long as this Griffin enters the Attack Range.
It will have no chance of escape!
Meanwhile.
Han Xing had already put the Divine Demon Battleship into charging state.
Buzz!
Ripples appeared in the Void.
The Griffin opposite suddenly sensed something amiss, halting its advance and questioning, "Moya, what did you do?"
Moya smiled faintly, "I did nothing, merely savoring a delicacy."
However, the more it said, the more uneasy the Griffin felt.
But because the Divine Demon Battleship was obstructed by Moya’s massive form.
Even if it sensed something amiss, even felt fatal danger.
It had no idea from where the danger originated.
Currently, Samoyed’s tail rested on the giant Bird’s Nest, seemingly ready to drop at any moment.
With its massive form, a sweep of the tail would crush at least millions of unhatched Griffin Eggs.
Meanwhile.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin’s sense of fatal threat grew ever stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 947 - 489: Interrogation, Han Xing’s Fury
paragraphs: The Bone-Eroding Griffin felt the sense of death growing stronger.
It spat out harsh words, "Damn Moya, I won’t let you go!"
"If you dare to continue devouring the spirits of my race, I will slaughter the entire Blade Armor Demon Race!"
Having spoken, the Bone-Eroding Griffin turned around, intent on escaping.
It actually suppressed its hatred, choosing to temporarily lie low.
It planned to find an opportunity to seek revenge on Moya and the Blade Armor Demon Race in the future.
However, Samoyed chuckled lightly, "I’m afraid you won’t have that chance."
At this moment, on Han Xing’s divine demon battleship, all energy cannon towers were fully charged.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin had also entered their attack range.
"Get down, Samoyed."
Samoyed immediately complied, body diving rapidly, revealing the divine demon battleship hidden behind it.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin caught a glimpse, seeing that glowing object in the Void.
Not yet clear on what it was.
Suddenly, radiant brilliance erupted from the divine demon battleship.
"Boom!"
Hundreds of light beams suddenly exploded!
Massive black and blue shells fell like raindrops.
Meanwhile, snow fell heavily from the sky, joined by pouring rain.
Additionally, a terrifying arc of electricity descended!
This was a supreme strike, enough to instantly kill High-tier Divine Spirits and severely injure Top-tier Divine Spirits!
Making the Bone-Eroding Griffin feel an acute sense of crisis!
"Damn! Moya, is this your hidden trick?"
Fear was evident in its eyes.
Because it sensed it couldn’t withstand this concentrated fire attack!
Seeing the blue arc about to descend.
In a moment of crisis.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin suddenly pulled out a special item.
With eyes full of prayer, it said, "Hope... this thing can help me block this strike..."
Boom!
The terrifying attack arrived.
And at this moment, Han Xing and others witnessed a shocking scene!
The energy columns, terrifying plasma ocean, and Dark Energy Shells, Frozen Star Shells.
As they were about to hit the Bone-Eroding Griffin, it was as if they touched a mini black hole.
All energy was absorbed in an instant.
"Rustle!"
The white beam of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, purple Dark Energy Shells, and azure Frozen Star Shells.
All were absorbed by this little black hole and vanished without a trace.
Even the simulated calamity scenes from hundreds of Calamity Defense Towers seemed to experience a siphon effect and disappeared instantly.
When the energy fluctuations ended.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin still stood there, unharmed.
This scene left everyone dumbfounded.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "What the hell is going on?"
"Did I see that right? That’s an attack capable of instantly killing High-tier Divine Spirits, yet it was absorbed just like that?"
"What exactly happened?"
Not only were Han Xing and the others puzzled, but even the God of Radiance was visibly shocked.
Because, as a Top-tier Divine Spirit, he wasn’t confident he could withstand that concentrated fire without injury.
Yet the opposing Bone-Eroding Griffin only had the strength of a Low-tier Divine Spirit.
But it fully absorbed the strike, remaining unharmed.
At this point, Samoyed seemed to recognize the item held by the Bone-Eroding Griffin opposite.
It explained, "Master, the item Biggs is holding seems to be a special treasure from the Forbidden Star River."
"Occasionally, the Forbidden Star River erupts with miraculous things."
"These items might seem useless ordinarily but can unleash infinite power at critical moments."
After hearing Samoyed’s explanation, Han Xing furrowed his brow.
However, the Bone-Eroding Griffin named Biggs opposite showed a delighted expression in its eyes.
Even it hadn’t expected to survive such an attack.
After narrowly escaping death, it laughed maniacally, "Hahahaha! Your attacks seem ineffective against me!"
"Moya! Is this your trick? Hahaha!"
"You dare to insult me even in a severely injured state."
"Now, I will make you pay the price!"
Having spoken, the Bone-Eroding Griffin charged forward directly.
This time, Han Xing controlled the main cannon of the divine demon battleship and fired directly.
"Buzz!"
The energy beam as wide as ten thousand meters, if hit, could even cause a Middle-tier Divine Spirit to fall on the spot.
However, when the Bone-Eroding Griffin took out the peculiar item again.
All energy was absorbed instantly.
This scene made the Bone-Eroding Griffin even more assured.
"Hahaha! It’s useless!"
"Your attacks are strong, but with the Galactic Treasure, you can’t harm me!"
Having spoken, it flapped its wings, accelerating its charge once more,
"Moya! You didn’t expect it, did you? So soon, you’ll pay for your arrogance."
"I will bite off your flesh bit by bit to feed my children!"
"And those on the warship, I will forge you into feeding bowls and pin them in our race’s Bird’s Nest, never to be reborn!"
Faced with its threats, Han Xing and the others remained unmoved.
The treasure in its hand, no matter how strong, was only for defense.
With the God of Radiance’s intervention, it could be dealt with easily.
At this moment, the Bone-Eroding Griffin still holding that peculiar item rushed forward at high speed.
As it approached, Han Xing suddenly saw the appearance of that item.
Instantly, Han Xing’s pupils constricted.

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 489: Interrogation, Han Xing’s Fury (Part 2)
paragraphs: Meanwhile, Cheng Jianyong said doubtfully, "Why do I feel like that Bone-Eroding Griffin is holding something kind of familiar?"
"It looks like... a human palm?"
Hearing that, everyone focused their gaze.
Shen Yun exclaimed, "Damn! It really does look like a human palm."
"Where the hell did this guy get it from?"
A strong look of shock appeared in everyone’s eyes.

But Cheng Jianyong said, "What I’m more curious about is—whose hand is this, that it actually has such terrifying Power, able to easily neutralize an Attack that can insta-kill a High-tier Divine Spirit."
"Brother Xing, do you know?"
Cheng Jianyong turned his gaze to Han Xing.
Yet this time, Han Xing did not answer.
His body was trembling slightly.
Everyone clearly noticed that Han Xing’s State was off.
"Brother Xing? What’s wrong with you?" Cheng Jianyong probed.
A moment later, Han Xing raised his head, his eyes bloodshot Red.
A violent killing intent surged out from within him.
Cheng Jianyong and the others had never seen Han Xing this full of Anger.
It was as if he was seeing something that drove him into utter rage!
Han Xing didn’t explain. He took a deep breath instead, slowly calming the emotions in his heart.
Then he said, "Radiance, go restrain that thing for me."
"No matter what happens, you must not let it escape, understand?"
The God of Radiance heard the seriousness in Han Xing’s tone and nodded. "Understood."
As the words fell, his figure flickered, turning directly into a streak of light and vanishing.
At this moment, that Bone-Eroding Griffin was still charging in madly.
Right then, it saw a figure of boundless light appear ahead.
That figure gave it a feeling of such surging, vast presence!
The Bone-Eroding Griffin halted at once, crying out in terror, "Top-tier Divine Spirit!"
"Damn it! Moya, is this your final trump card?"
However, Moya didn’t respond to him at all right now.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin quickly realized as well.
"I have this Galactic Treasure. So what if it’s a Top-tier Divine Spirit?"
But clearly, it had overestimated the power of this treasure—or rather, underestimated the combat strength of a Top-tier Divine Spirit.
Right now, the God of Radiance simply closed his hand.
Immediately, billions of Chains of Light filled the space around the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
Pu pu pu!
The surrounding space entered a completely sealed State.
Although the Bone-Eroding Griffin was clutching that severed palm, neutralizing many Chains of Light,
its neutralizing speed was nowhere near as fast as the speed at which the chains were appearing.
And, even more terrifying—
Billions of Light Spears had already appeared in the sky.
The God of Radiance moved his lips. "Accept Radiance’s Judgement."
"Divine Skill—Rain of Light!"
Hum!
Billions of Light Spears descended.
And from all directions, they wildly Attacked the Bone-Eroding Griffin!
Pu pu pu!
The sound of flesh being pierced rang out again and again.
In an instant, countless bloody holes appeared all over the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s body.
At the same time, the severed arm it held also slipped free, falling into the Endless Void.
"My treasure!"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin cried out.
It was just about to dive down to catch it.
However, the God of Radiance casually pointed,
and that severed arm was hooked by a Chain and dragged over, appearing in the God of Radiance’s hand.
With its trump card gone, despair flooded the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes.
And in that moment, tens of thousands of Feathers of Light were still constantly piercing through its body.
It seemed to have accepted its fate and stopped struggling,
after all, facing a Top-tier Divine Spirit, it had no chance to resist whatsoever.
Yet just then, the God of Radiance stopped the penetrating Rain of Light.
Instead, he drove a dozen or so Radiant Chains to run straight through its body!
He recalled Han Xing’s last words—
to capture this Bone-Eroding Griffin alive.
Meanwhile—
The Divine Demon Battleship had already flown to the God of Radiance’s side.
Han Xing and the others flickered and appeared in the Void as well.
The God of Radiance said, "Master, I’ve already restrained this thing."
"I’ve sealed off a radius of a million miles around us. There’s no way it can escape my control!"
Han Xing nodded, a chill still lingering in his eyes.
Then he took the severed arm from the God of Radiance’s hand.
A system prompt appeared.
[Obtained Unknown Creature’s Severed Arm*1]
[Unknown Creature’s Severed Arm: Special Item]
[Grade: ???]
[Effect: ???]
Even though the system called this the arm of an unknown creature,
Han Xing could sense a familiar aura on this severed arm.
He was certain—this was Hunter’s severed arm.
Yet what Han Xing hadn’t expected was that Hunter had died in that battle.
And now, parts of his body were actually being used by these bastards as a treasure.
This was a desecration of that hero!
At this moment, Han Xing’s heart once again filled with killing intent; he wished he could tear this Bone-Eroding Griffin to shreds on the spot.
But he held back, forcibly suppressing the Anger in his heart as he asked, "Where did you get this severed arm?"
Right now, the Bone-Eroding Griffin, bound in midair by tens of thousands of Chains of Light, looked down with disdain and said, "Ant, what right do you have to speak to this seat?"
Before the God of Radiance could speak,
Han Xing directly drove five Tower of Annihilation Lightning units to blast over.
Pa!
A ball of blue lightning erupted.
The Bone-Eroding Griffin convulsed under the shock.
It was already heavily wounded as it was.
The power of five Tower of Annihilation Lightning structures wouldn’t insta-kill it, but it was more than enough to make it feel agony.
A moment later, the Bone-Eroding Griffin emerged from the paralyzed State.
"Cough—cough—"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin spat out a mouthful of purplish Red blood, staring at Han Xing with eyes full of venomous hatred.
