chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 489: Interrogation, Han Xing’s Fury (3)
paragraphs: Han Xing ignored its look and continued asking, "Talk."
"Pah!"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin showed no fear.
Han Xing stopped talking as well, and continued controlling the Tower of Annihilation Lightning, bombarding the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
However, this bastard’s mouth really was hard.
No matter how Han Xing attacked it, it still refused to spill anything, and even kept hurling verbal taunts at Han Xing.
After more than ten waves of attacks in a row.
This Bone-Eroding Griffin had already been blasted until it was on its last breath.
But it still stared fixedly at Han Xing with eyes full of defiance.
The meaning in its gaze was: don’t even think about getting anything out of me.
A trace of coldness flashed in Han Xing’s eyes.
The God of Radiance asked, "Master, do you need me to take action?"
"In the God of Light’s memories, I found a special method."
"That is to transform a strand of Divine Power into Light’s Needles, ten thousand times thinner than a hair."
"These Light’s Needles will enter the enemy’s body, traveling along blood vessels, pores, even nerves."
"Their entire body will be flooded with these Light’s Needles, filling every last corner."
The God of Radiance spoke very calmly.
But everyone couldn’t help imagining how terrifying this method was.
If actually used, it would simply be inhuman torture, enough to inflict extreme pain on the target.
Including the Bone-Eroding Griffin opposite them, whose body trembled for a moment.
Yet it took a deep breath and ground its teeth. "Heh... you think a trick like that will make me yield?"
"Let me tell you, even if you kill me, I still won’t tell you anything!"
Han Xing said nothing, apparently aware that merely tormenting the body couldn’t make the other side submit.
So he controlled the Frozen Star Cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, turning the muzzles to a different direction.
Realizing Han Xing’s intent, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s expression changed. It demanded, "What are you trying to do?"
Han Xing didn’t answer. He directly controlled ten Frozen Star Cannons, aimed at that gigantic Bird’s Nest, and fired.
"Boom!"
The Frozen Star Cannons emanated endless chill in the Void.
They fell onto that enormous Bird’s Nest.
Crack!
Massive ice spheres exploded.
They turned that Bird’s Nest, vast as a continent, into sheets of frozen plains.
At least several million Griffin Eggs were blasted to pieces!
Seeing this scene, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes nearly split.
"You damned human brat! I’ll tear you into ten thousand pieces!"
However, Han Xing looked at it with an even deeper gaze and said coldly, "I’ll repeat this once more. Answer my questions honestly."
"Otherwise, for every second that passes, I’ll fire ten more shells."
"I’ll keep going until every Bone-Eroding Griffin on this Bird’s Nest is completely wiped out."
Listening to Han Xing’s demonic whisper, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s body shuddered.
At this moment, it realized it had run into someone truly ruthless.
The other side was absolutely determined to pry information out of its mouth.
Right now, the Bone-Eroding Griffin was still gritting its teeth.
Han Xing didn’t waste words.
He continued controlling the Frozen Star Cannons and Dark Energy Cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, bombarding in wave after wave.
Crack!
Boom!
The gigantic Bird’s Nest was enduring Han Xing’s relentless shelling.
Many Griffin Eggs were frozen into ice spheres in an instant, then shattered into fragments of ice crystals.
The purple shells of the Dark Energy Cannons fell, corroding everything; within the entire Bird’s Nest, patches of dark purple zones appeared.
Finally, after the twelfth wave of bombardment, a look of heartache finally appeared in the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes.
It clenched its teeth and said, "Stop! Don’t bombard anymore!"
"Whatever you want to know, I’ll tell you!"
Hearing this, Han Xing finally ceased the bombardment and asked coldly, "Where did you get this arm?"
Disdain once more appeared in the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes as it replied, "Don’t ask me such idiotic questions. Of course this arm comes from this Forbidden Galaxy!"
Hearing its answer, Han Xing didn’t speak. He decisively activated the ten Frozen Star Cannons again and blasted away.
Boom!
Down below, another million plus Griffin Eggs exploded.
"Damn it!" Furious rage flooded the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes.
Han Xing was unmoved, continuing to ask, "I’ll ask you again—where did you get it?"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin seemed to be making a difficult decision.
Yet when it saw Han Xing mobilize dozens more Frozen Star Cannons, all aimed at the Bird’s Nest below—
It finally spoke. "From the Moon Shadow Bee Race!"
Hearing this name, everyone glanced at one another.
None of them had heard of this Race before.
At this time, Moya explained, "Master, the Moon Shadow Bee Race is one of the most powerful Races in the Forbidden Galaxy."
"They’re also a core Race of the Ten Thousand Races Alliance."
"Within their clan, it’s said there exist True God Level powerhouses."
When he heard that last sentence, Han Xing’s gaze sharpened.
True Gods, huh?
But thinking about it, it wasn’t that surprising.
After all, only True God Level Power could have obtained the Hunter’s corpse.
Han Xing nodded and continued asking, "Besides this arm, where are the other parts?"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin seemed a bit puzzled. "What?"
Han Xing frowned. "Don’t play dumb with me."
The Bone-Eroding Griffin had gotten used to Han Xing’s harsh tone, and slowly said, "I don’t know where the other parts are."
"All I know is that this arm comes from an absolute powerhouse, carrying immense might."
"And not just me—across the entire Forbidden Star River, many Races possess fragments of this absolute powerhouse’s remains."
"They all treat those fragments of remains as defensive tools."
After listening to the Bone-Eroding Griffin, a fierce chill once more appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
These bastards clearly know those corpse fragments are very likely from the one who created the Forbidden Star River.
Yet they still use those corpse fragments as mere tools.
This completely ignited the anger in Han Xing’s heart!

They fell onto that enormous Bird’s Nest.
Crack!
Massive ice spheres exploded.
They turned that Bird’s Nest, vast as a continent, into sheets of frozen plains.
At least several million Griffin Eggs were blasted to pieces!
Seeing this scene, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes nearly split.
"You damned human brat!
I’ll tear you into ten thousand pieces!"
However, Han Xing looked at it with an even deeper gaze and said coldly, "I’ll repeat this once more.
Answer my questions honestly."
"Otherwise, for every second that passes, I’ll fire ten more shells."
"I’ll keep going until every Bone-Eroding Griffin on this Bird’s Nest is completely wiped out."
Listening to Han Xing’s demonic whisper, the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s body shuddered.
At this moment, it realized it had run into someone truly ruthless.
The other side was absolutely determined to pry information out of its mouth.
Right now, the Bone-Eroding Griffin was still gritting its teeth.
Han Xing didn’t waste words.
He continued controlling the Frozen Star Cannons and Dark Energy Cannons on the Divine Demon Battleship, bombarding in wave after wave.
Crack!
Boom!
The gigantic Bird’s Nest was enduring Han Xing’s relentless shelling.
Many Griffin Eggs were frozen into ice spheres in an instant, then shattered into fragments of ice crystals.
The purple shells of the Dark Energy Cannons fell, corroding everything; within the entire Bird’s Nest, patches of dark purple zones appeared.
Finally, after the twelfth wave of bombardment, a look of heartache finally appeared in the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes.
It clenched its teeth and said, "Stop!
Don’t bombard anymore!"
"Whatever you want to know, I’ll tell you!"
Hearing this, Han Xing finally ceased the bombardment and asked coldly, "Where did you get this arm?"
Disdain once more appeared in the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes as it replied, "Don’t ask me such idiotic questions.
Of course this arm comes from this Forbidden Galaxy!"
Hearing its answer, Han Xing didn’t speak.
He decisively activated the ten Frozen Star Cannons again and blasted away.
Boom!
Down below, another million plus Griffin Eggs exploded.
"Damn it!" Furious rage flooded the Bone-Eroding Griffin’s eyes.
Han Xing was unmoved, continuing to ask, "I’ll ask you again—where did you get it?"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin seemed to be making a difficult decision.
Yet when it saw Han Xing mobilize dozens more Frozen Star Cannons, all aimed at the Bird’s Nest below—
It finally spoke.
"From the Moon Shadow Bee Race!"
Hearing this name, everyone glanced at one another.
None of them had heard of this Race before.
At this time, Moya explained, "Master, the Moon Shadow Bee Race is one of the most powerful Races in the Forbidden Galaxy."
"They’re also a core Race of the Ten Thousand Races Alliance."
"Within their clan, it’s said there exist True God Level powerhouses."
When he heard that last sentence, Han Xing’s gaze sharpened.
True Gods, huh?
But thinking about it, it wasn’t that surprising.
After all, only True God Level Power could have obtained the Hunter’s corpse.
Han Xing nodded and continued asking, "Besides this arm, where are the other parts?"
The Bone-Eroding Griffin seemed a bit puzzled.
"What?"
Han Xing frowned.
"Don’t play dumb with me."
The Bone-Eroding Griffin had gotten used to Han Xing’s harsh tone, and slowly said, "I don’t know where the other parts are."
"All I know is that this arm comes from an absolute powerhouse, carrying immense might."
"And not just me—across the entire Forbidden Star River, many Races possess fragments of this absolute powerhouse’s remains."
"They all treat those fragments of remains as defensive tools."
After listening to the Bone-Eroding Griffin, a fierce chill once more appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
These bastards clearly know those corpse fragments are very likely from the one who created the Forbidden Star River.
Yet they still use those corpse fragments as mere tools.
This completely ignited the anger in Han Xing’s heart!

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 490: Frenzied Advancement
paragraphs: At this point, Cheng Jianyong and the others also understood why Han Xing was so furious.
This guy was actually using the bodily fragments of Hunter as a weapon, and using them against Han Xing and the others.
Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, what should we do?"
Cheng Jianyong directly said, "Let’s go directly to those races’ bases and make them hand over Hunter’s body parts?"
"If they don’t comply, let’s beat them all up!"
Cheng Jianyong also appeared very angry.
Although Shen Yun was also angry, he calmly said, "Don’t be so impulsive, Xiaoyongzi."
"Didn’t Samoyed say that among these races, there might be beings of True God level?"
"We are currently not a match for the True Gods."
Everyone did not speak, but waited for Han Xing’s decision.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
Everyone understood Han Xing’s intention.
His current strength was insufficient, so he had to temporarily suppress the anger in his heart.
He could only wait until they had the power to face the True Gods before going to take back all of Hunter’s body parts!
Meanwhile, Han Xing was even more eager to quickly defeat the True Gods,
The [Celestial Rail Strike Device] had an attack power of 1.5 billion.
According to what Old Tree said at the time, combined with the power of the God of Radiance.
Han Xing speculated that with the full force of the Celestial Rail Strike Device, it should be able to severely injure a True God, or even cause them to fall directly.
But this was his trump card.
And having only one [Celestial Rail Strike Device] was not a sure thing either.
At this time, Han Xing thought, "In the short term, I can’t obtain a second World Will, nor can I make another Celestial Rail Strike Device."
"To deal with True Gods, I can only start from myself, or let Radiance break through to True God level."
Thinking of this, Han Xing secretly made up his mind.
Then, Han Xing looked ahead at the Bone-Eroding Griffin and continued to ask, "What about the half rule you snatched from Samoyed?"
For this question, the Bone-Eroding Griffin quickly answered, "I swallowed it."
Han Xing nodded and then looked at this Bone-Eroding Griffin.
At this moment, the Bone-Eroding Griffin also saw the murderous intent in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Brat, give me a swift end!
"Anyway, I know you won’t let me go!"
"Today, just consider it as my Bone-Eroding Griffin clan being defeated by you."
Han Xing nodded, "As you wish."
The next moment, he directly entered the ultimate skill — Endless Arrow Prison state.
Like other divine spirits.
When it saw Han Xing preparing to personally take action to end its life, this Bone-Eroding Griffin appeared extremely resistant.
It roared, "Let the top-tier divine spirit over there kill me!"
"You’re just a legendary ant, unworthy to kill me!"
However, Han Xing directly ignored its roar.
Slowly drawing the bowstring.
Then shot arrow after arrow.
Completely ended the life of this divine-level Bone-Eroding Griffin.
A system prompt appeared.

[Successfully killed Bone-Eroding Griffin·Biggs (Middle-tier Divine Spirit), gained experience value of 13,673.26 billion (experience value has reached the limit), automatically absorbed divine power from the opponent, divine power value +1000]
[Due to your outstanding battle merit this time, received an extra reward: Legendary Points +500]
Another 500 Legendary Points gained!
And this was the reason why Han Xing wanted to kill it personally.
Han Xing looked at his Legendary Points.
[Legendary Points: 2427]
"Great!"
"When extracting the Six Jails Reincarnation Arrow, it cost me 400 Legendary Points. Estimating the fifth skill would cost me 800 Points, and the sixth skill would cost 1600 Points!"
"The Legendary Points I currently have on hand are just enough to extract two skills!"
Han Xing let out a breath.
He had a premonition.
The fifth and sixth exclusive skills must be even more powerful than the ultimate skill!
Should be able to give his strength another substantial increase.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly clicked to extract.
A system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to consume 800 Legendary Points to extract the fifth exclusive skill for Wild Ranger?]
Han Xing clicked without hesitation, "Yes."
However, the next system prompt left Han Xing dumbfounded for a moment.
[Due to your tier not reaching Demigod, this extraction failed.]
"Damn... there’s such a restriction?"
Han Xing was full of doubt, and at the same time feeling a bit disappointed.
He shook his head and sighed, "Forget it, Demigod it is."
"Once I break through to Demigod, I can wear Sacred Artifact Equipment and extract new skills, my strength will surely have a terrifying increase!"
Thinking of this, Han Xing became even more expectant.
Meanwhile, with the death of the Bone-Eroding Griffin.
In the sky, a glowing nerve network snapped.
Then, turned into six divine formats gathering in front of Han Xing.
Han Xing walked up and collected these six divine formats.
The next moment, these six divine formats synthesized into a complete rule.
The attributes of this complete rule appeared before Han Xing.
[Power of Rules]: Special Item.
[Attributes]: Hatred
[Effect]: Complete ’Hatred’ rule, can break through to Divine Realm after reaching Demigod limit, becoming the new God of Hatred, or can directly absorb and increase 13000 divine power value.
Compared to the rules generally controlled by low-tier divine spirits,
This ’Hatred’ rule, after absorption, increases divine power more substantially.
But this is because it absorbed half a rule leading to enhancement.
It’s worth noting that absorbing just that half ’Forgotten’ rule can increase 5000 divine power.
In this calculation, Han Xing was still at a loss.
Thinking about it, Han Xing shook his head and said, "But this way, it’s impossible to assemble a complete Forgotten rule."
